channel.title: Canton Signal Feed — Infiniti Signals
channel.description: Canton Signal Feed is the Infiniti Signals intelligence layer for the Canton Network ecosystem: twice-hourly editions covering ecosystem, product, partnerships, funding, regulation and security news across Canton Network and its registry companies, published directly to the web page as soon as each edition is generated.

item.title: Quantstamp audit of Canton Coin found no high or medium issues
item.description:
Canton Signal Feed (Nov 22, 2026 · 8:36 AM ET)

- **Quantstamp audit of Canton Coin found no high or medium issues** — Quantstamp's audit of the Canton Coin application, the Splice Amulet implementation, carried out from May 5 to June 26, 2025 at the request of the Global Synchronizer Foundation's Tokenomics working group under CIP-0057, recorded seven findings in total, none of high or medium severity: five low-severity issues, four of them fixed and one acknowledged, plus two informational items, both acknowledged; a fix review on July 11, 2025 confirmed every issue had been fixed or acknowledged with sufficient reasoning by the core Splice contributor team (Quantstamp)
- **Alpend locked value climbs 1.52% in latest protocol read** — DefiLlama's latest protocol rankings put Alpend, the lending protocol, at $1.8 million in locked value, up 1.52% over 24 hours and 2.28% over seven days, holding second place among the eight tracked Canton protocols behind Temple at $5.77 million (DefiLlama)
- **Canton closes to within 0.8% of Avalanche in market rankings** — Blockdeck's latest ranking read puts Canton at a $2.96 billion market capitalisation, ranked 26th, directly below Avalanche at $2.98 billion, so Canton would need to grow about 0.8% to pass it, narrowed from about 1.4% in the 6:51 AM edition's read, with Ripple USD directly below at $2.87 billion (Blockdeck)

Network: Canton Coin (CC) trades at $0.0737, with a market cap of $2.96 billion (rank 26) and 24-hour trading volume of $5.4 million, down 1.29% in 24 hours, with circulating supply of 40.10 billion CC at the November 22 read; as a network milestone, Canton counts 1,581 validators alongside 13 Super Validators on the latest network read (Blockdeck for market data; CCTools for the milestone).

Original sources:
Quantstamp: https://certificate.quantstamp.com/full/canton-coin-an-implementation-of-splice-amulet/d95ae8a5-34b5-4245-8afc-bfd5435e4632/index.html
DefiLlama: https://defillama.com/chain/canton?tvl=false&events=false&incentives=true
Blockdeck: https://blockdeck.app/coin/canton-network

item.title: Canton Coin burned reads 14.4 million in latest 24-hour window
item.description:
Canton Signal Feed (Nov 22, 2026 · 8:21 AM ET)

- **Canton Coin burned reads 14.4 million in latest 24-hour window** — CCTools' rolling 24-hour window, as of the November 22 13:00 UTC read, puts burn at 14.4 million Canton Coin against app rewards at 14.0 million Canton Coin, moved from 14.5 million burned and 14.1 million in rewards cited in the 5:21 AM edition; this is the rolling window read, distinct from the November 21 calendar-day record of 15.8 million burned and 15.1 million in rewards cited in the 7:21 PM edition on November 21 (CCTools)
- **Canton futures open interest reads $32.54M in latest venue read** — Coinfuty's latest read puts total futures open interest at $32.54 million, down 0.34% over 24 hours, with an open-interest-weighted funding rate of positive 0.0037% per four hours, futures volume at $10.75 million, an aggregate long/short ratio of 0.820 and Bybit largest at $10.85 million ahead of Binance at $9.85 million and Hyperliquid at $3.48 million; this is Coinfuty's own venue set, distinct from the wider CoinGlass aggregate cited in the 8:06 AM edition, and the tracked liquidation total is not cited here because it is unchanged from earlier editions today (Coinfuty)
- **Tradecraft locked value eases to $1.36M in latest protocol read** — DefiLlama's latest protocol rankings put Tradecraft at $1.36 million in locked value, up 0.69% over 24 hours and down from $1.39 million recorded on November 21, as the fourth-largest of the eight tracked Canton protocols (DefiLlama)

Network: Canton Coin (CC) trades at $0.0737, with a market cap of $2.96 billion and 24-hour trading volume of $5.40 million, down 2.07% in 24 hours, with circulating supply of 40.10 billion CC at the November 22 read; as a network milestone, total Canton transactions reach 608.76 million on the latest network read (The Block for market data; CCTools for the milestone).

item.title: Canton's final rule delays end-user coin transfers by 24 hours
item.description:
Canton Signal Feed (Nov 22, 2026 · 6:51 AM ET)

- **Canton's final rule delays end-user coin transfers by 24 hours** — The Canton Network Docs registry details CIP-0107, at Final status after approval on March 10, 2026, which supports a 24-hour submission delay between preparing and executing all Canton Coin end-user transactions; the delay applies to all token standard operations, making Canton Coin fully compliant with the token standard, and to the Canton Coin actions of creating, renewing and archiving preapprovals, purchasing traffic and tapping funds on DevNet (Canton Network Docs)
- **Canton Coin futures funding rises to 0.0047% in the wider aggregate** — CoinGlass's latest aggregate, with data as of November 22 19:52 UTC+8, puts the open-interest-weighted funding rate at 0.0047%, about 5.18% annualised, up from 0.0033% recorded in the 6:06 AM edition, with futures open interest at $32.72 million, up 0.22% over 24 hours, futures volume at $10.70 million against spot volume at $3.30 million; the tracked liquidation total is not cited here because it is unchanged from earlier editions today (CoinGlass)
- **Canton's synchronizer orders encrypted messages it never reads** — BSC News' explainer describes the Global Synchronizer as the shared coordination layer that lets parties on different Canton validators transact with one another: each Super Validator runs a sequencer, which timestamps and orders incoming messages, and a mediator, which collects approvals from the relevant parties, while both components handle only encrypted messages, so the synchronizer can see routing metadata but never transaction contents; ordering runs on a two-thirds Byzantine Fault Tolerant consensus, so the network keeps processing even if a subset of operators goes offline or acts incorrectly (BSC News)

Network: Canton Coin (CC) trades at $0.0737, with a market cap of $2.95 billion and 24-hour trading volume of $5.39 million, down 0.75% in 24 hours, with circulating supply of 40.10 billion CC at the November 22 read; as a network milestone, Canton sits directly below Avalanche by market capitalisation, about 1.4% behind Avalanche's $2.99 billion on the latest ranking read (CCTools for market data; Blockdeck for the milestone).

Original sources:
Canton Network Docs: https://docs.canton.network/ai-context/cip-registry
CoinGlass: https://www.coinglass.com/currencies/CC
BSC News: https://bsc.news/news/canton-global-synchronizer-encrypted-ordering
CCTools: https://cctools.network/network

item.title: Canton's approved free preapproval rule gives Canton Coin transfers a 90-day free base window
item.description:
Canton Signal Feed (Nov 22, 2026 · 6:36 AM ET)

- **Canton's approved free preapproval rule gives Canton Coin transfers a 90-day free base window** — The Canton Network Docs registry details CIP-0119, approved on June 15, 2026, which introduces a free base duration for Canton Coin transfer preapprovals defaulting to 90 days, so a preapproval can be created or renewed using just traffic costs, including the free base traffic rate; the change addresses a bootstrapping problem created when CIP-0096 removed validator liveness rewards, after which most exchanges would only send Canton Coin to parties that already had preapprovals enabled, while enabling a preapproval itself required paying a Canton Coin fee for its expiry duration (Canton Network Docs)
- **aSOL begins trading on Cantex and OneSwap, bringing a SOL-backed token to two Canton venues** — Cantex opened trading in aSOL on November 19 and Cantor8 announced the OneSwap listing on November 20, giving Canton traders two venues in two days for the token that represents SOL on Canton; Cantex describes aSOL as backed one-for-one by Solana's SOL token and says qualified participants can redeem aSOL for SOL, with HelloMoon identified as the issuer and issuance through Cantor8's C8 Registry in partnership with ACME Markets (CantonNews)
- **Canton Coin futures open interest reads $26.5 million in a second derivatives aggregate, with average funding at negative 0.0019%** — Coinalyze's latest aggregate puts futures open interest at $26.5 million, down 0.09% over 24 hours, with average funding at negative 0.0019%, a predicted rate of positive 0.0029% and tracked liquidations at $402.20 over 24 hours on $6.7 million of volume; this is Coinalyze's own venue set, a narrower aggregate than the wider CoinGlass total cited in the 6:06 AM edition, so the two open-interest totals are not comparable (Coinalyze)

Network: Canton Coin (CC) trades at $0.0736, with a market cap of $2.95 billion (rank 26) and 24-hour trading volume of $5.4 million, down 0.20% in 24 hours, with circulating supply of 40.10 billion CC at the November 22 read; as a network milestone, Canton counts 11 proposals in progress out of 642 total proposals on the latest network read (Blockdeck for market data; CCTools for the milestone).

Original sources:
Canton Network Docs: https://docs.canton.network/ai-context/cip-registry
CantonNews: https://cantonnews.org/asol-begins-trading-on-cantex-and-oneswap
Coinalyze: https://coinalyze.net/?ref=dobermanvc.com&p=3
Blockdeck: https://blockdeck.app/coin/canton-network

item.title: Four Canton improvement proposals await a Super Validator vote, including a commercial-paper platform bid
item.description:
Canton Signal Feed (Nov 22, 2026 · 3:36 AM ET)

- **Four Canton improvement proposals await a Super Validator vote, including a commercial-paper platform bid** — The Canton Network Docs registry lists four proposals still at Proposed status, meaning submitted for a Super Validator vote and not yet approved: CIP-0131 would add CapConnect+ (CC+), a platform built to modernise the issuance and settlement of primary commercial paper, as a Super Validator at a maximum weight of 5 released through escrow as milestones are met, starting with one of the largest corporate commercial-paper issuers in the United States; CIP-0120 covers traffic-based validator rewards and confirming-validator incentives; CIP-0108 would add Merkle Science's predictive analytics as a weight 1 Super Validator; and CIP-0049 covers incentivising cold backups for Super Validators (Canton Network Docs)
- **Canton Coin's open-interest-weighted futures funding flips back positive to 0.0052% in the wider derivatives aggregate, with open interest at $32.17 million** — CoinGlass's latest aggregate puts the open-interest-weighted funding rate at positive 0.0052%, about 5.71% annualised, flipped back from negative 0.0032% recorded in the 2:51 AM edition, with futures open interest at $32.17 million, up 0.91% over 24 hours, futures volume at $10.25 million against spot volume at $3.13 million; the tracked liquidation total is not cited here because it is unchanged from the previous edition (CoinGlass)
- **Canton DEX volume reads $17.25 million over 24 hours in the latest chain read** — DefiLlama's latest chain read puts decentralised exchange volume at $17.25 million over 24 hours, down from $17.61 million recorded in the 1:36 AM and 2:51 AM editions, with perpetuals volume at $224,326 over 24 hours, up from $221,063 recorded in the 1:51 AM edition, across eight tracked protocols (DefiLlama)

Network: Canton Coin (CC) trades at $0.0729, with a market cap of $2.92 billion and 24-hour trading volume of $5.09 million, up 0.59% in 24 hours, with circulating supply of 40.10 billion CC at the November 22 read; as a network milestone, tracked fundraising for the Canton ecosystem totals $415 million across its recorded rounds (CCTools for market data; DefiLlama for the milestone).

item.title: CIP-0129, read from the builder's side: production traffic on every MainNet synchronizer will burn Canton Coin
item.description:
Canton Signal Feed (Nov 21, 2026 · 3:51 PM ET)

- **CIP-0129, read from the builder's side: production traffic on every MainNet synchronizer will burn Canton Coin** — A builder walkthrough published November 21 sets out the tentative 2027 rollout, under which production traffic on every MainNet synchronizer burns Canton Coin and any team will be able to launch its own synchronizer without negotiating terms, with guidance on how to plan an application around it (CantonNews)
- **Canton Coin futures liquidations ease to $21,580, all of them longs, as the open-interest-weighted funding rate deepens to negative 0.0128%** — CoinGlass's November 21 read puts 24-hour liquidations at $21,580, with $21,560 in longs and $17.95 in shorts, down from $23,360 recorded in the 3:21 PM edition, with futures open interest at $33.45 million, futures volume at $13.35 million against spot volume at $4.89 million and an open-interest-weighted funding rate of negative 0.0128%, about negative 14.1% annualised, with shorts paying longs (CoinGlass)
- **Temple's locked value climbs 4.27% in 24 hours to $5.92 million as Canton DeFi locked value reads $11.04 million** — DefiLlama's November 21 chain read puts total value locked at $11.04 million, up 0.14% in 24 hours, with DEX volume at $18.44 million over 24 hours and perpetuals volume at $219,251, across eight tracked protocols with Temple largest at $5.92 million, ahead of Alpend at $1.84 million and Cantex at $1.70 million (DefiLlama)

Network: Canton Coin (CC) trades at $0.0762, with a market cap of $3.06 billion and 24-hour trading volume of $7.54 million, up 4.06% in 24 hours, with circulating supply of 40.10 billion CC at the November 21 read; as a network milestone, 16.0 million CC were burned in the 24-hour window to 21:00 UTC, against 15.1 million CC in app rewards over the same window (CCTools for market data and the milestone).

item.title: Tokenomics Committee approves cBNB as a featured asset and pauses three featured apps over Canton Coin locking rules
item.description:
Canton Signal Feed (Nov 21, 2026 · 1:51 PM ET)

- **Tokenomics Committee approves cBNB as a featured asset and pauses three featured apps over Canton Coin locking rules** — The committee approved cBNB, issued by Nuxaris, as a featured asset, and paused Obligate, Obligate issuer and the Interstice Cross-Chain Swap Engine because they do not meet the CIP-0116 Canton Coin locking requirement; cBNB's liquidity on three trading venues will be reviewed on December 7, 2026, and its featured status will be revoked if it does not pass (CC Space)
- **Canton Coin's open-interest-weighted futures funding flips back negative to 0.0102% as liquidations ease to $23,160** — Coinfuty's live November 21 read puts the open-interest-weighted funding rate at negative 0.0102% per four hours, back below zero from positive 0.0026% recorded in the 1236 edition, with 24-hour liquidations at $23,160, almost all of them longs at $23,140 against $17.95 in shorts, futures open interest at $33.30 million, futures volume at $13.97 million and an aggregate long-to-short ratio of 0.853 across 13 tracked exchanges (Coinfuty)
- **Total Canton transactions reach 608.27 million as total parties climb to 956,505 on the latest network read** — CCTools' network read as of 18:10 UTC on November 21 puts total transactions at 608.27 million, up from 608.24 million recorded in the 1251 edition, with total parties at 956,505, up from 956,472, and 1,579 validators alongside 13 Super Validators (CCTools)
- **Canton Coin burned eases to 16.1 million in the latest 24-hour window, with app rewards at 15.2 million** — The burn and app rewards read for the 24-hour window as of 18:00 UTC on November 21 puts burned Canton Coin at 16.1 million, eased from 16.2 million in the previous window, with app rewards at 15.2 million and the latest issuance round at number 122,705; the figures are the tracker's rolling 24-hour window reads, not calendar-day totals (CCTools)

Network: Canton Coin (CC) trades at $0.0766, with a market cap of $3.07 billion and 24-hour trading volume of $9.12 million, up 2.70% in 24 hours and down 5.94% over seven days, with circulating supply of 40.10 billion CC at the November 21 read; as a network milestone, total Canton transactions reach 608.27 million, with total parties at 956,505 on the latest network read (The Block for market data; CCTools for the milestone).

item.title: CapConnect+ can earn up to five Super Validator weight units under CIP-0131, tied to commercial-paper settlement milestones on Canton
item.description:
Canton Signal Feed (Nov 21, 2026 · 12:51 PM ET)

- **CapConnect+ can earn up to five Super Validator weight units under CIP-0131, tied to commercial-paper settlement milestones on Canton** — The approval, passed with 12 votes in favour and one non-vote, sets one unit for first production atomic settlements of at least $100 million in aggregate within six months, one unit for bringing at least two US corporate commercial-paper participants into production within nine months, and three units for cumulative Canton-settled issuance of $1 billion, $5 billion and $10 billion within nine, 12 and 18 months, with the top two thresholds also requiring at least 120 and 200 settlement events; the platform aims to settle both the debt instrument and its payment on Canton, with DiSH or compatible onchain cash for the payment side, and its more than $46.11 billion of issuance since early 2025 used existing infrastructure and is not Canton volume (CantonNews)
- **Canton Coin burned reads 16.2 million in the latest 24-hour window, with app rewards at 15.2 million** — The burn and app rewards read for the 24-hour window as of 17:00 UTC on November 21 puts burned Canton Coin at 16.2 million and app rewards at 15.2 million, with the latest issuance round at number 122,699 as of 17:10 UTC; the figures are the tracker's rolling 24-hour window reads, not calendar-day totals (CCTools)
- **Canton Coin's open-interest-weighted futures funding reads negative 0.0187%, with shorts paying longs, as open interest holds at $33.60 million** — The November 21 read puts the open-interest-weighted funding rate at negative 0.0187%, about negative 20.4% annualised, with futures open interest at $33.60 million, futures volume at $15.19 million against spot volume at $5.58 million, and 24-hour liquidations at $33,840, almost all of them longs at $33,820 (CoinGlass)
- **Tradecraft's locked value rises to $1.39 million, up 5.33% in 24 hours, in the November 21 protocol read** — DefiLlama's November 21 protocol rankings put Tradecraft at $1.39 million in locked value, up 5.33% over 24 hours and up from $1.38 million recorded in the 1146 edition, as the fourth-largest tracked Canton protocol behind Temple at about $6.0 million, Alpend at $1.83 million and Cantex at $1.70 million across eight tracked protocols (DefiLlama)

Network: Canton Coin (CC) trades at $0.0766, with a market cap of $3.07 billion and 24-hour trading volume of $9.50 million, up 2.46% in 24 hours, with circulating supply of 40.10 billion CC at the November 21 read; as a network milestone, total Canton transactions stand at 608.24 million, with total parties at 956,472 on the live network read (CCTools for market data and the milestone).

Original sources:
CantonNews: https://cantonnews.org/canton-approves-capconnect-super-validator-plan-with-weight-tied-to-milestones
CCTools: https://cctools.network/network
CoinGlass: https://www.coinglass.com/currencies/CC
DefiLlama: https://defillama.com/chain/canton?chainRevenue=true&tvl=false

item.title: A Foundation proposal would cut 30.845 in Super Validator weight across eight operators over milestones not delivered on time
item.description:
Canton Signal Feed (Nov 21, 2026 · 8:12 AM ET)

- **A Foundation proposal would cut 30.845 in Super Validator weight across eight operators over milestones not delivered on time** — The proposal would remove escrowed weight of 3.0 from Ledger, 2.0 from BitGo, 5.0 from Zodia, 2.0 from Republic, 10.0 from YZi Labs, 4.0 from Blockdaemon, 0.75 from Zero Hash and 1.0 from Talos, plus 3.095 of previously unassigned weight; affected firms have 30 days to submit evidence for reconsideration, and accrued unminted rewards may be burned, while Canton Strategic Holdings separately had a further 1.375 weight released, worth 2,977,563 Canton Coin, after the October holding review (CC Space)
- **Canton Coin futures liquidations rise to $51,410, all but $169 of them longs, as open interest reads $32.91 million** — CoinGlass's November 21 read puts 24-hour liquidations at $51,410, with $51,240 in longs and $169 in shorts, up from $49,870 recorded earlier today, with futures open interest at $32.91 million, down 4.22% in 24 hours, futures volume at $18.32 million against spot volume at $6.75 million and an open-interest-weighted funding rate of negative 0.0012% (CoinGlass)
- **Grofty Labs' Canton wallet onboarding reaches 74,509 participants, with 200 codes released each day** — The production-ready, fully non-custodial browser-extension wallet covers Party ID management, Canton Coin and USDCx assets, a cross-chain bridge and in-wallet swaps; its onboarding codes drop at 200 per day at 00:00 UTC, one per account for Level 10 and above users, with participation up from 74,478 recorded earlier today (CCTools)
- **QUADRILLIONS' community campaign reaches 7,126 participants, with $3,000 in the token on offer through November 28** — The Supanova-launched token's campaign awards the 30 best posts $50 each and draws 60 further winners of $25 among participants who complete every task; participation is up from 7,067 recorded earlier today (CCTools)

Network: Canton Coin (CC) trades at $0.07490, with a market cap of about $3.01 billion (rank 22) and 24-hour spot volume of $6.75 million against futures volume of $18.32 million, down 4.63% in 24 hours, with circulating supply of about 40.10 billion CC at the November 21 read; as a network milestone, Canton counts 1.6 thousand validators on the live network stand (CoinGlass for market data; CantonNews for the milestone).

Original sources:
CC Space: https://cc.itrocket.space/news
CoinGlass: https://www.coinglass.com/currencies/CC
CCTools: https://cctools.network/earn

item.title: Obsidian's Keys milestone passes its acceptance vote with 60% in favour and none against
item.description:
Canton Signal Feed (Nov 21, 2026 · 1:42 AM ET)

- **Obsidian's Keys milestone passes its acceptance vote with 60% in favour and none against** — The recorded result clears the 51% threshold for the project's first milestone, which concerns a repository connecting software publishers and auditors with their signing keys and the rules for approving changes to those identities; the result advances the package-distribution project from submission to milestone acceptance, and a later request for payment details is a follow-up step rather than a receipt showing the milestone has been paid (CCTools)
- **Temple's locked value rebounds to $5.79 million as Canton DEX volume reads $18.58 million over 24 hours in the November 21 chain read** — DefiLlama's November 21 chain read puts total value locked at $10.69 million, down 3.05% in 24 hours, with perpetuals volume at $224,148, app fees at $7,486 and app revenue at $6,576 across eight tracked protocols; Temple is back up to $5.79 million from $5.65 million recorded in the first edition today, ahead of Alpend at $1.74 million, Cantex at $1.63 million and Tradecraft at $1.33 million (DefiLlama)
- **Canton Coin's November 21 technical read stays strongly bearish, with futures open interest rising to $14.40 million** — The daily read from the November 21 close at 07:12 UTC, taken at an analysis price of $0.0737, counts no bullish indicator groups against five bearish and two neutral, with the 14-day relative strength index at 28.9, down from 29.3 in the previous technical read, first resistance at $0.0758 and first support at $0.0728; average funding has turned positive at 0.0027%, from negative 0.0006% in the previous read (Coinotag)
- **Canton counts 955.5 thousand total parties on the live MainNet stand, with throughput at 1.00 transactions per second** — The live network stand on November 21 puts total parties at 955.5 thousand alongside throughput of 1.00 transactions per second and 11 active proposals; the throughput figure is a live-dashboard read that moves between refreshes, not a daily total (CantonNews)

item.title: Canton Coin futures liquidations rise to $49,870, almost all of them longs, as open interest falls to $31.81 million
item.description:
Canton Signal Feed (Nov 21, 2026 · 12:42 AM ET)

- **Canton Coin futures liquidations rise to $49,870, almost all of them longs, as open interest falls to $31.81 million** — CoinGlass's November 21 read puts 24-hour liquidations at $49,870, with $49,720 in longs and $154 in shorts, up from $30,480 recorded on November 20, with futures open interest at $31.81 million, down 8.51% in 24 hours, futures volume at $17.78 million against spot volume at $6.38 million and an open-interest-weighted funding rate of 0.0052% (CoinGlass)

item.title: Zenith EVM Testnet can now send a test token to Ethereum Sepolia through a pilot linking 15 external testnets
item.description:
Canton Signal Feed (Nov 20, 2026 · 11:42 PM ET)

- **Zenith EVM Testnet can now send a test token to Ethereum Sepolia through a pilot linking 15 external testnets** — The Zenith EVM Testnet can now send a test token to Ethereum Sepolia, and a pilot built by Cosmos connects Zenith to 15 external testnets, including Tempo, Arc and Besu environments; Gateway enables atomic asset transfers between the Canton Network and Zenith, while IBC explores connectivity between Zenith and external networks, and the work is an early testnet step in exploring how assets and messages could move between Canton, Zenith EVM and other ecosystems, not a live MainNet transfer route (CantonNews)
- **Canton Coin falls 7.70% to $0.0732 in the November 21 market analysis as the broader market drops 5.64%** — CoinMarketCap's November 21 analysis puts Canton Coin down 7.70% to $0.0732 against a broader market fall of 5.64% and a Bitcoin decline of 6.31%, a move consistent with market beta with modest underperformance and no confirmed Canton-specific catalyst; sentiment sits at extreme fear with an index of 7 and Bitcoin liquidations totalled $695.8 million over 24 hours, and the near-term watch is whether Canton Coin holds above $0.070 while Bitcoin steadies near $58,126, with a break below $0.070 seen as exposing the $0.065 area mentioned in social commentary rather than a verified support level (CoinMarketCap)

item.title: Canton Coin burned covers 68.9% of round mints in the third quarter, up from 11.0% a year earlier
item.description:
Canton Signal Feed (Nov 20, 2026 · 9:12 PM ET)

- **Canton Coin burned covers 68.9% of round mints in the third quarter, up from 11.0% a year earlier** — Alea Research's third-quarter review puts burn at 1.369 billion Canton Coin against round mints under a curve capped at 10 billion a year, with Temple, Kora and Cantex paying 56.5% of the quarter's burn and wallets paying 19.9%; on third-quarter traffic and price, the November 5 cap on app rewards lifts burn's share of round mints to 74.7% to 84.6%, and the first five capped days ran at 77.9% against 72.9% had the cap held nothing back (Alea Research)
- **EDX lists BitSafe's CBTC, giving Canton Bitcoin its first centralized-exchange USD market** — The listing offers eligible institutions CBTC/USD spot trading in a token described as backed one-for-one by Bitcoin for use inside Canton, with distributed reserve controls and Chainlink Proof of Reserve cited for backing transparency and Granite River Trading quoting two-sided markets from launch; CBTC/USD perpetuals are planned in the coming weeks, followed later by CBTC/BTC spot, and Canton Coin may become eligible collateral for the perpetual market — those are staged plans, not features live at launch (FinanceFeeds)
- **Valour's Canton Network ETP trades in Swedish kronor on Spotlight Stock Market** — The Valour Canton Network (CC) SEK ETP, trading symbol CC SEK and ISIN CH1108682662, began trading on November 5 as one of eight new Valour products on Sweden's Spotlight Stock Market, each carrying a 1.9% management fee and giving investors exposure through traditional brokerage infrastructure; the launch takes Valour's platform past 100 digital asset ETPs (GlobeNewswire)
- **Canton governance totals 642 proposals, with 11 in progress and a 93% approval rate** — The live governance read as of November 21 at 02:10 UTC counts 642 proposals in total, with 576 executed and 45 rejected alongside the 11 still in progress; the count is the tracker's cumulative governance total, not a count of proposals opened today (CCTools)

Network: Canton Coin (CC) trades at $0.0747, with a market cap of $2.99 billion and 24-hour trading volume of $8.20 million, down 5.62% in 24 hours, with circulating supply of 40.09 billion CC at the November 21 read; as a network milestone, Canton counts 1,579 validators alongside 13 Super Validators securing the Global Synchronizer (CCTools for market data and the milestone).

item.title: EDX Markets partners with Canton, listing Canton Coin and joining as a validator
item.description:
Canton Signal Feed (Nov 20, 2026 · 8:12 PM ET)

- **EDX Markets partners with Canton, listing Canton Coin and joining as a validator** — Under the strategic partnership announced by PRNewswire, the institutional-only trading venue and clearinghouse will list Canton Coin on its spot exchange for clients to trade and settle, support settlement in stablecoins on the Canton Network, and operate as a validator on Canton; EDX and Canton say additional integrations and joint programs are anticipated in the coming months, and the listing and validator roles are announced plans rather than confirmed live operations (PRNewswire)
- **Tenderly revises its Canton transaction-testing proposal to $421,520.63 over 24 months** — The revised proposal seeks $281,013.75 for development and adoption followed by $140,506.88 for maintenance, and would let developers test transactions against controlled copies of the ledger data they are authorized to access, inspect failures and run checks before releasing software, with hosted and self-hosted options; the proposal remains under review, with no funding award established (CantonNews)
- **Canton-upgrade seeks 220,000 Canton Coin for eight commands to check and rehearse Daml package upgrades** — The November 17 submission proposes tools for checking and rehearsing package upgrades, following their rollout and controlling when old packages stop being accepted, laid out in three milestones over roughly a month; the document also describes a $20,000 grant value with CC payments calculated at the exchange rate when disbursed, and the request remains a proposal rather than a released or funded toolkit (CCTools)
- **Traffic-based app rewards get a dated MainNet timetable, with a dry run scheduled to begin December 8** — The November 18 update sets out the next steps after the CIP-0104 amendment approval: Super Validators are expected to raise the onchain proposal for a MainNet dry run on December 1, the dry run is scheduled to begin December 8, calculations are reviewed through December and January, and a go-live vote is expected in late January or early February 2027 if the committee recommends proceeding; the timetable does not mean the revised reward system is already active (CCTools)

Network: Canton Coin (CC) trades at $0.07485, with a market cap of $3.00 billion and 24-hour trading volume of $16.26 million, down 6.79% in 24 hours, with circulating supply of 40.09 billion CC at the November 20 read; as a network milestone, the CantonNews live dashboard shows 11 active proposals on Canton MainNet, alongside 13 Super Validators securing the Global Synchronizer (Crypto.com for price and volume; CoinGecko for market cap; CantonNews for the milestone).

item.title: Canton docs walk through cross-synchronizer DvP settlement, with atomic exchange as the fifth of six steps
item.description:
Canton Signal Feed (Nov 20, 2026 · 6:42 PM ET)

- **Canton docs walk through cross-synchronizer DvP settlement, with atomic exchange as the fifth of six steps** — The worked example settles a trade between a buyer whose cash sits on a Payments synchronizer and a seller whose securities sit on a Securities synchronizer: both contracts are first reassigned, in two phases each, to a common Settlement synchronizer such as the Global Synchronizer, then a single Daml transaction archives the original cash and securities contracts and creates new ones with the owners swapped, so either both transfers happen or neither does; the reassignments themselves can leave a contract temporarily unusable in a pending state but carry no settlement risk, because no value changes hands until the atomic step executes, and afterwards the new contracts can optionally be reassigned back to their home synchronizers (Canton Network Docs)
- **Live MainNet rewards reach 14.9 million Canton Coin over the past 24 hours on the CantonNews dashboard** — The live dashboard read puts rewards at 14.9 million Canton Coin over 24 hours, up from 14.5 million recorded in the early-evening read today; the figure is the dashboard's rolling 24-hour reward total, not a new issuance schedule (CantonNews)

Canton Signal Feed (Nov 20, 2026 · 6:42 PM ET)

- **Canton docs walk through cross-synchronizer DvP settlement, with atomic exchange as the fifth of six steps** — The worked example settles a trade between a buyer whose cash sits on a Payments synchronizer and a seller whose securities sit on a Securities synchronizer: both contracts are first reassigned, in two phases each, to a common Settlement synchronizer such as the Global Synchronizer, then a single Daml transaction archives the original cash and securities contracts and creates new ones with the owners swapped, so either both transfers happen or neither does; the reassignments themselves can leave a contract temporarily unusable in a pending state but carry no settlement risk, because no value changes hands until the atomic step executes, and afterwards the new contracts can optionally be reassigned back to their home synchronizers (Canton Network Docs)

item.title: CIP-0131 would add CapConnect+ as a Canton Super Validator, with Tradeweb as sponsor
item.description:
Canton Signal Feed (Nov 20, 2026 · 5:42 PM ET)

- **CIP-0131 would add CapConnect+ as a Canton Super Validator, with Tradeweb as sponsor** — The proposal would give CapConnect+ a maximum Super Validator weight of 5, sponsored by Tradeweb; alongside it, Canton's first technical paymaster model for Universal Burn has entered voting — both are proposals in voting, not adopted changes or a running node (CoinStats)
- **Traffic-based app rewards get a dated MainNet timetable, with a dry run scheduled for December 8** — The November 18 update expects Super Validators to raise the onchain proposal for a MainNet dry run on December 1, with the dry run beginning December 8, committee and provider review through December and January, and a go-live vote in late January or early February 2027 if recommended, with full rewards in early February if approved; the new reward system is not active today (CCTools)
- **OnePump cuts its stated trading charges as Canborsa adds copper and natural-gas perpetuals** — OnePump's November 18 announcement says the first trade each day is free, trades of 900 Canton Coin or more have no network fee, and other trades cost 1 CC, with the larger-trade exemption covering the network fee specifically; Canborsa has added COPPER and NATGAS perpetual markets with long and short positions and leverage up to 20 times, giving price exposure rather than ownership of the physical commodities (CCTools)
- **Live MainNet rewards reach 14.1 million Canton Coin over the past 24 hours on the CantonNews dashboard** — The live dashboard read puts rewards at 14.1 million Canton Coin over 24 hours, up from 13.8 million recorded in the late-afternoon read today; the figure is the dashboard's rolling 24-hour reward total, not a new issuance schedule (CantonNews)

item.title: Canton docs publish a recovery runbook for validators stuck after the November 7 MainNet upgrade
item.description:
Canton Signal Feed (Nov 20, 2026 · 5:12 PM ET)

- **Canton docs publish a recovery runbook for validators stuck after the November 7 MainNet upgrade** — The official documentation explains that validators running Splice before 0.8.3 (Canton 3.5.18) did not correctly recognise the Logical Synchronizer Upgrade announcement, kept processing timestamps and stopped when their clocks overlapped the successor synchronizer; the strongly recommended recovery is restoring a database backup taken before the November 6, 14:00 UTC freeze and upgrading to a recent Splice version such as 0.9.4, while operators without a backup follow a procedure that creates a new validator, migrates namespace keys and parties, gives the node a new participant ID while party IDs stay unchanged, and requires Ledger API clients to rebuild their state (Canton Network Docs)
- **Circle Internet Group is awarded a MainNet validator node allocation on Canton** — The Canton Foundation Tokenomics Working Group's November 19 notice awards Circle Internet Group, Inc. one additional MainNet validator node allocation, issued in line with current network capacity and ongoing health assessments, adding the USDC issuer to the organisations running Canton nodes; an allocation is a place in the MainNet onboarding process and does not by itself confirm a running node (CC Space)
- **Grofty Labs' Canton wallet onboarding reaches 74,430 participants, with 200 codes released each day** — The production-ready, fully non-custodial browser-extension wallet covers Party ID management, Canton Coin and USDCx assets, a cross-chain bridge and in-wallet swaps; its onboarding codes drop at 200 per day at 00:00 UTC, one per account for Level 10 and above users, with participation up from 74,289 recorded on November 19 (CCTools)
- **Live MainNet rewards reach 13.8 million Canton Coin over the past 24 hours on the CantonNews dashboard** — The live dashboard read puts rewards at 13.8 million Canton Coin over 24 hours, up from 13.5 million recorded in the late-afternoon read today; the figure is the dashboard's rolling 24-hour reward total, not a new issuance schedule (CantonNews)

Network: Canton Coin (CC) trades at $0.074901, with a market cap of $3.00 billion (rank 25) and 24-hour trading volume of $8.19 million, down 8.66% in 24 hours, with a 24-hour range of $0.074581 to $0.082209 and circulating supply of 40.09 billion CC at the November 20 read; as a network milestone, Canton counts 953.9 thousand total parties on the CantonNews live dashboard, alongside 607.1 million total transactions (3commas, reporting CoinGecko data, for market data; CantonNews for the milestone).

item.description:

item.title: Fairmint plans a Canton venue for tokenized shares, with Tradecraft as its first market maker
item.description:
Canton Signal Feed (Nov 20, 2026 · 2:42 PM ET)

- **Fairmint plans a Canton venue for tokenized shares, with Tradecraft as its first market maker** — Announced on November 20, Fairmint TSV LLC would operate a trading venue for issuer-sponsored shares starting on Canton, with Ethereum planned after, connecting liquidity pools to an official onchain ownership record maintained by its SEC-registered transfer agent Fairmint TA LLC while Tradecraft provides the first automated market maker; the venue has not begun trading, its initial securities, eligible participants and launch date are still to be announced, and launch remains subject to the SEC Innovation Exemption requirements, final agreements and operational readiness (CantonNews)
- **Talos, Marex and Broadridge build a tokenized Treasury financing workflow on Canton** — Talos will supply trading technology and its request-for-quote network, Marex will provide prime brokerage, and Broadridge's DLX is intended to coordinate settlement and connect transactions to institutional records, with an initial focus on US Treasuries tokenized through the DTCC Tokenization Service and financing beyond traditional market hours; the integration is being built rather than live, and the announcement gives no launch date or measured volume (CantonNews)
- **Canton Coin's daily downtrend reads as weak in the November 20 chart analysis, with decision levels at $0.07875 and $0.08687** — The daily read puts trend strength at 21 on ADX, below the 25 mark that separates a trending market from a drifting one, after a 36 percent fall in 25 days to the November 15 low of $0.07498; a daily close under $0.07875 would extend the downtrend, while a close over $0.08687 would end it, and neither side holds the edge until one of those closes occurs (Sylvo)
- **Canton DeFi locked value eases to $10.61 million as 24-hour DEX volume slips to $17.87 million** — The latest chain read puts total value locked at $10.61 million, down from $10.68 million in the earlier read today, across eight tracked protocols with Temple largest at $5.68 million, followed by Alpend at $1.79 million and Cantex at $1.66 million, while DEX volume reached $17.87 million in 24 hours, down from $18.57 million earlier today (DefiLlama)

Network: Canton Coin (CC) trades at $0.0742, with a market cap of $2.97 billion (rank 25) and 24-hour trading volume of $8.19 million, down 8.79% in 24 hours and down 15.51% over seven days, with circulating supply of 40,093,216,670 CC at the 19:58 UTC November 20 read; as a network milestone, live MainNet rewards reach 12.3 million CC over the past 24 hours on the CantonNews dashboard, up from 11.1 million CC recorded earlier today (CoinGecko for market data; CantonNews for the milestone).

item.title: Splice's Canton compatibility changes make selected interfaces accessible and turn off startup configuration logging by default
item.description:
Canton Signal Feed (Nov 20, 2026 · 1:42 PM ET)

- **Splice's Canton compatibility changes make selected interfaces accessible and turn off startup configuration logging by default** — The latest dated codebase update in CoinMarketCap's November 20 roundup, dated October 23, tracks Splice's local adaptations to its copied Canton code: selected interfaces are made accessible to Splice, startup configuration logging is disabled by default because it could expose secrets, test retries and polling are improved, and build updates adjust dependency handling and caching; the update records integration and developer-workflow adjustments rather than a new network release, and it specifies no required node upgrade or breaking network change (CoinMarketCap)
- **Zenith's atomic composability lets Canton-native workflows invoke Solidity contracts in a single transaction** — A November 18 CantonNews wire item sets out how, through external_call, supported Canton-native workflows can invoke Solidity smart contracts on Zenith EVM with both sides coordinated as part of one atomic transaction, creating a path for institutional assets to interact with established DeFi mechanisms such as collateralised lending and swaps without those protocols being rebuilt in Daml; Zenith's Head of Ecosystem explains the approach in a new episode of Tokenization Talks (CantonNews)
- **The 21Shares Canton Network ETF trades at $12.6299 on November 20, down 7.02% in the session** — Finnhub's November 20 read puts the Nasdaq-listed TCAN fund at $12.6299 as of 1:32 PM ET, down $0.9536 from its previous close of $13.5835, after opening at $13.27 and trading between $13.2999 and $11.89, with returns of -16.03% over five sessions and -34.93% over one month; the figures describe the listed fund's market price, not network usage (Finnhub)
- **Canton Coin's multi-timeframe technical read aligns bearish across all four monitored frames in the November 20 snapshot** — TradeAnalyzer's 16:06 UTC November 20 snapshot shows a SHORT reading on the 15-minute, 1-hour, 4-hour and daily frames, with RSI at 23.3, 25.5, 29.6 and 29.9 respectively, 1-hour ADX at 33.0 and evidence agreement at 95 out of 100; price holds below the EMA50 on key frames, and a sustained reclaim of the 4-hour EMA50 near $0.0836 would weaken the bearish case, while the depressed hourly RSI is flagged as extension risk rather than an automatic reversal (TradeAnalyzer)

Network: Canton Coin (CC) trades at $0.0749, with a market cap of $3.00 billion (rank 25) and 24-hour trading volume of $9.0 million, down 9.08% in 24 hours and down 13.58% over seven days, with a range of $0.0746 to $0.0822 and circulating supply of 40.09 billion CC at the 19:08 UTC November 20 read; as a network milestone, Canton accounts for 0.15% of the total crypto market value of $2.01 trillion at that read (Blockdeck for market data and the milestone).

item.title: DLA Piper joins the Canton Foundation as an Associate Member to work on collateral and legal standards
item.description:
Canton Signal Feed (Nov 20, 2026 · 12:42 PM ET)

- **DLA Piper joins the Canton Foundation as an Associate Member to work on collateral and legal standards** — The law firm was named an Associate Member on November 2 and is expected to contribute to the Foundation's Collateral Subcommittee and its legal and regulatory standards work, adding a major law firm's market-infrastructure practice to the group that shapes how tokenized collateral is documented and governed on Canton; membership is a standards and committee role, not a product launch or a client deployment (CantonNews)
- **Rho reports distributing two million points for epochs 33 and 34 on Canton** — The distribution covers the platform's epochs 33 and 34 reward periods; the two million figure is platform points, not two million Canton Coin or two million dollars, so it records user-activity rewards inside the Rho programme rather than a token payout (CCTools)
- **Rocky Wallet adds support for LUNADOG, a community token launched on Supanova** — The wallet update adds the Supanova-launched community token to the assets Rocky Wallet supports, extending the wallet's coverage of Canton-native community tokens; support in a wallet is an access step and does not by itself establish the token's liquidity or value (CCTools)
- **Canton DeFi locked value eases to $10.83 million as 24-hour DEX volume rises to $18.4 million** — The latest chain read puts total value locked at $10.83 million, down 5.01% in 24 hours and down from the $10.97 million recorded earlier today, across eight tracked protocols with Temple still largest at $5.82 million, while DEX volume reached $18.4 million in 24 hours and $126.74 million over seven days; the figures are the tracker's measured DeFi totals, not total Canton network activity (DefiLlama)

Network: Canton Coin (CC) trades at $0.07757, with a market cap of $3.11 billion (rank 25) and 24-hour trading volume of $8.6 million, down 6.61% in 24 hours, with a 24-hour range of $0.07831 to $0.08278 and circulating supply of 40.09 billion CC at the 15:21 UTC November 20 read; as a network milestone, live throughput on Canton MainNet stands at 1.00 transactions per second on the CantonNews live dashboard, alongside 13 Super Validators (Coindataflow for market data; CantonNews for the milestone).

item.title: Tokenomics Committee approves six Featured Apps, four featured assets and three asset-moving apps on Canton
item.description:
Canton Signal Feed (Nov 20, 2026 · 12:12 PM ET)

- **Tokenomics Committee approves six Featured Apps, four featured assets and three asset-moving apps on Canton** — The November 19 approvals name Helvex, Cove Wallet API, Maha Wallet, Modulo, OS Ledger and Float as Featured Apps, with Canal, Tori Finance's trUSD and strUSD, BTC0 and Supanova as featured assets and Ekiden, Rocky Exchange and Supanova Launchpad as asset-moving apps, the last on a provisional basis requiring its asset rewards to buy back and burn its memecoins; Bitleo Wallet was paused for not meeting the CIP-0116 locking requirement, and a new committee takes over from November 20 with Chris Zuehlke of Cumberland as chair and Eric Saraniecki of Digital Asset as vice-chair (CC Space)
- **canton-upgrade seeks 220,000 Canton Coin for eight commands to check and rehearse Daml package upgrades** — The November 17 submission proposes tools for checking and rehearsing upgrades, following their rollout and controlling when old packages stop being accepted, over three milestones in roughly a month; the document describes a $20,000 grant value with Canton Coin payments calculated at the rate when disbursed, so the stated request is not a fixed final payout, and the toolkit remains a proposal rather than a released or funded product (CCTools)
- **Noves Canton Data App reaches version 4.2.8 with better export diagnostics and historical price coverage** — The November 17 release improves failed-export diagnostics and reporting and adds configurable database-storage pressure handling, under which historical work can pause while live activity continues; usage analytics in the release respect the account's opt-out setting (CCTools)
- **Canton Foundation spotlight puts Diviko's self-custody wallet and shared-approval vaults in focus on November 20** — The November 20 spotlight, following Diviko's earlier membership naming, highlights the Swiss developer's local-signing wallet, where keys are generated and used on the user's device, its multisignature vaults requiring a chosen number of signers before funds can move, and its Canton–Ethereum atomic swaps; the Foundation says Diviko already operates applications on MainNet and will contribute operator perspectives on interoperability, network economics and technical standards (CantonNews)

Network: Canton Coin (CC) trades at $0.0758, with a market cap of $3.0 billion (rank 25) and 24-hour trading volume of $8.7 million, down 7.55% in 24 hours and down 13.56% over seven days, with circulating supply of about 40,062,882,265 CC at the 16:04 UTC November 20 read; as a network milestone, live MainNet rewards reach 10.8 million CC over the past 24 hours on the CantonNews dashboard (Altcoin Buzz, reporting CoinGecko data, for market data; CantonNews for the milestone).

item.title: Silvana adds NPCC and QUADRILLIONS in its latest Canton listing update
item.description:
Canton Signal Feed (Nov 20, 2026 · 10:42 AM ET)

- **Silvana adds NPCC and QUADRILLIONS in its latest Canton listing update** — The November 17 listing update, promoted on November 18, adds the two tokens to Silvana's Canton listings; the listing announcement does not establish a particular level of liquidity or trading volume for either token, so the addition is a listing step rather than evidence of market depth (CCTools)
- **Canton Venues offers to serve as a second publisher for the Canton Application Data Framework** — The offer would add a second publisher for the framework's application data; its sample was described as unsigned and unanchored, so the comment is an offer to collaborate rather than an accepted integration or a live second publisher (CCTools)

item.description:
Canton Signal Feed (Nov 20, 2026 · 9:42 AM ET)

- **Obsidian seeks 4 million Canton Coin for a mathematically checked Daml reference model** — The Development Fund proposal, running over 12 months, would create a mathematically checked reference for how Daml packages and the Canton ledger behave, so analysis tools can test their assumptions against a common model; planned proofs cover authorisation, Canton Coin issuance, reward caps and the locking schedule, and the proposal is open rather than approved (CCTools)
- **Edel's planned Supanova stock pairs stay in final testing, with no new opening date** — Edel's November 17 plan named SPY, QQQ, Nvidia, SPCX and EDELx for additional Supanova pairings, but on November 18 Supanova said the stock pairs remained in final testing and would arrive later than planned, giving no replacement opening date, so these markets should not yet be described as live (CCTools)
- **Live MainNet rewards reach 9.2 million Canton Coin over the past 24 hours on the CantonNews dashboard** — The live read is up from the 8.4 million CC recorded in this morning's earlier edition, a genuine move in the daily reward total rather than a restatement; the figure is the dashboard's 24-hour reward measure for network activity, not a count of new users or of transactions (CantonNews)
- **Canton DEX volume totals $18.19 million over 24 hours as Temple holds at $16.89 million** — DefiLlama's November 20 rankings put total DEX volume at $18.19 million in 24 hours, up from the $18.11 million recorded earlier today, with Temple still the largest venue at $16.89 million in 24 hours ahead of Cantex at $1.3 million (DefiLlama)

item.title: Cancore adds Base as its seventh network connection for exchanging Canton assets
item.description:
Canton Signal Feed (Nov 20, 2026 · 8:42 AM ET)

- **Cancore adds Base as its seventh network connection for exchanging Canton assets** — The addition brings Cancore's stated network connections to seven — Canton, Ethereum, Arbitrum, BNB Chain, Robinhood Chain, TRON and Base — adding another network from which users can exchange supported assets through the platform; Cancore describes its settlement as atomic, meaning both sides of a trade complete together or the trade does not complete, the announcement extends the service beyond its earlier Canton–Ethereum stablecoin route, and available pairs and quotes still depend on the route selected in the app (CCTools)
- **Supanova introduces Thesis, a feature giving holders a place to explain why they hold a token** — The new social feature is now live within Supanova's memecoin launchpad, adding written reasoning to a platform otherwise centred on token discovery and trading; a holder's explanation remains their opinion and does not verify a project's claims or future value (CCTools)
- **Canton bridge volume totals $5.72 million over 30 days, with none recorded in the last seven days or the last 24 hours** — DefiLlama's November 20 bridge read lists Chainlink as the sole tracked bridge protocol for the chain, and the figures have genuinely moved from the November 19 read, when seven-day volume stood at $99,821 and the 30-day total at $7.7 million; the zero is the tracker's reported figure for the window, not a confirmed halt to cross-chain activity (DefiLlama)
- **Live MainNet rewards reach 8.4 million Canton Coin over the past 24 hours on the CantonNews dashboard** — The live read is up from the 8.1 million CC recorded in this morning's earlier edition, a genuine move in the daily reward total rather than a restatement; the figure is the dashboard's 24-hour reward measure for network activity, not a count of new users or of transactions (CantonNews)

Network: Canton Coin (CC) trades at $0.0785, with a market cap of $3.23 billion (rank 25) and 24-hour trading volume of $8.74 million, down 5.94% in 24 hours, with circulating supply of 40,089,228,416 CC at the 13:42 UTC November 20 read; as a network milestone, total Canton Coin burned on Canton reaches 6.13 billion CC on the live dashboard, up from 6.12 billion recorded earlier today (Coinotag for market data; CantonNews for the milestone).

item.title: Triple Play Labs seeks up to 7.15 million Canton Coin for private eligibility credentials on Canton
item.description:
Canton Signal Feed (Nov 20, 2026 · 8:12 AM ET)

- **Triple Play Labs seeks up to 7.15 million Canton Coin for private eligibility credentials on Canton** — The request would fund reusable checks that an account is eligible to hold or trade an asset, letting applications confirm relevant permissions without exposing every underlying detail, with an issuer able to revoke a credential when eligibility changes; the total comprises 3.5 million CC for development, up to 800,000 CC for a security review, 600,000 CC for maintenance and up to 2.25 million CC paid only on adoption, and the request still needs a champion and funding approval, so it is not an adopted network standard (CCTools)
- **Canton .NET SDK reaches version 0.8.0, targeting Canton 3.7 with bindings for Splice 0.10.0** — The release for applications written in C# and the wider .NET environment lets developers generate C# code from Daml contracts during a normal project build without installing a Java development kit for that step, submit related commands together, investigate writes whose outcome was initially unknown, and use a typed client for token-registry services with checks on disclosed contract signatories; version 0.8.0 contains breaking changes, so teams are asked to update the SDK packages together and regenerate their bindings, while teams remaining on Canton 3.6 can stay on the 0.7.x line (CCTools)
- **Live MainNet rewards reach 8.1 million Canton Coin over the past 24 hours on the CantonNews dashboard** — The live read is up from the 7.6 million CC recorded in this morning's earlier edition and the 6.7 million CC recorded earlier still, a genuine move in the daily reward total rather than a restatement; the figure is the dashboard's 24-hour reward measure for network activity, not a count of new users or of transactions (CantonNews)
- **Canton Coin's seven-day trading volume totals $88.58 million in the latest market read** — The seven-day total sits alongside $7.86 million in 24 hours, with price down 9.24% over seven days and down 24.81% over 30 days in the same read; the figures are a market snapshot of trading activity across venues, not a measure of on-chain network usage (AMBCrypto)

Network: Canton Coin (CC) trades at $0.07819, with a market cap of about $3.15 billion (rank 22) and 24-hour spot volume of $4.58 million alongside $13.53 million in futures volume, down 6.29% in 24 hours and down 8.57% over seven days, with circulating supply of about 40.09 billion CC at the November 20 read; as a network milestone, live throughput on Canton stands at 2.00 transactions per second on the live dashboard (CoinGlass for market data; CantonNews for the milestone).

item.title: Send restores its Canton Wallet on a new validator, with a one-time passkey security upgrade on the next sign-in
item.description:
Canton Signal Feed (Nov 20, 2026 · 7:42 AM ET)

- **Send restores its Canton Wallet on a new validator, with a one-time passkey security upgrade on the next sign-in** — The wallet is back online on a new validator after the outage explained in Send's October incident update; users are asked to approve a one-time security upgrade with their passkey the next time they sign in, wallet addresses and assets stay the same, the upgrade carries no fee and nothing is transferred, and the earlier incident report said customer wallets had not been accessed and customer funds had not been taken; the restoration announcement does not provide a new independent security assessment (CCTools)
- **The Development Fund merges the 12.95 million Canton Coin QuickStart Uplift, a 10.5-month upgrade to Canton's sample application** — The proposal was merged on November 10 after the voting tally was recorded, including use of an alternate for a conflict-of-interest abstention; Digital Asset and Moonsong Labs plan to update QuickStart, the sample application that helps developers learn to build on Canton, to current token standards and wallet-controlled signing, with a refreshed application, documentation and testing by outside developers, so new teams begin with current tools rather than an older setup they later need to replace; the merged decision is progress for the funding proposal, and the upgraded application still has to be delivered (CCTools)
- **Live MainNet rewards reach 7.6 million Canton Coin over the past 24 hours on the CantonNews dashboard** — The live read is up from the 6.7 million CC recorded in this morning's earlier edition, a genuine move in the daily reward total rather than a restatement; the figure is the dashboard's 24-hour reward measure for network activity, not a count of new users or of transactions (CantonNews)
- **Bybit extends its lead as Canton Coin's largest spot venue, at 26.56% of volume, as Temple's share rises to 24.48%** — The latest venue table puts Bybit's CC/USDT pair first at $2,087,503 in 24 hours, ahead of Temple Digital Group's CC/USDCx pair at $1,923,754, with Bybit's CC/USDC pair third at $789,076; Temple's share is up from the 15.22% recorded on November 19, and the read records zero Canton Coin liquidations across its 1-hour, 4-hour, 12-hour and 24-hour windows (AMBCrypto)

Network: Canton Coin (CC) trades at $0.079754, with a market cap of $3.20 billion (rank 25) and 24-hour trading volume of $7.86 million, down 4.01% in 24 hours and down 9.24% over seven days, with circulating supply of 40,090,557,763 CC at the November 20 read; as a network milestone, Canton counts about 1.6K validators and 13 Super Validators on the live dashboard (AMBCrypto for market data; CantonNews for the milestone).

item.title: Canton Coin's new supply grew 1.77% over the last 90 days, with the next 90 days estimated at 1.25% as issuance slows
item.description:
Canton Signal Feed (Nov 20, 2026 · 6:12 AM ET)

- **Canton Coin's new supply grew 1.77% over the last 90 days, with the next 90 days estimated at 1.25% as issuance slows** — The November 20 supply analysis counts 2.05 billion CC created through rewards, grants and voted releases over 90 days against 1.35 billion CC burned in fees, about two thirds of the new coins; protocol issuance between August 12 and November 10 totalled 1.93 billion CC, about 21.47 million a day, and has slowed to about 19.9 million a day since a November 5 vote cut how much applications can earn per dollar of fees, with no pre-mine, no vesting batch and no dated unlock scheduled in the next 90 days (MrNasDog)
- **Peaceful Studio's LocalNet release updates the bundled Canton test environment to Splice 0.10.2 and Canton 3.7.3** — Version 0.10.2-1 updates the bundled environment while the command-line and GitHub Action versions stay unchanged, and a new forum introduction explains how teams can run a local Canton environment inside an automated test workflow; the release is a developer test tool, not a MainNet upgrade (CCTools)
- **A 21-day vote opens on moving a contributor-enablement milestone from November 2026 to February 2027** — The milestone covers Digital Asset's core development teams moving their planning and roadmap tickets to open-source GitHub workflows; the amendment changes only the estimated delivery date for that third milestone and is awaiting a decision, rather than approving new work (CCTools)
- **Canton Coin's latest exchange read puts the $0.075 to $0.080 zone as support, with $0.085 to $0.087 as resistance** — The read frames the zones as levels to watch alongside volume and price confirmation after the recent decline, rather than as a forecast; it follows separate technical reads published earlier today with different levels, and is a market snapshot only (Bybit)

item.title: Obsidian outlines three Canton standards projects covering clear signing, validator access checks and personal-data handling
item.description:
Canton Signal Feed (Nov 20, 2026 · 5:42 AM ET)

- **Obsidian outlines three Canton standards projects covering clear signing, validator access checks and personal-data handling** — The three early outlines, each seeking a Tech & Ops Committee champion and a technical reviewer, cover signed, readable descriptions of application transactions that wallets and custody systems could verify and display, with an unverified fallback for transactions without a published description; a common rulebook and read-only checker comparing validator users, rights and identity-provider settings, reporting problems without changing access itself; and an eight-month plan for a specification, Daml library and supporting component for handling personally identifiable information, including verifiable erasure; the team says the projects would be open source, and the outlines are proposals being prepared rather than adopted standards or approved grants, with the clear-signing work also needing to account for transaction-review work already underway through Digital Asset and Blockdaemon's Wallet Gateway (CCTools)
- **Sync Insights introduces a multi-wallet view that separates internal transfers from external flows on Canton** — The new view combines balances, rewards, fees and activity across a user's Canton parties in one place, and separates transfers between the user's included wallets from external flows, helping avoid treating internal movements as fresh income or spending; the listing announcement does not establish a particular level of adoption (CCTools)
- **Pool Party's locked value stands at $196,017 in DefiLlama's November 20 protocol read** — The read lists the Send Foundation venue among eight tracked Canton protocols, with its locked value down 22.7% on the longest change window shown; the figure describes the tracker's measured value for this one venue, not total Canton network activity (DefiLlama)
- **CantonNews' Fear and Greed gauge stands at 12, in extreme fear, on its November 20 daily page** — The gauge is published alongside the day's live network activity as a sentiment measure; it is not a network launch, a trading signal or a price forecast (CantonNews)

Network: Canton Coin (CC) trades at $0.07983, with a market cap of about $3.21 billion (rank 22) and 24-hour spot volume of $4.56 million alongside $13.23 million in futures volume, down 3.68% in 24 hours and down 6.65% over seven days, with a range of $0.07837 to $0.08360 and circulating supply of about 40.09 billion CC at the November 20 read; as a network milestone, MainNet rewards total 6.7 million CC over the past 24 hours on the live dashboard, with 2 active proposals (CoinGlass for market data; CantonNews for the milestone).

- **CantonNews' Fear and Greed gauge stands at 12, in extreme fear, on its November 20 daily page** — The gauge is published alongside the day's live network activity as a sentiment measure; it is not a network launch, a trading signal or a price forecast (CantonNews)

item.title: Mystic Finance proposes a shared vault standard for Canton, with up to 2 million Canton Coin tied to development and verified adoption
item.description:
Canton Signal Feed (Nov 20, 2026 · 4:42 AM ET)

- **Mystic Finance proposes a shared vault standard for Canton, with up to 2 million Canton Coin tied to development and verified adoption** — The proposal, part of the Development Fund's October 16 voting batch of thirteen, would give compatible products common ways to handle deposits, ownership shares and withdrawals, reducing the separate integration work needed each time a wallet supports another vault; the request totals up to 2 million CC, split between 1 million for development and up to 1 million paid only on verified adoption by other teams, Cashen endorsed the effort on October 16 and intends to use the standard, and the funding vote does not itself approve a future Canton Improvement Proposal (CantonNews)
- **Kiwoom, CSDBR and Ironlight feature in a Canton validator application batch of seven, now in an objection period ending November 25** — The November 18 notice lists seven submissions that will be treated as implicitly approved if no concerns are raised; Kiwoom Securities wants a dedicated validator operated through a node-service provider to evaluate tokenization and institutional workflows, Brazil's CSDBR plans a Canton proof of concept to present to the Brazilian Securities and Exchange Commission with any implementation subject to regulatory approval, and Ironlight Technologies would control its own settlement infrastructure while developing an open-source identity-verification standard; the applications do not establish running nodes, Super Validator appointments or completed launches (CantonNews)
- **Canton Coin's November 20 unlock totals 21,421,761 Canton Coin, about 0.05% of circulating supply** — The dated unlock, valued at about $1.7 million at the price when read and rated low impact, continues the pattern of small daily releases rather than a single cliff event, following 21,191,792 CC on November 19 (World-Crypt)
- **Cantex is Canton's top decentralised-exchange gainer over seven days, with volume up 19.87% to $10.72 million as Temple eases 11.56%** — The November 20 rankings put total DEX volume at $18.11 million in 24 hours and $603.34 million over 30 days, with Temple still the largest venue at $16.77 million in 24 hours despite its seven-day decline to $116.02 million and Cantex at $1.34 million in 24 hours (DefiLlama)

Network: Canton Coin (CC) trades at $0.07995, with a market cap of $3.20 billion and 24-hour trading volume of $7.89 million, down 5.14% in 24 hours at the November 20 read; as a network milestone, total transactions on Canton reach 607.1 million, with total parties at 953.9K, about 1.6K validators and 13 Super Validators on the live dashboard (OKX for market data; CantonNews for the milestone).

item.title: Canton network fees in the 30 days through November 17 were more than twice those on Ethereum, settled by burning Canton Coin
item.description:
Canton Signal Feed (Nov 20, 2026 · 4:12 AM ET)

- **Canton network fees in the 30 days through November 17 were more than twice those on Ethereum, settled by burning Canton Coin** — The figure comes from the network's official account as summarised in the November 20 market review; fees on Canton are settled by burning CC, so the comparison is presented as a measure of paid network use over that 30-day window rather than as a price or revenue claim, and analysts remain divided on whether burns and token unlocks will net out to demand for CC (CoinStats)
- **Concordia submits its next auction milestone for review, with sealed-bid, Dutch and multi-unit formats using Token Standard V2 allocations** — The submission includes public code, examples and tests for the expanded auction tools; it is an applicant's delivery submission for committee review, not yet evidence of acceptance or payment (CCTools)
- **Supanova reports 30 million Canton Coin in volume and more than 36,000 trades in its November 15 update** — The launchpad's latest update rises from the 20 million CC it reported on November 6; the update does not specify the measurement period, so the figure is not presented as 24-hour volume, and the trade count is not a count of unique users (CCTools)
- **Canton Coin's November 20 technical levels put first support at $0.0799 and first resistance at $0.0844** — The read puts the daily relative strength index at 34.5 and the weekly at 36.1, with price below all eight moving averages measured, second support at $0.0748 and the recovery band at $0.0868 to $0.0890; the levels are a market snapshot, not a forecast (CoinStats)

Network: Canton Coin (CC) trades at $0.08041, with a market cap of $3.2 billion (rank 25) and 24-hour trading volume of $7.6 million, down 1.9% in 24 hours and down 9.7% over seven days, with a range of $0.079585 to $0.083607 and circulating supply of 40,087,101,760 CC at the November 20 read; as a network milestone, total value locked on the Canton chain stands at $11.1 million, with recent chain fees running at about $7,036 per day (Crypheat, reporting CoinGecko figures, for market data and the milestone).

item.title: Canton Foundation adds 14 parties, including KPMG and Visa, in its latest published membership notice
item.description:
Canton Signal Feed (Nov 20, 2026 · 3:42 AM ET)

- **Canton Foundation adds 14 parties, including KPMG and Visa, in its latest published membership notice** — The notice, filed on August 4 under the National Cooperative Research and Production Act and published on November 10, adds KRO Brokers, BPX Markets, Tokenovate, Zeppelin Group, KPMG, Hecto Finance, Texture Capital, Titan Labs, Edge & Node Ventures, Halborn, 21M Labs, the International Securities Lending Association, Visa and Transcend Street Solutions as parties to the Canton Foundation venture, extending the Act's limit on antitrust recovery to actual damages; membership remains open and the filing records no other change to the venture's planned activity (PolicyRisk)
- **Tokenized Treasuries hold $10.47 billion across 29 products in the November 20 board refresh, as DTCC's service runs on Canton** — The board read at 03:18 UTC on November 20 puts Treasury and government-securities products at $10.47 billion, 50.9% of its $20.59 billion total, led by Ondo's USDY at $2.10 billion, Circle's USYC at $2.01 billion and BlackRock's BUIDL at $1.57 billion; DTCC's Tokenization Service, live since October 28 on Canton and DTCC's private Besu network, has 20 signed participants including Bank of America, Citi, Fidelity, J.P. Morgan, Morgan Stanley, State Street and UBS, while the roughly $30 trillion figure cited for the service is the market value of eligible securities, not an amount already converted (RWAWeekly)
- **Canton Coin's technical read stays bearish into November 20, with first support at $0.0783 and first resistance at $0.0824** — The daily read at 08:51 UTC on November 20 shows a strong bearish bias across its indicator groups, with the 14-period relative strength index at 34.9, futures open interest at $15.54 million and average funding at negative 0.0088%, a derivatives posture that points to short positioning rather than leveraged long buildup at current levels (Coinotag)
- **Morgan Stanley says it has converted U.S. equities and Treasuries to tokenized form through DTCC's service** — The firm's November 3 post places it among the first banks to convert securities through the service; it discloses no amounts, specific securities, network or transaction date, and DTCC's own tokenization totals are reported to SEC staff privately each quarter rather than published, with the first report, covering the fourth quarter of 2026, due around mid-January 2027 (RWAWeekly)

Network: Canton Coin (CC) trades at $0.0802, with a market cap of $3.23 billion (rank 25) and 24-hour trading volume of $8.39 million, down 3.04% in 24 hours and down 9.71% over seven days, with a range of $0.0786 to $0.0838 and circulating supply of 40,089,228,416 CC at the 08:52 UTC November 20 read; as a network milestone, DTCC's Tokenization Service covers 34 eligible securities at launch on Canton and its Besu network, drawn from Russell 1000 equities, major-index ETFs and U.S. Treasuries (Coinotag for market data; RWAWeekly for the milestone).

item.title: Fairmint backs the SEC's transfer-agent modernization, asking that onchain shareholder registers be judged by the same tests as conventional ones
item.description:
Canton Signal Feed (Nov 20, 2026 · 2:12 AM ET)

- **Fairmint backs the SEC's transfer-agent modernization, asking that onchain shareholder registers be judged by the same tests as conventional ones** — In a comment letter submitted November 3 on the SEC's proposed transfer-agent rules (Release No. 34-106246, File No. S7-2026-30) and promoted in a November 18 release, Fairmint asks the Commission to confirm that a qualifying onchain record can itself be the master shareholder file, that a token represents a share only when recorded on the issuer's authority, and that holding a private key does not by itself confer authority to transfer; its registered subsidiary Fairmint TA LLC serves as onchain transfer agent for Canton Strategic Holdings' tokenized common stock, and the letter sets out proposed changes only, not adopted rules (Quantisnow)
- **FTP submits evidence for its third x402 milestone, with 350,000 Canton Coin payable only if the milestone is accepted** — The submission reports at least 1.85 GB of MainNet traffic over June 15 to September 14; the reporting period is historical, and the submission itself does not establish acceptance or payment of the 350,000 CC milestone (CCTools)
- **DamlForge publishes version 0.0.16 and a revised milestone report, with 655 passing tests and review still open** — The update reports fixes made following champion review, and a subsequent committee reply says the language team is still reviewing, so this is a submission update rather than milestone acceptance (CCTools)
- **Doppler Finance's real-world-asset roadmap puts a Canton move and instant redemption in early 2027, after a December Flare expansion** — The thesis published on Thursday sets out the sequence for the vault protocol, which started with XRP yield vaults and is widening toward tokenized gold, equities, commodities and fixed-income assets; Doppler has not published how the Canton integration or the instant redemption feature will work, so timing beyond early 2027 remains open (Cryptonews)

Network: Canton Coin (CC) trades at $0.0797, with a market cap of $3.2 billion (rank 25) and 24-hour trading volume of $7.5 million, down 3.67% in 24 hours and down 7.36% over seven days at the 06:23 UTC November 20 read; as a network milestone, the validator pipeline advanced this week as Kora's approval notice moved its Canton validator application forward, a step separate from node allocation and operation (Altcoin Buzz, reporting CoinGecko figures, for market data; CCTools for the milestone).
