item.title: Tradecraft's locked value falls to $1.35 million, a new all-time low for the Canton liquidity layer
item.description:
Canton Signal Feed (Nov 20, 2026 · 1:12 AM ET)

- **Tradecraft's locked value falls to $1.35 million, a new all-time low for the Canton liquidity layer** — DefiLlama's live read puts the automated market maker at $1.35 million, with its November 20 daily snapshot at $1.37 million marked as its all-time low, down from $1.41 million on November 19 and from its $1.74 million all-time high on October 31; users swap Canton-native and bridged assets on Tradecraft and provide liquidity to earn trading fees, with all of its tracked value on Canton (DefiLlama)
- **Canton DeFi locked value eases to $10.95 million as 24-hour DEX volume rises to $17.85 million** — The latest chain read puts total value locked down 3.99% in 24 hours, with DEX volume at $126.74 million over seven days, perpetuals volume at $238,377 in 24 hours, app fees at $7,241 and app revenue at $6,268, across eight tracked protocols with Temple still largest at $5.88 million ahead of Alpend at $1.79 million and Cantex at $1.73 million (DefiLlama)
- **Canton Coin sits about 1.2% below Litecoin in market value as its turnover stays well below the top-100 norm** — With a market capitalisation of $3.18 billion against Litecoin at $3.21 billion directly above it, Canton would need to grow about 1.2% to pass it, while $7.9 million in 24-hour volume equals 0.25% of its market cap against a typical 2.86% turnover for the top 100 coins (Blockdeck)
- **No Canton Coin arbitrage route is worth taking at the latest scan, with spot prices 7.69% apart across liquid exchanges** — The November 20 scan at 05:33 UTC puts Canton Coin cheapest on MEXC at $0.073791 and dearest on Gate at $0.079465 across 11 exchanges with a liquid spot market, with only caveated pairs in profit after taker fees and the best futures route, long on WhiteBIT perpetuals against short on Bybit perpetuals, at 0.20% after fees (ArbitrageGap)

Network: Canton Coin (CC) trades at $0.0792, with a market cap of $3.18 billion (rank 25) and 24-hour trading volume of $7.9 million, down 4.85% in 24 hours and down 8.33% over seven days, with a range of $0.0787 to $0.0836 and circulating supply of 40.09 billion CC at the November 20 read; as a network milestone, Canton DEX volume totals $126.74 million over the past seven days across eight tracked protocols (Blockdeck for market data; DefiLlama for the milestone).

item.title: Cauri starts a six-week community challenge on Canton, with 10,000 Canton Coin in Season 01 rewards
item.description:
Canton Signal Feed (Nov 20, 2026 · 12:12 AM ET)

- **Cauri starts a six-week community challenge on Canton, with 10,000 Canton Coin in Season 01 rewards** — Season 01 advertises 10,000 CC in total: 6,000 CC across weekly challenges and 4,000 CC in season awards, with Week 1, Roll Call, offering five awards of 200 CC each; the launch post directs participants to Discord for entry instructions and submission details, so the advertised rewards depend on completing the stated tasks rather than holding an asset (CCTools)
- **Canborsa adds Solana and Tron as funding routes for moving funds in and out** — Canborsa says Solana and Tron are now integrated for funding, expanding the ways users can move funds in and out of the venue; its public wallet guide still lists the six older supported networks and has not yet supplied the new asset, fee or limit details, and the announcement concerns funding access rather than a claim that Canborsa's trading assets are deployed natively on both chains (CCTools)
- **Temple's locked value eases to $5.92 million in the November 20 snapshot as its 24-hour DEX volume holds at $16.43 million** — DefiLlama's daily snapshot puts Temple at $5.92 million on November 20, down from $6.05 million on November 19 and below its $7.45 million all-time high on November 3, with DEX volume at $16.43 million in 24 hours and $116.02 million over seven days (DefiLlama)
- **Canton Coin open interest falls to $34.75 million as derivatives positioning contracts without a liquidation cascade** — The November 20 read puts open interest at $34.75 million, down 3.88% in the period and down 21.50% over 30 days to near its 30-day low of $32.79 million, with funding close to neutral at 0.0002% per eight hours; the pattern reflects longs closing positions rather than forced selling (CoinStats)

Network: Canton Coin (CC) trades at $0.079, with a market cap of $3.17 billion (rank 25) and 24-hour trading volume of $7.88 million, down 5.05% in 24 hours and down 8.33% over seven days, with a range of $0.0787 to $0.0836 and circulating supply of 40,089,819,700 CC at the 05:07 UTC November 20 read; as a network milestone, Temple's cumulative fees reach $564,671, with $563.95 million in DEX volume over the past 30 days on Canton (Kriptometre, reporting CoinGecko figures, for market data; DefiLlama for the milestone).

item.title: Further Asset Management signs a memorandum to join Canton's validator network and explore a Super Validator in the UAE
item.description:
Canton Signal Feed (Nov 19, 2026 · 11:12 PM ET)

- **Further Asset Management signs a memorandum to join Canton's validator network and explore a Super Validator in the UAE** — Under the agreement announced in Abu Dhabi, Further will join the Canton Validator Network and explore establishing a Canton Super Validator in the UAE, aiming to position Abu Dhabi as a regional hub for production-grade tokenization, collateral mobility and on-chain market infrastructure; several Further portfolio companies already build on or support Canton applications across custody, tokenization, payments and trading venues, and Further says it will mobilise that ecosystem to accelerate institutional adoption in the Middle East (Further Asset Management)
- **OpenAssets partners with Digital Asset to offer institutional tokenization services on Canton through DA Registry** — OpenAssets will serve as an implementation partner for Digital Asset's tokenization engine, DA Registry, combining tokenized asset issuance, settlement, compliance, asset management and distribution; institutions can configure allowlists and blocklists and transfer-approval functions linked to external know-your-customer and anti-money-laundering monitoring, with assets able to take part in atomic settlement, collateral management and cross-application lending on Canton (TradingView News)
- **Tharimmune takes a Super Validator role on Canton as part of a Canton Coin treasury strategy** — The Nasdaq-listed company says its role as a Super Validator aims to bolster transaction security and strengthen a digital-asset strategy, established in November 2025, focused on acquiring Canton Coin and earning validator rewards; it also plans to invest in applications on Canton to accelerate institutional use and market adoption (CoinLive)
- **Canton DeFi locked value stands at $11.03 million in the November 20 read as 24-hour DEX volume holds at $17.48 million** — The snapshot puts total value locked at $11.03 million, down 2.65% in 24 hours, with decentralised exchange volume at $17.48 million in 24 hours and $126.35 million over seven days, and perpetuals volume at $236,392 in 24 hours (DefiLlama)

Network: Canton Coin (CC) trades at $0.0796, with a market cap of $3.19 billion (rank 25) and 24-hour trading volume of $7.93 million, down 3.7% in 24 hours; as a network milestone, Canton supports more than 750 validators, the base that new validator entrants such as Further are joining (Coinbird, reporting CoinGecko data, for market data; KuCoin for the milestone).

item.title: Woof seeks 1,248,700 Canton Coin for a compliance middleware SDK that lets Zenith EVM contracts act on issuer decisions recorded on Canton
item.description:
Canton Signal Feed (Nov 19, 2026 · 10:12 PM ET)
- **Woof seeks 1,248,700 Canton Coin for a compliance middleware SDK that lets Zenith EVM contracts act on issuer decisions recorded on Canton** — Proposal #621, from the builders of DeFi infrastructure for Compound, would deliver an open-source SDK in which an operator-run service reads an issuer's or operator's decision through the Ledger API, checks the address-to-party binding and signs a short-lived, single-use permit for one specific EVM action, with the contract checking the permit's binding, expiry and revocation path; external adoption accounts for 40% of the request, with 249,740 Canton Coin payable per independent organisation, up to two, once it integrates the SDK in a test environment and publishes its evidence, and the proposal is not yet funded and still seeks a Tech & Ops Committee champion and review from the Regulatory Compliance SIG (Canton Network Forum)
- **Wrapped Canton Coin holds $165,269 in locked value as EA Finance's 1:1 bridge for Canton Coin onto EVM chains** — DefiLlama describes wCC, developed by EA Finance, as a 1:1 wrapped representation of Canton Coin on EVM chains starting with BSC, built as an interoperability layer to expand access, composability and capital flow into the Canton ecosystem; its daily locked value stood at $167,611 on November 19, down 20.9% over the past 30 days from $206,678 on October 21, and it ranks 83rd among tracked bridge protocols (DefiLlama)
- **Canton DeFi locked value stands at $10.98 million in the November 20 read as 24-hour DEX volume rises to $17.75 million** — DefiLlama's latest chain read puts total value locked down 3.66% in 24 hours, with DEX volume at $126.64 million over seven days, perps volume at $237,122 in 24 hours, app fees at $7,205 and app revenue at $6,232 over the same period, and $1.72 million in token incentives, across eight tracked protocols with Temple still largest at $5.88 million (DefiLlama)
- **Canton Coin's community sentiment sits at 52% bullish in the latest CoinGecko poll as its heat score stays at zero** — Crypheat's November 20 read rates Canton Coin's heat score at 0, labelled COLD and down one point from yesterday, with the price down 9.7% over seven days and 24.2% over 30 days and turnover described as slow, with 24-hour volume equal to 0.2% of market cap (Crypheat)

Network: Canton Coin (CC) trades at $0.0798, with a market cap of $3.20B (rank 25) and 24h volume of $7.49M, down 3.08% in 24 hours with circulating supply of 40,087,101,760 CC at the 00:49 UTC November 20 read; milestone: chain fees run at about $7,036 per day in the latest daily snapshot, a figure the source describes as a proxy for real usage of the chain (Kaavon, reporting CoinGecko figures, for market data; Crypheat for the milestone)

item.title: Canborsa moves its AI assistant into execution, letting users open and close leveraged positions by instruction
item.description:
Canton Signal Feed (Nov 19, 2026 · 9:12 PM ET)

- **Canborsa moves its AI assistant into execution, letting users open and close leveraged positions by instruction** — The November 17 update says the assistant can now open and close leveraged positions, set take-profit and stop-loss orders, swap assets and deposit into Earn, with voice instructions supported and every trade shown to the user for review before execution; that is a step beyond the October version, which answered market and portfolio questions while order placement was still planned, and AI assistance does not remove the need to check the asset, size and terms presented for approval (CCTools)
- **Obsidian's Keys milestone passes its acceptance vote with 60% in favour and none against** — The recorded November 17 result clears the 51% threshold for the first milestone of the package-distribution work, which maintains a repository connecting software publishers and auditors with their signing keys and the rules for approving changes to those identities; the vote advances the project from submission to milestone acceptance, and a later request for payment details is a follow-up step rather than proof the milestone has been paid (CCTools)
- **CantonGrid presents an open-source Rust indexer for Canton and seeks a champion, contributors and Development Fund support** — Built by a Rust engineer while developing a Daml prediction-market application, the framework is at working alpha stage with authorised PQS integration, PostgreSQL persistence, contract lifecycle tracking and party-aware REST and GraphQL access, demonstrated in two end-to-end LocalNet runs indexing a contract from draft to resolved; production hardening, DevNet validation, large-scale backfills and real-time streaming remain planned work under RFP 20, and no funding has been approved (Canton Network Forum)
- **Canton bridge volume totals $7.7 million over 30 days, with just $99,821 in the last seven days and none in the last 24 hours** — DefiLlama's November 19 bridge read lists Chainlink as the sole tracked bridge protocol for the chain, and the seven-day figure is down sharply from the $399,220 recorded on November 14, with the 30-day total easing from $11.68 million in that earlier read; the zero is the tracker's reported figure for the window, not a confirmed halt to cross-chain activity (DefiLlama)

Network: Canton Coin (CC) trades at $0.0790, with a market cap of $3.2B (rank 25) and 24h volume of $7.6M, down 3.68% in 24 hours at the 02:11 UTC November 20 read; milestone: the latest runtime configuration lists the next logical synchronizer upgrade on DevNet, Canton's developer test environment, targeting protocol version 37, with its topology-freeze time recorded as November 17 at 14:00 UTC — a DevNet setting that does not establish a MainNet upgrade (AltcoinBuzz, reporting CoinGecko figures, for market data; CCTools for the milestone)

item.title: Canton's Protocol Development Fund counts 42 approved projects and 290 million Canton Coin in commitments in its first report
item.description:
Canton Signal Feed (Nov 19, 2026 · 8:12 PM ET)
- **Canton's Protocol Development Fund counts 42 approved projects and 290 million Canton Coin in commitments in its first report** — The Canton Foundation's first report on the fund puts total commitments at 290.0 million CC across work on protocol performance, developer tooling, security reviews and open infrastructure, and launches Development Fund 2.0, which targets 80% of the budget at roadmap requests for proposals under the 2026–2028 technical vision while preserving up to 20% for individual initiatives; the updated template requires each applicant to define the problem, evidence the need, name a community champion and tie payments to milestones (Canton Foundation)
- **CCTools' next grant takes the Canton toolkit on-chain, turning project discovery into verifiable activity** — CCTools, the community toolkit that maps Canton projects and aggregates the market data several Canton protocols feed to DefiLlama, says its next Development Fund grant moves it from making the network legible to making it actionable from one place, adding on-chain activity and a grounded assistant alongside its existing portfolio tracking across Canton, EVM and Solana wallets, its anti-sybil Human Score and its learn-to-earn paths; the on-chain phase is listed as building now, not yet live (CCTools)
- **Canton Coin futures volume runs at about two and a half times spot, with almost no forced selling in the latest day** — The latest derivatives read puts 24-hour futures volume at $12.37 million against $4.68 million in spot, while tracked liquidations totalled just $197.66, all of it longs, and the open-interest-weighted funding rate sits at -0.0077%, meaning shorts are paying longs; the pattern points to positioning staying orderly rather than leverage being flushed out (CoinGlass)

Network: Canton Coin (CC) trades at $0.08001, with a market cap of about $3.21B (rank 22) and 24h volume of $7.91M, down 2.06% in 24 hours with a range of $0.07946 to $0.0836 and circulating supply of about 40.09B CC at the 01:33 UTC November 20 read; milestone: the Protocol Development Fund has paid or minted 62.2 million CC to date against accepted milestones and approved recurring work, with the full 290.0 million CC commitment released only as work is accepted (CoinGlass for market data; Coinotag for the volume read; Canton Foundation for the milestone)

item.title: Standard Chartered says Japan's government-bond tokenization could support its $2 trillion tokenized-asset forecast for the end of 2028
item.description:
Canton Signal Feed (Nov 19, 2026 · 7:12 PM ET)

- **Standard Chartered says Japan's government-bond tokenization could support its $2 trillion tokenized-asset forecast for the end of 2028** — The bank places the tokenized real-world-asset market at about $2 trillion by the end of 2028 against roughly $45 billion today, an expansion of more than 44 times, an outlook it also maintained in its May 2026 investor presentation with tokenized money market funds and listed equities as major contributors; it sees longer-dated Japanese government bonds on blockchain infrastructure as a category that could reduce transaction costs, enable round-the-clock trading and broaden investor access, while noting adoption still depends on institutional participation, secondary-market liquidity, legal certainty and integration with existing settlement systems (Tron Weekly)
- **Saxon tests an offline-root setup for its self-hosted Canton validator key drivers, with the node never holding the root key** — In the November 13 update, the root key was generated and used only in a separate offline process, signing a delegation to an intermediate key held in Scaleway Key Manager, and the participant registered pre-created keys, joined a synchronizer and hosted a party without the node ever holding the root; a second KMS intermediate plus revocation of the first, both signed offline, kept the party's ID while the revoked key could no longer authorise anything, though disabling the keys in the KMS stopped the node only after about three minutes because session signing keys keep it signing for their lifetime (Canton Network Forum)
- **Canton decentralised-exchange volume totals $610.77 million over 30 days, with Temple still the largest venue** — DefiLlama's November 19 rankings put Temple at $15.71 million in 24-hour DEX volume and Cantex at $1.41 million, with Cantex volume up 11.62% over seven days while Temple eases 9.52% over the same period (DefiLlama)

Network: Canton Coin (CC) trades at $0.0804, with a market cap of $3.22B (rank 25) and 24h volume of $7.56M, down 2.27% in 24 hours with a range of $0.0796 to $0.0836 and circulating supply of 40,087,101,760 CC at the 00:15 UTC November 20 read; milestone: the network record counts 146 featured app rights and 1,563 validator licenses, with 13 Super Validators operating under a 9-of-13 voting threshold (Criptano, reporting CoinGecko figures, for market data; CCTools for the milestone)

item.title: Canton Risk Engine seeks 1,560,870 Canton Coin to bring governed risk parameters to Canton lending and vaults
item.description:
Canton Signal Feed (Nov 19, 2026 · 6:42 PM ET)

- **Canton Risk Engine seeks 1,560,870 Canton Coin to bring governed risk parameters to Canton lending and vaults** — Proposal #665 from Woof, builders of DeFi infrastructure for Compound, would deliver an on-chain risk-parameter Registry in Solidity where risk-reducing changes apply after approval and loosening changes wait a full timelock, an ERC-4626 vault and lending market integrated with the Registry on Zenith testnet plus a Daml governance example, and an open simulator and self-hostable dashboard; Milestone 3 is 40% of the request (624,348 CC) and pays only on committee acceptance plus a publicly confirmed integration by an external Canton DeFi team, and the proposal is not yet funded and still seeks a Tech & Ops champion (Canton Network Forum)
- **A Delegated Automation proposal would make Canton delegation a scoped, revocable grant enforced on the ledger** — The reusable Daml standard would let a user authorise another party, such as an automation operator, to execute one specific action on their behalf, with each grant bounded by max executions, expiry and cooldown plus app-defined rules enforced on-ledger so a faulty or compromised runner cannot exceed what was granted, alongside a UI dashboard to view and revoke grants; it is seeking a champion (Canton Network Forum)
- **Dedaub seeks a champion for DamlSec, a tool to check compiled Daml packages for security problems before deployment** — The revised proposal under RFP 22 remains a proposal with no new approval established; Dedaub says the original request was closed during the Development Fund transition (CCTools)
- **Canton DeFi locked value eases to $10.99 million as 24-hour DEX volume rises to $17.12 million** — DefiLlama's latest November 19 read puts TVL down 4.62% in 24 hours from $11.2 million recorded earlier today, with perps volume at $238,246 in 24 hours, Temple still largest at $5.89 million ahead of Alpend at $1.83 million and Cantex at $1.75 million across 8 tracked protocols (DefiLlama)

Network: Canton Coin (CC) trades at $0.0801, with a market cap of $3.21B (rank 25) and 24h volume of $7.54M, down 2.08% in 24 hours with circulating supply of 40,087,101,760 CC at the 11:36 PM UTC November 19 read; milestone: 24h network rewards reached 15.0M CC, up from 14.4M CC in the 5:42 PM edition, with live throughput at 7.00 transactions per second, total transactions at 606.4M and total burned at 6.12B CC (Kaavon, reporting CoinGecko figures, for market data; CantonNews for the milestone)

item.title: Rütli splits a Canton validator's keys across a threshold cluster so no single machine ever holds the whole key
item.description:
Canton Signal Feed (Nov 19, 2026 · 5:42 PM ET)

- **Rütli splits a Canton validator's keys across a threshold cluster so no single machine ever holds the whole key** — Stakecraft's open-source, self-hosted KMS (Apache-2.0) holds namespace and signing keys as FROST-Ed25519 shares across a t-of-n cosigner cluster, plugs into an unmodified participant through the KMS Driver SPI, and lets an existing validator migrate in without changing its namespace or party IDs; a Splice 0.9.0 / Canton 3.6.1 DevNet validator has run on it since October 7, the internal review is done, and the RFP 26 proposal would fund a Cure53 audit with a public report, a TestNet run of at least four weeks and a 1.0 release — it is not externally audited yet and Stakecraft warns against putting production authority keys behind it until that audit is done (Canton Network Forum)
- **OpenZeppelin's Canton library and four application designs pass Development Fund review** — The open-source Daml contracts library, released under MIT and implementing Token Standard V2 (CIP-0112), is available now and was tested together on LocalNet; the four reviewed designs — a private exchange with atomic settlement, a lending market, cross-chain stablecoin payments and confidential sealed-bid auctions — were reviewed and approved by Digital Asset but still need implementation, and security audits are planned for the next phase rather than completed (CCTools)
- **Canton Flash Liquidity seeks a champion for an uncollateralised borrow-and-repay primitive that settles in one atomic transaction** — The RFP 13 proposal would let a borrower draw funds with no collateral, put them to work and repay principal plus fee in a single borrower-submitted transaction on Token Standard V2 (CIP-0112) rails; if repayment falls short the whole transaction is rejected and the pool is untouched (Canton Network Forum)
- **QUADRILLIONS runs a $3,000 community campaign on Canton through November 28, with 6,447 joined so far** — The meme coin launched on Supanova, completed its bonding curve there and now trades in a liquidity pool; the campaign pays the 30 best posts $50 each in QUADRILLIONS and draws 60 further $25 winners among everyone else who completes every task (CCTools)

item.title: Canborsa opens its Road to 1 Million creator campaign, with a prize pool that grows to $10,000 at one million verified views
item.description:
Canton Signal Feed (Nov 19, 2026 · 4:42 PM ET)

- **Canborsa opens its Road to 1 Million creator campaign, with a prize pool that grows to $10,000 at one million verified views** — The campaign runs from November 16 to December 16, with two leagues carrying 32 paid places alongside weekly draws and a $500 creative award; the maximum pool is conditional on verified community views reaching the milestones, and the public rules include league-entry score and average-view thresholds, content review, one submission per UTC day and up to 15 works for the campaign (CCTools)
- **Canton's package manager reaches version 1.1.0, letting projects depend on prebuilt DARs straight from Git instead of keeping local copies** — With dpm 1.1.0 a project can reference a DAR where it lives in a public repository, and on install dpm downloads and caches the file and rewrites the branch or tag to the exact commit so everyone builds against the same DAR, while build and test work as before; the feature was built by Moonsong Labs with support from the Canton Development Fund and reviewed and released by the Digital Asset dpm team (Canton Network Forum)
- **Developers flag that Daml cannot yet verify Ed25519 signatures on the ledger, leaving some Canton security features waiting** — A November 16 forum discussion confirms that DA.Crypto.Text verifies only the secp256k1 family on-ledger, with no Ed25519 support, even though Canton supports Ed25519 at the protocol level and most external parties are onboarded with it; the poster says features and security enhancements are pending on this, a respondent confirmed the reading and noted two practical traps in the secp256k1 path, and no roadmap date was given (Canton Network Forum)
- **No Canton Coin arbitrage route is worth taking at the latest scan, with spot prices 5.98% apart across liquid exchanges** — The 21:54 UTC November 19 scan puts Canton Coin cheapest on WEEX at $0.075385 and dearest on LBank at $0.079895 across 11 liquid exchanges, with the widest route, buying on MEXC and selling on LBank at 5.47% after fees, flagged as a suspect pair, and the best futures route long WhiteBIT and short Lighter at 0.32% after fees; the spread has widened from 5.20% recorded earlier today (ArbitrageGap)

item.title: DTCC will add Stellar in the first half of 2027 and Circle's Arc and Solana in the second half to its tokenization service, keeping Canton as its core near term
item.description:
Canton Signal Feed (Nov 19, 2026 · 3:42 PM ET)

- **DTCC will add Stellar in the first half of 2027 and Circle's Arc and Solana in the second half to its tokenization service, keeping Canton as its core near term** — Canton was the first network DTCC partnered with on tokenization, in December 2025, and its Tokenization Service launched in October 2026 on Canton and DTCC's private Besu network under agreements with 20 participants, letting them turn entitlements to stocks, ETFs and Treasuries held at DTC into tokens carrying the same legal rights and transferable 24 hours a day between registered wallets; the multi-chain additions are still at the planning stage, so Canton is expected to serve as the core of the service's ecosystem in the near term (Tiger Research)
- **Obsidian Systems prepares a machine-checked semantics of Daml-LF 2 so Canton analysis tools can be tested against one public model** — The proposal under RFP 22, on Daml security standards, would build an executable semantics of Daml-LF 2.x and the Canton ledger model in Agda in a public Apache-2.0 repository over 12 months, delivering a core semantics that agrees with the Daml engine on the Daml Script tests of 20 real packages and rejects seeded authorisation defects, plus proofs on Splice code covering authorisation, Canton Coin issuance, the CIP-0098 reward cap and the CIP-0105 lock schedule, with part of the grant paid only on outside adoption; it is seeking a Tech & Ops Committee champion and a technical reviewer (Canton Network Forum)
- **BlockBot seeks a wallet review for a WhatsApp-based AI wallet interface for Canton under RFP 14** — The Development Fund proposal, filed as pull request 1056 under RFP 14 on wallet and dApp integration tooling, presents BlockBot as a WhatsApp-based AI wallet interface designed to make Canton interactions more accessible while providing reusable wallet and dApp integration tooling, and asks the Wallet Apps and dApp Integration group for a technical review of its wallet architecture, signing flow, security model and alignment with ecosystem priorities, and for a champion (Canton Network Forum)
- **About 79% of updates recorded on Canton in a 24-hour period in November were private, as the network keeps most activity visible only to its parties** — The figure reflects Canton's sub-transaction privacy model, in which each participant's node receives only the parts of a transaction it is involved in while the Global Synchronizer orders encrypted messages and confirms transactions without seeing their contents, a design intended to let institutions issue, trade and settle tokenized assets together without showing positions, client data or collateral flows to competitors (Decrypt)

item.title: Predge seeks a champion for conditional x402 payments on Canton, released only by a signed delivery verdict
item.description:
Canton Signal Feed (Nov 19, 2026 · 3:12 PM ET)

- **Predge seeks a champion for conditional x402 payments on Canton, released only by a signed delivery verdict** — x402 payments on Canton are final at the moment of the call today, with no way back short of a manual refund if the paid job is not delivered; Predge's draft proposal would lock the amount in a Daml escrow contract instead, with a verifier checking delivery against criteria agreed up front and issuing an ed25519-signed verdict that anyone can verify offline, recorded on the ledger to release the funds or refund the payer, and the payer able to reclaim on their own if no verdict arrives in time; the same escrow-plus-verdict design has been live on Arc mainnet since September 2026 and on 16 EVM mainnets, settling a GPU rental per verified day on November 12 where the A100 days were paid and a day the host swapped in an A40 was refunded by the contract, and the draft plan runs about four months at about 600,000 Canton Coin over three milestones, seeking a Tech & Ops Committee champion under RFP 13 and not yet funded (Canton Network Forum)
- **A Daml bytes and cryptography library seeks 300,000 Canton Coin to give developers the byte operations Daml lacks natively** — The Apache-2.0 library plus DPM component, proposed under RFP 16 with RFP 19 elements, asks for 300,000 Canton Coin over nine weeks in three milestones of 100,000 each and has been open for review since October 23 with status Needs Champion; Daml has no byte array type, so bytes from other systems use hex-encoded text and every team writes the remaining operations itself, and the scope covers byte operations, documented cryptography wrappers, RLP encoding and decoding, and binary Merkle and Ethereum Patricia trie proof verification, with the proof of concept's RLP encoder passing all 28 official ethereum/tests vectors, its signature verification passing 8 of 8 Wycheproof assertions and its keccak256 output matching Foundry's cast byte for byte, and the repository stays private until Milestone 1 publishes it (Canton Network Forum)
- **Tradecraft's locked value eases to $1.41 million as the Canton AMM's slide from its October peak continues** — DefiLlama's daily snapshots put the automated market maker and liquidity layer at $1.41 million on November 19, down from $1.44 million on November 18 and above the $1.39 million low on November 15, against an all-time high of $1.74 million on October 31; users swap Canton-native and bridged assets on Tradecraft and provide liquidity to earn trading fees, with 100% of its tracked locked value on Canton (DefiLlama)
- **A new guide sets out how Canton governs itself through the CIP process, with sponsorship and a two-thirds vote before any change takes effect** — Anyone can author a Canton Improvement Proposal, and the discussion period runs three months for Standards Track proposals and one month each for Governance and Tokenomics proposals; moving to a vote requires sponsorship from two Super Validators, which signals the proposal is worth voting on rather than endorsing it, the Super Validator voting window lasts 10 days with approval requiring a two-thirds supermajority and no single entity holding veto power, and a proposal reaches Final status only after two-thirds of Super Validators have implemented the change on-chain, moving through DevNet and TestNet before MainNet (CantonNews)

item.title: CoBuilders proposes a sandbox testing library so JavaScript and TypeScript teams stop rebuilding their own Canton test harnesses
item.description:
Canton Signal Feed (Nov 19, 2026 · 2:42 PM ET)

- **CoBuilders proposes a sandbox testing library so JavaScript and TypeScript teams stop rebuilding their own Canton test harnesses** — STL, proposed under RFP 18, is an open-source npm package that starts and stops the Canton Sandbox, creates fresh parties and users for each test, and already runs unchanged OpenZeppelin contracts against a real Sandbox in public CI in its beta; the grant would add authenticated submission and queries, control of ledger time through static time, party and contract lookup helpers, compatibility tests, three migration pull requests for independent projects and a Node.js testing tutorial, with a request for 400,000 Canton Coin over eight weeks of development and twelve months of maintenance, of which 69,000 coins are paid only when an independent project adopts STL in its own CI, and the proposal is seeking feedback and a champion (Canton Network Forum)
- **A native IBC v2 proposal would connect Canton directly to Cosmos chains without a custom bridge for each chain** — The BeencoLabs proposal would write IBC v2 core and ICS-20 transfers in Daml, so any Cosmos chain on a recent ibc-go could send assets to Canton through its existing transfer module and received assets would land as CIP-56 holdings that work in existing Canton wallets and applications; the gateway would run as a decentralised party with a confirmation threshold so no single operator can move funds, the first scope is one working connection between Canton DevNet or TestNet and one Cosmos testnet covering transfers in, transfers out and timeout refunds with an open-source relayer path and documentation, and the proposal is seeking a Tech & Ops Committee champion (Canton Network Forum)
- **Canton DeFi locked value eases to $11.2 million as 24-hour DEX volume rises to $16.85 million** — DefiLlama's November 19 evening read puts total value locked at $11.2 million, down 2.76% over 24 hours from the $11.32 million snapshot recorded this morning, while 24-hour DEX volume rose to $16.85 million from $16.41 million in that morning read, across the eight protocols DefiLlama tracks on Canton (DefiLlama)
- **Grofty Labs' Canton wallet is among only three active campaigns on CCTools, with 200 onboarding codes released each day** — Grofty is a production-ready, fully non-custodial browser-extension wallet for Canton covering Party ID management, Canton Coin and USDCx assets, a cross-chain bridge and in-wallet swaps; its onboarding codes drop at 200 per day at 00:00 UTC, one per account for Level 10 and above users, with 74,289 joined to date, and CCTools lists 27 campaigns in total with only three currently active (CCTools)

item.title: Digital Asset introduces covalidation services so Canton parties can spread transaction confirmation across independent operators
item.description:
Canton Signal Feed (Nov 19, 2026 · 1:42 PM ET)

- **Digital Asset introduces covalidation services so Canton parties can spread transaction confirmation across independent operators** — The November 19 introduction lets a party be multi-hosted so several nodes share confirmation duties, including threshold settings such as two approvals from three covalidators before a transaction confirms, with no single node able to confirm alone and services able to continue if one node becomes unavailable; 5N Loop, T-RIZE and Bron are already using multi-hosted infrastructure, 5N Loop became the first Canton wallet where every new participant is multi-party hosted using Digital Asset and MPCH as independent operators, and Digital Asset, MPCH and Kiln are among the early covalidation service providers, building on underlying capabilities delivered in May 2026 (Crypto Economy)
- **Obsidian Systems prepares an access rulebook and read-only checker for Canton validator logins under RFP 25** — The proposal would build an open Apache-2.0 standard covering how identity-provider logins and Canton users and rights are set up, a read-only checker that reads a validator's users, rights and identity provider and reports each broken rule with how to fix it without changing anything, a mapping from each rule to audit requirements such as SOC 2, ISO 27001 and DORA, and tested setup recipes, with part of the grant paid only when operators outside Obsidian run the checker on their own TestNet or MainNet validators; it is seeking a Tech & Ops Committee champion and technical reviewer and is distinct from the same firm's RFP 26 clear-signing proposal (Canton Network Forum)
- **Ditto seeks guidance on bringing working yield vaults to Canton, starting from a private DevNet prototype** — Ditto, which operates a Canton MainNet validator, says it has built a private prototype for Canton DevNet using Canton Token Standard interfaces, with application accounting and processing queues currently maintained off-ledger, and is asking which vault interfaces, packages and versions are ready to use today, which priority protocol integrations or operational workflows sit outside existing vault proposals, and whether a maintainer or integration partner would review a small scope before it defines a Development Fund proposal (Canton Network Forum)
- **Canton's represented tokenized assets on RWA.xyz rise to $370.5 billion in the November 12 read, all of it in recordkeeping form** — The updated figure, up from the $320.7 billion snapshot served on November 18, puts Canton at 88.6% of the $418.2 billion in represented value RWA.xyz tracks across networks, while the same read shows $0 in distributed tokens held in investor wallets, 0 holders and $0 of transfers in the last 30 days, so the ranking reflects ledger recordkeeping rather than distributed onchain holdings (Daniil Kozin, reporting RWA.xyz)

item.title: Obsidian Systems prepares a clear-signing proposal so Canton wallets can show users what they are actually approving
item.description:
Canton Signal Feed (Nov 19, 2026 · 12:42 PM ET)

- **Obsidian Systems prepares a clear-signing proposal so Canton wallets can show users what they are actually approving** — Most Canton wallets today decode only a handful of transaction types, mostly transfers, and show little more than a fingerprint for other applications, leaving the wallet screen as the last chance to catch a compromised transaction; the proposal under RFP 26 would deliver an open format for signed, human-readable transaction descriptions, a library wallets and custody systems can use to verify and display them, and a readable fallback marked unverified for applications without a published description, all under Apache-2.0 and building on an approved developer-keys grant, and it is seeking a Tech & Ops Committee champion and technical reviewer while noting related transaction-visualisation work already underway at Digital Asset and Blockdaemon (Canton Network Forum)
- **Canborsa adds copper and natural gas perpetual markets with leverage up to 20 times** — The new COPPER and NATGAS markets let traders take long and short positions on price movements without owning the physical commodities, adding commodity exposure to the venue's perpetuals range; the contracts are derivatives, so they provide price exposure rather than ownership (CantonNews)
- **OnePump lowers its stated trading charges, with the first trade each day free** — Under the November 18 fee announcement, trades of 900 Canton Coin or more carry no network fee and other trades cost 1 Canton Coin, with the larger-trade exemption referring specifically to the network fee rather than every possible trading cost (CantonNews)
- **A canton-upgrade proposal requests 220,000 Canton Coin for tools to move live Daml packages from one version to the next** — The Development Fund submission proposes eight commands — validate, rehearse, vet-status, pin, status, migrate, unvet and gate — covering checks of the live participant, counterparty vetting, package pinning, contract counts, migration, safe unvetting and continuous integration, delivered in three milestones over about a month and verified on LocalNet, DevNet, TestNet and MainNet; the proposal still needs a champion and is not a funded or released toolkit (GitHub)

Network: CC $0.0824 | Market cap $3.30B (rank 25) | 24h volume $8.31M | Circulating supply 40,085,984,762 CC, up 0.18% in 24 hours and down 7.79% over seven days with a 24-hour range of $0.0811 to $0.0836 at the 17:45 UTC November 19 read; milestone: 24-hour network rewards stand at 11.1M CC on the live MainNet dashboard, with throughput at 1.00 TPS, about 1.6K validators and 13 Super Validators (Criptano, reporting CoinGecko figures, for market data; CantonNews for the milestone)

item.title: Canton's improvement-proposal registry now tallies 103 proposals, with 56 in Final effect and 42 Approved
item.description:
Canton Signal Feed (Nov 19, 2026 · 12:12 PM ET)

- **Canton's improvement-proposal registry now tallies 103 proposals, with 56 in Final effect and 42 Approved** — The Canton Network Docs registry counts 56 Canton Improvement Proposals as Final, meaning approved and adopted on-chain by a two-thirds majority of Super Validator node operators, alongside 42 Approved, 4 still Proposed and 1 Rejected; proposals are discussed on the cip-discuss list, voted on by the Super Validator operators and announced once approved, with the canonical text held in the Canton Foundation's CIP repository (Canton Network Docs)
- **DTCC's tokenization service can natively connect with more than 150 production applications across a network of more than 830 firms** — The Canton Network's "One Giant Leap" account of the October 28 launch says the service's initial pool covers more than $30 trillion in high-quality liquid assets across U.S. Treasuries, equities and ETFs, and that tokenized Treasuries can be pledged and accepted as collateral to meet intraday obligations inside that connected application network (Canton Network)
- **No Canton Coin arbitrage route is worth taking at the latest scan, with spot prices 5.20% apart across liquid exchanges** — The 17:17 UTC November 19 scan finds Canton Coin cheapest on WEEX at $0.07724 and dearest on Bitrue at $0.081255 across 11 exchanges with a liquid spot market, with only caveat-flagged pairs in profit after taker fees and the best futures route, long WhiteBIT perpetuals against short Hyperliquid perpetuals, at 0.19% after fees (ArbitrageGap)
- **Joining Canton MainNet as a validator requires committee approval, an approved address and a sponsor's onboarding secret** — A new Canton-versus-XRP comparison sets out the admission path: a prospective validator needs approval from the network's tokenomics committee, an approved IP address and an onboarding secret issued by the Super Validator sponsoring it, a members-club model the comparison contrasts with open public networks (Phemex)

Network: CC $0.0819 | Market cap $3.28B (rank 25) | 24h volume $8.45M | Circulating supply 40,085,390,057 CC, down 0.31% in 24 hours and 7.06% over seven days with a 24-hour range of $0.0811 to $0.0839 at the 16:07 UTC November 19 read; milestone: four CIPs sit in Proposed status awaiting Super Validator votes, including CIP-0120 on traffic-based validator rewards and CIP-0108 to add Merkle Science's predictive analytics as a weight-1 Super Validator (Kriptometre, reporting CoinGecko data, for market data; Canton Network Docs for the milestone)

item.title: Krasilnikoff Credit & Collateral adds a fifth Canton benchmark, a Burn/Mint Ratio, in methodology version 0.14
item.description:
Canton Signal Feed (Nov 19, 2026 · 11:12 AM ET)

- **Krasilnikoff Credit & Collateral adds a fifth Canton benchmark, a Burn/Mint Ratio, in methodology version 0.14** — The new measurement, effective for the November 13 sheet, compares traffic-related Canton Coin burns with estimated gross issuance over a defined period, joining benchmarks for liquidation capacity, the dollar borrowing rate, the Canton Coin borrow rate and reward coverage; it requires at least 27 valid days in a 30-day window, so its first full 30-day value is still being built and is expected on the November 28 sheet, and its traffic-burn figures come from Canton Scan snapshots while gross mint is inferred from supply changes plus measured burns rather than counted directly (CantonNews)
- **Canton's data-access layer now runs well beyond the ledger itself, with Noves supporting more than 100 participants and CC View logging about 6.05 million requests** — Noves' self-hosted Data App, which lets organisations read only the information their own authorised participants can see, reports support for more than 100 validators, applications and strategic partners, while CC View, PixelPlex's Canton explorer and indexing service covering transfers, parties, prices, rewards and governance, reports about 6.05 million total API requests at a 0.02% historical error rate; both figures are provider-reported rather than independently audited (CantonNews)
- **Bit Dynamics' Canton DevKit campaign offers a 5,000 Canton Coin draw through November 24 for running a complete local network** — The DevKit runs a full local Canton network on a developer's own machine — two validator nodes and a Super Validator, each with its own party, managed from one command-line tool or a local web interface — covering DAR uploads, contract inspection, token flows and portable network snapshots; entering requires the campaign's social tasks, a qualifying DevKit run, which means minting a token on the local network and posting it, triples a participant's entries, and 3,436 participants had joined at the latest read, with the 5,000 CC valued at about $410.40 (CCTools)
- **Canton's Foundation board counts 22 members co-chaired by DTCC and Euroclear, while only 13 Super Validator node operators hold governance votes** — Research drawing on the network's governance record puts the Canton Foundation, a Delaware non-profit that facilitates network governance, under co-chairs from DTCC and Euroclear with a 22-member board including Broadridge, BNY, HSBC, Tradeweb and Digital Asset as of September 30, 2026; the same record counts about 60 Super Validators at that date but only 13 Super Validator node operators, and only the operators vote on network changes, one vote each (Medium)

Network: CC $0.0822 | Market cap $3.30B (rank 25) | 24h volume $8.46M | Circulating supply 40.09B CC, down 0.26% in 24 hours and 6.71% over seven days with a 24-hour range of $0.0805 to $0.0867 at the 16:00 UTC November 19 read; milestone: circulating supply has risen to 40.09 billion CC from 40,085,390,057 CC recorded earlier on November 19, reflecting continued minting rounds under the network's burn-and-mint model (BlocFolio)

item.title: VertexPoint's mobile signing tools enter a 21-day Development Fund vote, seeking 1.25 million Canton Coin plus a security review
item.description:
Canton Signal Feed (Nov 19, 2026 · 9:42 AM ET)

- **VertexPoint's mobile signing tools enter a 21-day Development Fund vote, seeking 1.25 million Canton Coin plus a security review** — The vote covers a mobile signer that would keep signing keys on the user's phone and native Swift and Kotlin software kits for app developers, with the request set at 1.25 million CC plus up to 130,000 CC for a security review, or 1.38 million CC at the cap; voting is open, and this step approves neither the grant nor any launched product (CCTools)
- **ABS seeks 450,000 Canton Coin for dar-vet, a tool that flags who gains or loses permissions when a Daml application is upgraded** — Alternative Bold Solutions' proposal runs over four months and would compare versions of a Daml application package, highlighting changes to who can perform actions; the team says its prototype has already been run on 101 Splice releases, and the request remains submitted and seeking a champion rather than funded (CCTools)
- **The Hub warns that the HUBI token is unaffiliated and that it has issued no token of its own** — The Hub says it has no connection to HUBI, a token using its mascot's name on OneSwap and OnePump, and that a familiar name or mascot does not establish an official relationship; the notice concerns an unaffiliated token, not a reported breach of the platform (CantonNews)
- **Canton applications recorded $6,659 in fees and $5,665 in revenue over the latest 24 hours, alongside $1.73 million in token incentives** — The November 19 protocol read also puts Cantex as the only tracked protocol gaining total value locked over 24 hours, up 2.50% to $1.78 million, while Temple remains the largest tracked protocol at $5.95 million (DefiLlama)

Network: CC $0.0835 | Market cap $3.35B (rank 25) | 24h volume $8.98M | Circulating supply 40,085,390,057 CC, up 0.50% in 24 hours and down 6.66% over seven days at the 14:30 UTC November 19 read; milestone: four tracked Canton spot venues — Temple, Cantex, Rocky and Tradecraft — recorded $137.6 million in volume across November 9–15, with Temple accounting for 91.4% of the total (Criptano, reporting CoinGecko figures, for market data; Canton Venues, via CCTools, for the milestone)

item.title: Supanova introduces V2 with mobile trading and Canton Coin funding routes
item.description:
Canton Signal Feed (Nov 19, 2026 · 8:42 AM ET)
- **Supanova introduces V2 with mobile trading and Canton Coin funding routes** — Supanova's V2, announced November 17, highlights bridging into Canton Coin, trading from a phone and creating tokens through its Canton launchpad; its current guide sets out three funding routes — sending CC from a supported exchange, bringing USDC, USDT or ETH through the Squid route, or sending CC to an account's Party ID — with incoming CC arriving in Funding and needing a move to Trading before purchases, a 25 CC creation fee, a 1% trade fee of which creators receive 80%, and graduation to an open liquidity pool at 250,000 CC raised on the bonding curve (CantonNews)
- **Tokenized stock discussed as instant collateral once DTCC-tokenized shares sit in a wallet** — In a November 19 discussion, Digital Asset's Yuval Rooz set out a forward-looking use case in which holders could pledge DTCC-tokenized shares directly to a DEX lender for stablecoins, with no broker-to-lender handoff; the item describes a discussed use case for tokenized shares, not a launched collateral product (CantonNews)
- **Canton Coin derivatives positioning stays calm, with open interest at $35.64 million and liquidations at $2.25 thousand** — The latest read puts open interest down 0.18% over two days, 24-hour liquidations totalling $2.25K, funding close to zero at -0.0070% per 8 hours, and Binance retail accounts leaning long at 63.6% of positions, indicating no leveraged rally behind the price move (CoinStats)
- **Canton Coin holds slightly positive while Bitcoin and Ethereum fall over the same 24 hours** — Canton Coin finished up 0.17% over 24 hours while Bitcoin fell 2.62% and Ethereum fell 1.61% over the same period; over seven days Canton Coin is down 9.09%, a smaller decline than Bitcoin's 14.79% and Ethereum's 13.27%, in a broader market reading 11 on the Fear and Greed Index, or Extreme Fear (CoinStats)

item.title: Nomura, NRI and BOOSTRY set out a joint plan to connect financial firms to on-chain markets on Canton, with back-office links at its centre
item.description:
Canton Signal Feed (Nov 19, 2026 · 7:12 AM ET)
- **Nomura, NRI and BOOSTRY set out a joint plan to connect financial firms to on-chain markets on Canton, with back-office links at its centre** — The November 16 announcement assigns Nomura Holdings the work of connecting institutions, applications and digital-asset markets, while Nomura Research Institute develops a service that captures blockchain transactions and balances in real time and feeds them into its I-STAR securities back-office systems; BOOSTRY, majority-owned by Nomura, says its institutional wallet initially supporting Canton entered production operation in September and that development is complete on a protocol connecting Canton with its ibet for Fin digital-securities platform, with government bonds, corporate bonds, shares and funds the intended coverage from issuance through settlement and collateral use (CCTools)
- **A paymaster model for dedicated synchronizers opens for a formal vote, alongside new lock-enforcement rules** — CIP-0132, opened for a formal vote on November 16 with Digital Asset as Super Validator sponsor, would let dedicated synchronizers use a paymaster model and covers Universal Burn for those synchronizers in its first phase, without yet enforcing traffic limits; separate November 18 network updates describe CIP-0127 defining how Super Validator and Featured App locks are enforced on the ledger, and Canton version 3.7.3, released November 12, fixes sequencer resource leaks and makes party replication safer (CoinStats)
- **Canton Strategic Holdings reports third-quarter revenue of $3 million, up 104% from the prior quarter** — The November 16 results from the Nasdaq-listed Canton Strategic Holdings put total third-quarter 2026 revenue at $3 million, more than double the previous quarter, as the company builds its position around Canton-based applications and its digital treasury strategy (CoinStats)
- **Alpend introduces Adula as a separate protocol home for ONE, its Canton-based debt asset** — The November 16 introduction gives the ONE debt asset its own dedicated protocol home on Canton, separating it within Alpend's product set as the network's lending and debt offerings continue to specialise (CoinStats)

Network: CC $0.083 | Market cap $3.33B (rank 25) | 24h volume $8.97M | Circulating supply 40,084,061,192 CC, down 0.78% in 24 hours and 8.30% over seven days at the 11:07 UTC November 19 read; milestone: the approved Nomura Group and BOOSTRY shared Super Validator framework under CIP-0130 carries a maximum earnable reward weight of 10 in total, adding a major Japanese financial group to the operators running and governing the Global Synchronizer (Kriptometre, reporting CoinGecko data, for market data; CCTools for the milestone)

item.title: Halborn requests 3.5 million Canton Coin for open tools to check six security properties in Canton applications
item.description:
Canton Signal Feed (Nov 19, 2026 · 5:42 AM ET)

- **Halborn requests 3.5 million Canton Coin for open tools to check six security properties in Canton applications** — The Development Fund proposal would deliver open checking tools supported by at least 30 deliberately flawed test examples to show whether the checks catch the problems they are meant to find, over 12 months with an initial six months of delivery followed by adoption milestones at months eight and twelve; 40 percent of the requested funding is tied to adoption, the proposed tools and runner would be released under Apache 2.0 with Halborn's commercial LIMES product outside the funded scope, and the proposal was seeking a champion at the reporting cutoff (CantonNews)
- **PagFinance seeks a champion for a 6.2 million Canton Coin fiat-connector proposal, with Brazilian reais via PIX as the first proposed corridor** — The request totals 4.5 million CC for engineering, 700,000 CC for an audit and one million CC for an adoption bounty to connect Canton token settlement with bank payment systems; local sandbox tests are described, while migration through DevNet and TestNet to a live MainNet corridor remains work proposed under the grant, and the request is not an approved grant or evidence of an operating Canton-to-PIX service (CantonNews)
- **The REX-Osprey Canton Coin ETF's effective date has moved from November 13 to December 11, 2026, with trading still requiring a separate listing** — The November 19 update records the new December 11 effective date for the fund, a change from the November 13 date covered in earlier editions, and notes that effectiveness alone does not start trading, which still requires a separate exchange listing (CoinStats)
- **Canton Coin is down 8.3% over seven days, outperforming a global crypto market down 12.3% over the same period** — The latest comparison also puts Canton ahead of similar smart contract platform cryptocurrencies, which are down 12.1% over seven days, even as Canton's own price remains 57.30% below its all-time high (CoinGecko)

Network: CC $0.083047 | Market cap $3.32B (rank 25) | 24h volume $8.96M, down 40.70% from one day ago | Circulating supply 40.084B CC at the November 19 read; milestone: a new MainNet allocation notice names Calastone, Sanctum-Digik, Isolate Markets, Huginn, Canborsa, QuickNode, The Hub, Ingenium Labs and Chainalysis-Alchemy as validator allocations, with several names holding multiple allocation rows including a second node for The Hub (CoinGecko for market data; CantonNews for the milestone)

item.title: Canton sets dated MainNet steps for traffic-based app rewards, with a dry run starting December 8 and full effect targeted for early February
item.description:
Canton Signal Feed (Nov 19, 2026 · 5:12 AM ET)

- **Canton sets dated MainNet steps for traffic-based app rewards, with a dry run starting December 8 and full effect targeted for early February** — A November 18 status post sets out the rollout for the amended CIP-0104: Super Validators raise an on-chain proposal on December 1, the vote takes effect and a MainNet dry run begins on December 8, the accountability committee and app providers study the dry-run data through January, and a go-live vote follows in late January or early February, with traffic-based rewards taking full effect in early February if approved; until then the interim marker rules stay in force, including the $0.79 reward cap for every $1.00 of traffic burned, markers set 1:1 with the burn they correspond to and submitted within two reward rounds, and a pause without warning for any app whose ratio exceeds 103% (Canton Network Forum)
- **Canton's live MainNet read shows 1.00 transactions per second and 6.4 million Canton Coin in rewards over 24 hours** — The live dashboard read on November 19 puts 24-hour network rewards at 6.4 million CC, up from the 5.7 million CC live read recorded on November 18, with current activity at 1.00 TPS at the time of the read (CantonNews)
- **Bybit is Canton Coin's largest spot venue at 23.58% of volume, with the Canton-native Temple exchange second at 15.22%** — The latest venue table puts Bybit's CC/USDT pair first at $2.39 million in 24 hours, Temple Digital Group's CC/USDCx pair second at $1.54 million and CoinW third at $1.16 million, and records no Canton Coin liquidations across its 1-hour, 4-hour, 12-hour or 24-hour windows (AMBCrypto)
- **Canton Coin's seven-day trading volume totals $93.94 million as the price eases 7.91% over the week** — The same read puts the price down 19.76% over 30 days and 57.21% below the $0.194152 all-time high set on February 2, 2026 (AMBCrypto)

Network: CC $0.083076 | Market cap $3.33B (rank 25) | 24h volume $10.12M | Circulating supply 40,084,061,192 CC, down 1.64% in 24 hours at the November 19 read; milestone: circulating supply has risen from 40,077,505,741 CC recorded earlier on November 19, reflecting continued minting rounds under the network's burn-and-mint model (AMBCrypto)

item.title: A new Canton Coin explainer sets out the whitepaper minting path: 100 billion coins over ten years, then 2.5 billion a year
item.description:
Canton Signal Feed (Nov 19, 2026 · 4:12 AM ET)

- **A new Canton Coin explainer sets out the whitepaper minting path: 100 billion coins over ten years, then 2.5 billion a year** — The November 19 explainer puts the whitepaper ceiling at 100 billion Canton Coin over the first ten years, split evenly between infrastructure and application providers, then 2.5 billion a year after that, with no hard cap on total supply; in the current phase, running to mid-2029, the annual ceiling is 10 billion with 62 percent for application providers, 18 percent for validators and 20 percent for Super Validators, coins are minted in ten-minute rounds with a development fund taking 5 percent of each round first, and Digital Asset confirmed in its October 2026 letter to the SEC that there was no pre-mine, pre-sale or allocation to founders, venture investors or the Foundation (Medium)
- **DTCC's tokenization service opened commercially with 25 securities drawn from Russell 1000 stocks, major ETFs and Treasuries** — The October 28 commercial launch started with that defined set of 25 securities, according to a DTCC fact sheet, and the service runs on Canton and on DTCC's own private Besu network; DTCC had already processed real production trades using DTC-tokenized Treasuries and equities on Canton in July 2026, ahead of the commercial launch (iTrusty)
- **Canton traffic credits are bought by burning Canton Coin, repriced every ten minutes and cannot be transferred or converted back** — Beyond a small free allowance that regenerates, validators buy traffic by burning Canton Coin at a dollar-per-megabyte price converted to coins every ten minutes from the median of Super Validator submissions; the credits cannot be transferred or converted back, a third party can fund a participant's traffic balance, and unlike Canton's private application data, Canton Coin balances and transfers are publicly visible through the network's scan service (Medium)
- **Canton Coin sits between Litecoin and Uniswap in market value, needing about 4.4% growth to pass the coin above it** — At the latest read Canton ranks 25th with a $3.33 billion market capitalisation, about 0.15% of the $2.20 trillion total crypto market, sitting below Litecoin at $3.48 billion and above Uniswap at $3.17 billion, with 24-hour volume of $10.6 million equal to 0.32% of its market cap, well below the 2.59% typical turnover for the top 100 coins (Blockdeck)

Network: CC $0.0831 | Market cap $3.33B (rank 25) | 24h volume $10.6M | Circulating supply 40.08B CC, down 1.60% in 24 hours and 8.70% over seven days with a 24-hour range of $0.0811 to $0.0847 at the November 19 read; milestone: DTCC processed real production trades using DTC-tokenized U.S. Treasuries and equities on Canton in July 2026, ahead of the tokenization service's October 28 commercial launch (Blockdeck for market data; iTrusty for the milestone)

item.title: CapConnect+ is approved as a Canton Super Validator with a maximum reward weight of 5
item.description:
Canton Signal Feed (Nov 19, 2026 · 3:12 AM ET)

- **CapConnect+ is approved as a Canton Super Validator with a maximum reward weight of 5** — Super Validator operators have approved CapConnect+ as a new Super Validator on the network, adding another operator to the group that runs and governs the Global Synchronizer; the approval gives the firm a maximum earnable reward weight of 5, and it resolves the vote that had been open since November 10 (CC Space)
- **DTCC's tokenization totals will reach the public only through private quarterly reports to the SEC, with the first due around mid-January 2027** — Under the December 2025 no-action letter, DTC sends SEC staff a quarterly report covering the total value tokenized and outstanding for the fourth quarter of 2026, and those reports are not published; the $30 trillion figure is the market value of eligible securities, not an amount already converted, and Canton's privacy means its token supply cannot be measured on-chain the way public-chain products are (RWAWeekly)
- **Canton's all-time transaction count reaches 606.66 million as parties pass 953,000** — The November 19 read puts total transactions at 606.66 million, up from 606.4 million recorded on November 18, with total parties at 953,065, validators at 1,572 across 13 Super Validators and 147 Featured Apps built on the network (CCTools)

Network: CC $0.081971 | Market cap $3.3B (rank 25) | 24h volume $12.6M | Circulating supply 40,077,505,741 CC, down 0.1% in 24 hours with a 24-hour range of $0.081078 to $0.085597 as of November 19; milestone: Canton governance now counts 632 proposals with a 93% approval rate — 576 executed and 45 rejected, with 1 still in progress (Crypheat for market data; CCTools for the milestone)

item.title: Talos, Marex and Broadridge are building a single workflow for trading, prime brokerage and atomic settlement on Canton
item.description:
Canton Signal Feed (Nov 19, 2026 · 2:42 AM ET)

- **Talos, Marex and Broadridge are building a single workflow for trading, prime brokerage and atomic settlement on Canton** — The three firms are combining their platforms into one workflow so institutions can finance tokenized Treasuries and move collateral after hours, a concrete step toward onchain capital markets on the network rather than separate trading, financing and settlement systems; the work builds on the DTCC-tokenized securities now available on Canton (CantonNews)
- **Canton settled 4,869,283 transactions last week, averaging nearly 700,000 a day** — November 11 was the busiest day in the week at 752,000 transactions, and each transaction settled atomically, with each party seeing only the parts of it they were entitled to see (CantonNews)
- **PartyLayer passes 200,000 cumulative downloads as its Canton developer toolkit expands** — The open-source wallet-integration toolkit from Cayvox Labs also reports nearly 100,000 unique visitors and more than 2 million web requests over the past 30 days; current releases are SDK 0.22.1, React 3.4.0 and React Native 2.0.0, and its November 15 corrective release passed 2,277 workspace tests and 210 browser interface tests across Chromium, Firefox and WebKit (CCTools)
- **Canton's nominal daily reward split sends 58.9% of new issuance to application builders** — The current distribution allocates 16.1 million Canton Coin a day to app builders, 5.2 million to Super Validators at 19%, 4.7 million to validators at 17.1% and 1.4 million to the Development Fund at 5%, tying the largest share of rewards to the applications that generate network activity (CCTools)

Network: CC $0.0831 | Market cap $3.33B | 24h volume $12.00M | Circulating supply 40.08B CC, down 1.80% in 24 hours at the 07:52 UTC November 19 read; milestone: Canton Coin burned equalled 58.9% of issuance over the last seven days — 110.0 million CC burned against 186.6 million CC of issuance from November 12 to 18 — with 448.0 million CC burned over the last 30 days (CCTools)

item.title: The IMF's October stability report puts intraday repo and legal certainty at the centre of tokenization's next phase, with Canton's repo scale as its evidence
item.description:
Canton Signal Feed (Nov 19, 2026 · 1:42 AM ET)

- **The IMF's October stability report puts intraday repo and legal certainty at the centre of tokenization's next phase, with Canton's repo scale as its evidence** — The International Monetary Fund's Global Financial Stability Report chapter "Scaling Tokenization: New Efficiencies, New Vulnerabilities" says growth depends on legal certainty, regulatory clarity, interoperability and safe settlement assets under technology-neutral rules, and highlights intraday repo as a priority use case, evidenced by the $350 billion-plus a day in tokenized repo facilitated by Broadridge's Distributed Ledger Repo on Canton; Digital Asset's response argues the report underplays privacy — mentioned only twice in nearly thirty pages — and that central banks and clearing houses still need to clarify when tokenized assets count as eligible collateral (Digital Asset)
- **DTCC plans to expand its Canton tokenization service toward nearly all of the $114 trillion in assets it manages** — The service launched on October 28 with an initial pool of more than $30 trillion in Treasuries, equities and ETFs, and the planned expansion would put more equities and corporate, municipal and agency bonds into play on-chain; production use has already begun, with trades highlighted by Morgan Stanley, Tradeweb, Temple, Talos and Broadridge using the tokenized assets to finance balance sheets, hedge and margin (Canton Network)
- **Institutions sit on about $25 billion of excess or unremunerated collateral overnight, ValueExchange research finds** — The average financial institution pledges and manages up to $74 billion in collateral, yet about a quarter of it is excess or earns nothing overnight and 7% of firms post excess collateral purely for buffering; moving collateral atomically against cash, in minutes and at any hour, is the efficiency case behind the collateral-mobility flows now running on Canton (ValueExchange research, via Digital Asset)
- **No Canton Coin arbitrage route is worth taking at the latest scan, with spot prices 7.04% apart across exchanges** — At the 05:07 UTC November 19 read the cheapest spot price was WEEX at $0.078025 and the dearest Bitstamp at $0.083521 across 13 exchanges with a liquid spot market, only caveated pairs showed profit after taker fees, and the best futures route — long WhiteBIT, short Lighter — returned just 0.09% after fees (ArbitrageGap)

Network: CC $0.0829 | Market cap $3.32B (rank 25) | 24h volume $12.07M | Circulating supply 40.08B CC, down 1.82% in 24 hours with a 24-hour range of $0.0805 to $0.0867 at the 07:00 UTC November 19 read; milestone: Canton currently handles about 600 million annualized transactions, roughly 1.7 million a day, including $9 trillion of tokenized real-world assets processed monthly (BlocFolio for market data; Canton Network for the milestone)

- **DTCC plans to expand its Canton tokenization service toward nearly all of the $114 trillion in assets it manages** — The service launched on October 28 with an initial pool of more than $30 trillion in Treasuries, equities and ETFs, and the planned expansion would put more equities and corporate, municipal and agency bonds into play on-chain; production use has already begun, with trades highlighted by Morgan Stanley, Tradeweb, Temple, Talos and Broadridge using the tokenized assets to finance balance sheets, hedge and margin (Canton Network)
- **Institutions sit on about $25 billion of excess or unremunerated collateral overnight, ValueExchange research finds** — The average financial institution pledges and manages up to $74 billion in collateral, yet about a quarter of it is excess or earns nothing overnight and 7% of firms post excess collateral purely for buffering; moving collateral atomically against cash, in minutes and at any hour, is the efficiency case behind the collateral-mobility flows now running on Canton (ValueExchange research, via Digital Asset)
- **No Canton Coin arbitrage route is worth taking at the latest scan, with spot prices 7.04% apart across exchanges** — At the 05:07 UTC November 19 read the cheapest spot price was WEEX at $0.078025 and the dearest Bitstamp at $0.083521 across 13 exchanges with a liquid spot market, only caveated pairs showed profit after taker fees, and the best futures route — long WhiteBIT, short Lighter — returned just 0.09% after fees (ArbitrageGap)

item.title: Tenderly revises its Canton transaction-testing proposal to $421,520.63 over 24 months, with no funding award yet
item.description:
Canton Signal Feed (Nov 19, 2026 · 12:42 AM ET)

- **Tenderly revises its Canton transaction-testing proposal to $421,520.63 over 24 months, with no funding award yet** — The revised request sets $281,013.75 for development and adoption followed by $140,506.88 for maintenance, equivalent to 4,370,354 Canton Coin at an October 30 reference rate but denominated in dollars; it would let developers test transactions against controlled copies of the ledger data they are authorised to access, inspect failures and run checks before releasing software, in hosted and self-hosted forms, and the proposal remains under review (CCTools)
- **Canton's wallet toolkit ships new releases adding role-based access tokens and Token Standard V2 transfer tools** — Wallet Gateway 1.14.0 adds support for role-based access tokens, clearer reasons when a signing provider rejects a request and confirmation before an API key is revoked, while Wallet SDK 1.7.0 adds tools for transfers and allocations under Token Standard V2, which reserve assets for a later settlement, and the companion dApp SDK 1.10.0 passes signing-rejection reasons back to applications; these are released developer tools that individual wallets still need to adopt (CCTools)
- **Canton DeFi holds at $11.32 million in total value locked as weekly DEX volume eases 8.07%** — The November 19 snapshot puts total value locked at $11.32 million, down 1.76% in 24 hours, with decentralised exchange volume at $16.41 million in 24 hours and $126.63 million over seven days, perpetuals volume at $234,140 in 24 hours and Temple the largest tracked protocol at $5.98 million (DefiLlama)
- **Today's listed Canton Coin unlock releases 21,191,792 coins, about 0.05% of circulating supply** — The November 19 unlock, rated low impact and valued at about $1.76 million at the price when read, is larger than the 19,329,747 coins listed for November 17 and the 19,821,185 listed for November 16, continuing the schedule's regular small releases rather than a single cliff (World-Crypt)

item.title: CIP-0129's Universal Burn first phase targets the first quarter of 2027, routing dedicated-synchronizer traffic into Canton Coin's burn economy
item.description:
Canton Signal Feed (Nov 18, 2026 · 11:42 PM ET)

- **CIP-0129's Universal Burn first phase targets the first quarter of 2027, routing dedicated-synchronizer traffic into Canton Coin's burn economy** — The framework, approved on October 23, 2026, would connect eligible production traffic on dedicated synchronizers to the network's burn-and-reward system for the first time, with volume-based fee pricing targeted for the third quarter of 2027; both dates are described as ambitious rather than firm, and the token impact depends on real traffic qualifying, not on the approval alone (CoinMarketCap)
- **Cashen holds more than 500 million Canton Coin in live locking deals, about 1.26% of circulating supply** — The bilateral marketplace, live since June and backed by DRW Labs, passed the mark in mid-October with more than 75 institutions onboarded and suppliers earning an average 5.07% APR; demand comes from governance rules requiring non-issuer Featured Apps to keep 5 million Canton Coin locked per party and asset issuers 25 million, while Super Validators tie their weight to locking 70% of lifetime rewards (CantonNews)
- **Kiln runs live two-of-three co-validation on Canton MainNet, layering redundant validator infrastructure for institutions that cannot tolerate downtime** — The setup, among the first production deployments of the co-validation capability Digital Asset contributed to Canton, splits validation across three operators so a single failure does not halt a participant's node; Ledger is among the ecosystem participants already using the pattern, and Kiln itself operates as a Canton Super Validator offering white-labelled validator infrastructure (Kiln)
- **Japan's Financial Services Agency puts on-chain finance at the centre of its 2026 strategic priorities, with a Canton government-bond repo test inside its regulatory sandbox** — The September 15 policy announcement covers payments, securities settlement, tokenised assets and cross-border transfers; four Mitsubishi UFJ Financial Group entities have been testing Japanese government bond repos on Canton with Digital Asset and Progmat since August, targeting 24-hour settlement, and the proof of concept was selected for the agency's Payment Innovation Project (CantonNews)

item.title: Marex is approved as a Canton Super Validator with a maximum weight of 10, running through the MPC-Holding-Inc node
item.description:
Canton Signal Feed (Nov 18, 2026 · 11:12 PM ET)

- **Marex is approved as a Canton Super Validator with a maximum weight of 10, running through the MPC-Holding-Inc node** — The global financial services platform, active in execution, clearing, financing and prime services, adds commodities and clearing market expertise to the group of operators running Canton's Global Synchronizer, and the on-chain vote to grant that weight has been opened (CC Space)
- **Canton ecosystem funding totals $415 million across three recorded rounds, led by the $355 million raise in June 2026** — That round drew a16z crypto, Citadel Securities, Apollo Funds, BNP Paribas, Broadridge, CME Ventures, Coinbase Ventures, HSBC, S&P Global, SBI Group and Tradeweb Markets, alongside a $50 million strategic round in December 2025 backed by BNY Mellon, Nasdaq Ventures, iCapital and S&P Global and a $10 million round in July 2026 from Shinhan Venture Capital and SC Ventures (DefiLlama)
- **Canton's third-quarter developer recap shows Dev Fund-backed builder tools now shipping, including a DAR cross-package analyzer and a Hardhat-style deployment tool** — The Canton Foundation's Q3 DevRel recap highlights daml-analyzer, built by Certora to analyse Daml application packages, and canton-deploy, built by LYNC as a deployment tool in the style of Ethereum's Hardhat, as part of the tooling the Development Fund has backed into production for teams building on Canton (CC Space)
- **Canton network traffic is priced at $60 per megabyte, and validators recover at most 20 cents of Canton Coin for every dollar of traffic they burn** — Synchronizer traffic fees are quoted in dollars but settled in Canton Coin, and the minting cap means validator rewards offset only a fraction of infrastructure spend rather than refunding it, so traffic belongs in the cost column for institutions modelling Canton operations, with rewards booked as partial recovery (Catalyx)
