item.title: Zenith joins DTCC's tokenization working group alongside more than 100 firms to help design the service Canton now runs
item.description:
Canton Signal Feed (Nov 18, 2026 · 9:42 PM ET)

- **Zenith joins DTCC's tokenization working group alongside more than 100 firms to help design the service Canton now runs** — Zenith has joined DTCC's Digital Assets Solutions Industry Working Group alongside more than 100 firms including BlackRock, JPMorgan, Goldman Sachs, Citi, Nasdaq and NYSE, helping design and test DTCC's tokenization service for U.S. equities, ETFs and Treasuries ahead of its October 2026 launch on Canton (CC Space)
- **Meridiant and Rocky Wallet are approved as Featured Apps, with Tradecraft recognised for delivery-versus-payment settlement** — The Tokenomics Committee approved Meridiant, from Catalyst Labs, and Rocky Wallet, from Dune Labs, for Featured App status, meaning their activity can earn elevated app rewards once Super Validators confirm it on-chain, and granted DvP recognition to Tradecraft's C8 Wallet and RFQ DEX; approval is not an endorsement, and approved apps must stay within the Foundation's guidelines (CC Space)
- **Canton's Global Synchronizer coordinates transactions without either of its core components being able to read them** — Research on the DTCC launch explains that a sequencer orders encrypted messages while a mediator collects confirmations and declares each transaction committed or rejected, and crucially neither component can read the transaction content — the synchronizer handles ciphertext and confirmation results only, which is the mechanism that lets independent applications coordinate on Canton without exposing their terms (Medium)
- **Canton Coin perpetual open interest edges up to 316 million coins as funding stays balanced** — Open interest stands at 316 million CC, about $25.81 million, up from 314 million CC and about $25.55 million recorded earlier today, with an average funding rate of 0.0018% across eight exchanges suggesting balanced positioning between longs and shorts and no clear overheating on either side (JustScreener)

item.title: DTCC's Canton tokenization pilot runs under an SEC no-action letter that keeps tokenized entitlements outside DTC's collateral calculations
item.description:
Canton Signal Feed (Nov 18, 2026 · 9:12 PM ET)

- **DTCC's Canton tokenization pilot runs under an SEC no-action letter that keeps tokenized entitlements outside DTC's collateral calculations** — The staff relief, dated December 11, 2025, lets DTC participants record security entitlements on distributed ledger technology as Tokenized Entitlements covering Russell 1000 stocks, major-index ETFs and Treasuries, with the tokens keeping the same ownership rights and investor protections as the underlying securities but carrying no collateral or settlement value for DTC's Net Debit Cap or Collateral Monitor; the relief is withdrawn three years from the date DTC launched the service, 24X Exchange has filed rules referencing the pilot, and the service itself went live on October 28, 2026 on Canton and DTCC's private Besu network with 34 eligible securities representing about $30 trillion and 20 participants signed at launch (EDS Tokenized Securities Rails)
- **Goldman Sachs, Hong Kong FMI Services and Moody's Ratings sit on the Global Synchronizer Foundation, taking its membership past 30 participants** — The three joined the Foundation that governs the Global Synchronizer alongside participants including Broadridge, Tradeweb and Digital Asset, with the Linux Foundation supporting the Foundation under an open governance model; Goldman Sachs digital assets head Mathew McDermott tied the seat to the bank's work on blockchain innovation in regulated markets, Moody's Ratings digital economy head Fabian Astic tied it to helping market participants assess digital finance risks and opportunities, and Foundation chair Jorgen Ouaknine of Euroclear chairs the body (Mondo Visione)
- **Canton Foundation's Daml 3 developer certification is live, with free self-paced courses and a $150 exam** — The programme, launched November 10, certifies practical mastery of Daml 3 and Canton 3.x, testing whether developers can apply Canton's authorisation and privacy principles — controlling who may act on a contract and who may see its terms — in production applications for regulated markets; existing Daml 2 developers can migrate their skills and codebases to the current stack, and Foundation chief operating officer Amanda Martin said the standard is meant to give financial institutions confidence that the applications they rely on are built by developers who understand regulated-market requirements (MarsBit)
- **Ledger data shows the biggest Canton names barely bought network traffic in the month around the DTCC go-live, a CCTools analysis finds** — Reading Canton Scan traffic purchases from October 6 to November 7, the analysis finds a DTCC node bought traffic once, on October 26, paying 787,155 Canton Coin (about $79,000, roughly 5% of that day's burn), while HSBC, Franklin Templeton, Tradeweb, Goldman Sachs and Broadridge nodes bought no traffic at all in the window; network-wide burning held at about 15 million Canton Coin a day after the go-live, four nodes — Temple, Kora, Cantor8 and Obsidian — account for 87.5% of all traffic burn, and minting of about 21.9 million Canton Coin a day against about 15.2 million burned left net new supply of about 6.7 million a day, a gap the analysis says regular institutional traffic purchases or a daily burn that catches up with minting would need to close (CCTools)

item.title: DFNS adds Canton Token Standard V2 allocations support, letting institutions lock the Canton leg of a trade until settlement
item.description:
Canton Signal Feed (Nov 18, 2026 · 8:42 PM ET)

- **DFNS adds Canton Token Standard V2 allocations support, letting institutions lock the Canton leg of a trade until settlement** — DFNS announced allocations support for CIP-112, the V2 evolution of the Canton Network Token Standard, adding committed allocations that lock the Canton leg of a trade until an agreed settlement deadline so the other leg can be coordinated with certainty, alongside pre-approvals so incoming deliveries settle without manual acceptance and delivery-versus-payment allocations that settle securities and cash together; DFNS is also an official signing provider for CIP-103 compliant applications through the Canton Wallet Gateway and operates validators on MainNet, TestNet and DevNet (DFNS)
- **Uber's Canton treasury pilot shows a non-financial company settling tokenized cash against a tokenized fund, including over a weekend** — In the October 30 pilot led by HSBC with Franklin Templeton, Tradeweb and Fireblocks, Uber used HSBC Tokenized Deposits to buy Franklin Templeton tokenized money market fund shares on Tradeweb through delivery-versus-payment transactions on Canton via Fireblocks, then liquidated part of the holding over a weekend while continuing to earn yield throughout the investment lifecycle, capturing about a day and a half of yield that traditional market hours would have left unavailable (Canton Network)
- **New Canton research finds network voting concentrated in 13 Super Validator node operators despite about 60 Super Validators** — The analysis, shared for consideration under the Canton Foundation's Community Research Grants programme with data as of September 30, 2026, finds that only the 13 Super Validator node operators vote on network changes, by two-thirds majority, with Digital Asset operating two of the 13 nodes, and puts the Canton Foundation's published Super Validator weight at 404.45 units in total (Medium)

Network: CC $0.082583 | Market cap $3.31B | 24h volume $13.13M | Circulating supply 40,072,723,000 CC, up 2.53% in 24 hours at the latest read; milestone: more than 150 applications are live or emerging on Canton and Digital Asset works with more than 700 ecosystem participants (3Commas, reporting CoinGecko figures, for market data; DFNS for the milestone)
item.content:encoded:
Canton Signal Feed (Nov 18, 2026 · 8:42 PM ET)

- **DFNS adds Canton Token Standard V2 allocations support, letting institutions lock the Canton leg of a trade until settlement** — DFNS announced allocations support for CIP-112, the V2 evolution of the Canton Network Token Standard, adding committed allocations that lock the Canton leg of a trade until an agreed settlement deadline so the other leg can be coordinated with certainty, alongside pre-approvals so incoming deliveries settle without manual acceptance and delivery-versus-payment allocations that settle securities and cash together; DFNS is also an official signing provider for CIP-103 compliant applications through the Canton Wallet Gateway and operates validators on MainNet, TestNet and DevNet (DFNS)
- **Uber's Canton treasury pilot shows a non-financial company settling tokenized cash against a tokenized fund, including over a weekend** — In the October 30 pilot led by HSBC with Franklin Templeton, Tradeweb and Fireblocks, Uber used HSBC Tokenized Deposits to buy Franklin Templeton tokenized money market fund shares on Tradeweb through delivery-versus-payment transactions on Canton via Fireblocks, then liquidated part of the holding over a weekend while continuing to earn yield throughout the investment lifecycle, capturing about a day and a half of yield that traditional market hours would have left unavailable (Canton Network)
- **New Canton research finds network voting concentrated in 13 Super Validator node operators despite about 60 Super Validators** — The analysis, shared for consideration under the Canton Foundation's Community Research Grants programme with data as of September 30, 2026, finds that only the 13 Super Validator node operators vote on network changes, by two-thirds majority, with Digital Asset operating two of the 13 nodes, and puts the Canton Foundation's published Super Validator weight at 404.45 units in total (Medium)

item.title: Canton Dev Fund votes are failing from absent voters, not rejections, a community analysis finds
item.description:
Canton Signal Feed (Nov 18, 2026 · 8:12 PM ET)

- **Canton Dev Fund votes are failing from absent voters, not rejections, a community analysis finds** — The analysis of the Dev Fund repository finds seven funding votes failed with almost no votes against: they simply expired after 21 days because the 51%-of-eligible-voters threshold was never met, and four were reopened within days; it also warns that repository labels undercount failures because reopening a vote resets them (CC Space)
- **Canton Coin perpetual open interest eases to 314 million CC as shorts keep paying longs** — Open interest stands at 314 million CC, about $25.55 million, down from 323 million CC and $27.22 million recorded earlier today, with 24-hour turnover at $20.73 million and an average funding rate of -0.0083% across eight exchanges, meaning shorts are paying longs in a sign of bearish positioning (JustScreener)
- **Under CIP-0096, Canton earning now runs through apps and traffic, not validator liveness** — Validator liveness rewards were set to zero on April 30, 2026 under CIP-0096; applications now earn about 62% of the reward pool, Super Validators about 20% on a share decreasing until mid-2029, and regular users earn through app rewards and activity incentives funded by traffic purchases, which burn Canton Coin (Canton Wiki)
- **No Canton Coin arbitrage route is worth taking at the latest read, with only suspect pairs in profit after fees** — At the 01:02 UTC November 19 read the widest spot gap was buy on MEXC, sell on LBank at +5.27% after fees and flagged suspect, spot prices ran 5.63% apart across 13 liquid exchanges from MEXC at $0.077962 to Bitrue at $0.082355, and the best futures route was WhiteBIT long against Hyperliquid short at 0.23% (ArbitrageGap)

item.title: Canton issues Java4Shell mitigation guidance for node operators, recommending they disable Java's Base64 intrinsic
item.description:
Canton Signal Feed (Nov 18, 2026 · 7:42 PM ET)
- **Canton issues Java4Shell mitigation guidance for node operators, recommending they disable Java's Base64 intrinsic** — The November 18 advisory recommends running the Java runtime with -XX:-UseBASE64Intrinsics until patches are deployed, after verification found no adverse performance impact on Canton; CERT-EU identifies the issue as CVE-2026-114938 with a severity score of 8.1, where malformed input can cause memory corruption, service disruption or remote code execution on affected x86-64 systems, with ARM64 unaffected, and Canton stresses the notice is an operator advisory and does not report a network breach, with separate Docker and Kubernetes instructions covering validator and participant nodes and related services such as Keycloak (CantonNews)
- **Canton 3.7.4 maintenance release appears on November 18 with performance and correctness changes** — The release, noted alongside the Java4Shell guidance on November 18, is described as carrying performance and correctness changes, and should not be treated as confirmation that every bundled Java runtime has been remediated, so operators still need to check the Java distribution inside their actual deployment, including container images (CantonNews)
- **Five North splits into two brands, keeping the fund and Super Validator operations while its products move to Loop** — Under the split, Cantonloop becomes Loop Wallet, the Lighthouse explorer becomes Loop Data, and the Loop SDK serves teams integrating Canton; users' wallets and balances are unchanged and moving to the new domains is optional (CC Space)
- **Canton DeFi locked value eases to $11.27 million as 24-hour DEX volume falls to $16.52 million** — DefiLlama's November 18 snapshot puts total value locked at $11.27 million, down 2.05% in 24 hours from $11.33 million recorded earlier today, with DEX volume at $16.52 million in 24 hours and $130.84 million over seven days, perps volume at $233,007, and Temple still largest at $5.94 million ahead of Alpend at $1.97 million and Cantex at $1.76 million across eight tracked protocols (DefiLlama)

item.title: Draft CIP-0128 would let validators join Canton without whitelisting, gated by a traffic purchase
item.description:
Canton Signal Feed (Nov 18, 2026 · 7:12 PM ET)
- **Draft CIP-0128 would let validators join Canton without whitelisting, gated by a traffic purchase** — The draft proposal, "Remove IP Whitelists from the Global Synchronizer," created on October 5, 2026 and still in Draft status and not approved, would replace the Canton Foundation-run IP allowlists and onboarding secrets for the Scan and sequencer APIs with automatic access once a minimum amount of traffic has been bought in Canton Coin — a starting threshold of 10MB, about $600 at the current MainNet rate, with the amount set by an on-ledger governance vote; Super Validators would grant permission once a BFT quorum is reached and could suspend or revoke access through a new ValidatorBlocklist contract, and the draft lists audits and hardening of the APIs, consistent rate limiting and a DevNet testing period as prerequisites before TestNet and MainNet (CantonCap)
- **Nasdaq and Send are awarded new MainNet validator node allocations on Canton** — The Canton Foundation Tokenomics Working Group has granted new MainNet validator node allocations, including one to Nasdaq, Inc. and three to Send; allocations are issued in line with current network capacity and health assessments, and show continued institutional uptake of running Canton infrastructure (Global Synchronizer Foundation via CC Space)
- **Paxos is approved to join Canton as a Super Validator, tied to stablecoin treasury workflows** — Paxos, the regulated stablecoin issuer behind USDP and other major stablecoins, has been approved to join the Canton Network as a Super Validator, tying its participation to bringing stablecoin treasury-management workflows onto Canton (Global Synchronizer Foundation via CC Space)
- **Ankr proposes to join Canton as a Super Validator with a milestone-based weight of up to 6** — A draft CIP from the node infrastructure provider would earn weight in four stages, from running nodes to an "Ankr Forge" rewards campaign and white-label RPC support; the proposal has not been voted on (CantonCap)

item.title: Valour's Canton Network ETP is trading on Sweden's Spotlight Stock Market, giving brokerage accounts regulated exposure to Canton Coin
item.description:
Canton Signal Feed (Nov 18, 2026 · 6:42 PM ET)
- **Valour's Canton Network ETP is trading on Sweden's Spotlight Stock Market, giving brokerage accounts regulated exposure to Canton Coin** — The Valour Canton Network (CC) SEK exchange-traded product, trading symbol CC SEK and ISIN CH1108682662, began trading on November 5, 2026 as one of eight new SEK-denominated ETPs from DeFi Technologies subsidiary Valour; each product carries a 1.9% management fee and tracks its underlying asset through traditional brokerage infrastructure, and the launch takes Valour's platform past 100 digital asset ETPs (PR Newswire)
- **Circle holds about 380 million Canton Coin worth about $47.99 million in its disclosed digital asset portfolio** — Circle's latest disclosed financial report shows total digital assets of about $133 million at fair value as of September 30, with the Canton Coin position the largest single holding, ahead of about $45.88 million in HYPE, about $6.39 million in Bitcoin and smaller positions in SUI and Ether; the holdings were not in Circle's previously released third-quarter earnings press release (BlockBeats)
- **Canton Coin's spot spread across exchanges widened to 5.62%, with no arbitrage route worth taking** — At the 23:44 UTC November 18 read the cheapest liquid spot price was on WEEX at $0.077755 and the dearest on Bitrue at $0.082125 across 12 exchanges, the widest net route was MEXC to OKX at +4.99% after fees and flagged suspect, and the best futures route was WhiteBIT long against Lighter short at 0.22%; the spread is up from 4.83% earlier today (ArbitrageGap)

item.title: London Stock Exchange Group is approved as a Canton Super Validator under CIP-0124, with a maximum weight of 10
item.description:
Canton Signal Feed (Nov 18, 2026 · 6:12 PM ET)

- **London Stock Exchange Group is approved as a Canton Super Validator under CIP-0124, with a maximum weight of 10** — The approval brings major financial market infrastructure expertise to the network's operator set, and Super Validators are voting to put the weight in place, with the change taking effect on October 10, 2026 (Global Synchronizer Foundation via CC Space)
- **A planned tokenized securities venue relies on the same SEC Innovation Exemption that produced the first live trades on Canton** — Formation Securities has notified the SEC of a tokenized securities venue on Solana with trading expected in early 2027, opening with Galaxy Digital, Exodus Movement and Forward Industries and relying on the exemption that produced the first live trades on the Canton Network, with distribution through broker-dealer Alpaca and custodians Anchorage, BitGo and Fireblocks (Suit Up)
- **The Tie closes its Canton privacy series by arguing regulators are converging on selective disclosure** — The final part of the five-part series compares Canton's selective-disclosure privacy model, where each participant sees only the transaction views it is entitled to, with privacy coins, zero-knowledge designs and app- or wallet-level privacy add-ons, and argues selective disclosure is the model regulators are converging on (Canton Network via CC Space)

item.title: a16z crypto is cleared to join Canton as a Super Validator, with its weight assigned to the MPC-Holding-Inc node
item.description:
Canton Signal Feed (Nov 18, 2026 · 5:42 PM ET)
- **a16z crypto is cleared to join Canton as a Super Validator, with its weight assigned to the MPC-Holding-Inc node** — Super Validators approved adding a16z crypto's Super Validator weight to the MPC-Holding-Inc node following CIP-0123, giving the venture firm the go-ahead to operate as a Super Validator on Canton; the approval follows its earlier clearance to run a Super Validator with a maximum earnable weight of 10, bringing a major crypto investor into the group of operators running the Global Synchronizer (Global Synchronizer Foundation via CC Space)
- **Kaiko joins the Canton Foundation's tokenized collateral workstream, bringing licensed pricing feeds to onchain settlement** — The market data provider has joined the Foundation's Collateral Sub-Committee, bringing licensed pricing feeds including Bloomberg evaluated pricing and NCFX FX benchmarks onto Canton and connectivity from FIX, SWIFT/ISO 20022 and APIs to onchain settlement; trusted pricing is described as the missing piece for central counterparties and market infrastructures to accept tokenized assets as collateral and margin (Canton Network Forum via CC Space)
- **DRW and Marex execute the first OTC derivative referencing a fully tokenized index on Canton** — In October 2026 the two trading firms executed a total return swap on S&P Dow Jones Indices' iBoxx investment-grade benchmark, which data firm Kaiko tokenized on Canton; the trade ran on Derivnex, an institutional derivatives platform built on Canton, and was billed as the first over-the-counter derivative of its kind referencing a fully tokenized index (CVJ.AI)
- **Pinnaccle is approved as a Featured App on Canton, with on-chain Super Validator confirmation still to come** — The Canton Foundation's Tokenomics Committee approved Pinnaccle for Featured App status, which still needs on-chain approval by the Super Validators, and announced that version 2.0b of the Featured App Guidance starts applying on November 5, 2026; Featured App status lets an application earn boosted Canton Coin rewards for the activity it drives (Global Synchronizer Foundation via CC Space)

item.title: Broadridge's repo product built on Canton moves $300 billion to $400 billion of value daily, Yuval Rooz tells a KBW audience
item.description:
Canton Signal Feed (Nov 18, 2026 · 5:12 PM ET)
- **Broadridge's repo product built on Canton moves $300 billion to $400 billion of value daily, Yuval Rooz tells a KBW audience** — Discussing the roughly $15 trillion notional a day repo market, Digital Asset chief executive Yuval Rooz said Broadridge, whose clients include some of the biggest banks in the world, built its repo product on Canton and now moves $300 billion to $400 billion of value daily through it; the remarks were made at KBW and reported in conversation with Bitcoin News, putting a current daily figure on the largest known production repo workload on the network (CantonNews)
- **OnePump is now live on Canton, paying memecoin creators monthly rewards only after their tokens stay active** — The launchpad built by the OneSwap team and approved by the Canton Foundation is built around Canton's Featured Asset model: creators of tokens that reach 1 million CC in trading volume and more than 1,000 holders can earn monthly rewards from the network rather than from the launchpad; tokens graduate to a OneSwap pool at 250,000 CC with liquidity locked, and JOSE, one of the first tokens to graduate, reached 8.4 million CC in volume and 615 holders in its first four days (BSCN)
- **Canton's governance guide sets out a CIP process with more than 117 proposals approved and no single-entity veto** — Every protocol, tokenomics and governance change goes through the Canton Improvement Proposal process: anyone can author a proposal, Standards Track items require three months of discussion, a formal vote needs sponsorship from two Super Validators, all 55 Super Validators vote over 10 days, approval requires a two-thirds supermajority, and a proposal reaches Final status only after two-thirds have implemented it on-chain through DevNet, TestNet and MainNet (CantonNews)
- **Silvana's private orderbook on Canton keeps orders off public view and assets in the user's wallet until DvP settlement** — Silvana Book, already live on Canton, matches orders privately before final delivery-versus-payment settlement on the network, so assets are not placed into escrow during matching and only move when the trade completes; its V2 release adds a redesigned Trading Terminal, support for Lattice Wallet, private RFQ trading, grid strategies and agent tools that act only within user-set permissions and signing controls (Canton Army)

item.title: CIP-0104 stands Approved in the Canton Foundation registry, tying app rewards to measured traffic instead of code markers
item.description:
Canton Signal Feed (Nov 18, 2026 · 4:42 PM ET)
- **CIP-0104 stands Approved in the Canton Foundation registry, tying app rewards to measured traffic instead of code markers** — The Tokenomics proposal, approved on October 27, 2026, bases an application's Canton Coin rewards on the actual traffic spent on transactions that change the state it manages, measured directly on the Global Synchronizer from sequencer and mediator data, rather than on FeaturedAppActivityMarker contracts builders had to place in their code; the approved text keeps the featured-app reward cap at 0.79, allowing at most 79 cents minted for every $1 burned, and approval is not implementation — on-chain steps are still required before it reaches Final status (CantonCap)
- **Canton's governance pipeline stands at 56 Final and 42 Approved proposals, with only four still Proposed** — The Canton Foundation's CIP registry counts 56 proposals Final and in effect, 42 Approved, 8 Active and just 1 Rejected across the full set; the four still at Proposed are CIP-0120 on traffic-based validator rewards, CIP-0108 to add Merkle Science's predictive analytics as a weight-1 Super Validator, CIP-0049 on cold-backup incentives for Super Validators, and one further governance item (Canton Network Docs)
- **The SEC's examinations arm has put tokenization on its fiscal 2027 priority list for clearing agencies** — The SEC Division of Examinations listed tokenization among its fiscal 2027 examination priorities for clearing agencies and Regulation SCI entities on October 23, putting the regulated clearing infrastructure Canton plugs into — including DTCC's tokenization service — squarely in the examination frame for the coming year (Blockchain Reporter)
- **Singapore FinTech Festival 2026 is live today with Canton tracked in the day's conference coverage** — CantonNews is tracking the festival, hosted by the Monetary Authority of Singapore and GFTN, as a live conference on November 18, the same day its daily edition leads on Canton developer tooling; the listing is conference coverage, not a Canton product announcement (CantonNews)

item.title: Blockdaemon schedules Canton Testnet and Devnet upgrades for November 19, taking Testnet to Splice 0.10.1 and Devnet to 0.10.2
item.description:
Canton Signal Feed (Nov 18, 2026 · 4:12 PM ET)
- **Blockdaemon schedules Canton Testnet and Devnet upgrades for November 19, taking Testnet to Splice 0.10.1 and Devnet to 0.10.2** — Blockdaemon will update all Canton Testnet nodes to Splice version 0.10.1 and all Devnet nodes to version 0.10.2 on November 19 at 14:00 UTC, following the Canton Foundation releases, with planned downtime of up to 15 minutes per node; the work is scheduled maintenance, not an outage response (Pulsapi)
- **Digital Asset's Proof of Transfer API lets Canton users confirm a transfer without exposing confidential transaction data** — The DA Registry feature shows whether a transfer of a privacy-enabled Canton asset succeeded, failed or is still pending, without revealing the underlying confidential details; Bybit has already integrated it, and Digital Asset is urging other wallets and exchanges to follow (Canton Network Forum)
- **BitSafe's CHYPE wallet app is set for Featured App status on Canton MainNet** — CHYPE, already cleared by the Tokenomics Committee, is up for an on-chain Super Validator vote that would grant it Featured App status from November 6, increasing the Canton Coin rewards the wallet earns for the activity it drives; committee clearance alone does not grant the status until Super Validators confirm it on-chain (Global Synchronizer Foundation)
- **Hecto launches $NEOPRIME, billed as Canton's first DeFi-native real-world-asset token** — The token gives exposure to a basket of U.S. pre-IPO defence, robotics and fintech companies, with more themed pre-IPO tokens promised and the team asking other Canton applications for integrations (Canton Network Forum)

item.title: Societe Generale earns 4,009,129 Canton Coin for completing its first Super Validator commitment milestone
item.description:
Canton Signal Feed (Nov 18, 2026 · 3:12 PM ET)
- **Societe Generale earns 4,009,129 Canton Coin for completing its first Super Validator commitment milestone** — The Tokenomics Committee has confirmed Societe Generale completed its first Super Validator commitment milestone, accepting tokenized assets as collateral, worth 4,009,129.4504 CC; the payout makes the bank's collateral work on Canton a paid, completed commitment rather than a pilot pledge (Global Synchronizer Foundation)
- **Nexode is reinstated as a Featured App after its pause for review** — The Tokenomics Committee recommended reinstating Nexode's Featured App status after it had been paused for review, restoring the application's eligibility for the enhanced Canton Coin rewards that Featured App status carries (Global Synchronizer Foundation)
- **Temple and Kora are recognised as delivery-versus-payment venues on Canton** — The Tokenomics Committee approved Temple and Kora for delivery-versus-payment treatment, meaning their atomic multi-asset settlements are recognised as genuine delivery-versus-payment rather than ordinary batching, which earns the assets they settle a better reward treatment (CC Space)
- **HackCanton Season 3 is in its build phase, with workshops and streams published for builders** — The third season of the HackCanton builder programme is under way, backed by the Canton Foundation and BitSafe alongside sponsors including Hacken, Metatarz and OneSwap, with workshops and streams published to support teams building on the network (Canton Network Forum)

item.title: Canton backs a Four Pillars research programme on real-world-asset and stablecoin risks alongside MetaMask and the Solana Foundation
item.description:
Canton Signal Feed (Nov 18, 2026 · 2:42 PM ET)
- **Canton backs a Four Pillars research programme on real-world-asset and stablecoin risks alongside MetaMask and the Solana Foundation** — Canton has joined MetaMask and the Solana Foundation in backing a Four Pillars university research programme in Seoul, with Canton's track studying the risks of issuing large-scale real-world assets and stablecoins on public proof-of-stake chains (Canton Network Forum)
- **Copper withdraws its Canton apps from the Featured App reward programme while Wormhole's integration milestone is approved** — Copper Technologies is removing its ClearLoop Settlement and wrapped-assets apps from Canton's app reward programme, saying it will keep using them for collateral movement but wants them economically independent, while Wormhole's Canton integration milestone was approved for a weight release (Global Synchronizer Foundation)
- **Tokenomics Committee pauses Wintip's Featured App status after its on-chain activity is flagged for review** — The Global Synchronizer Foundation's Tokenomics Committee has voted to pause Featured App status for Wintip (Winsnip) on MainNet after on-chain activity was flagged for review by the Accountability Committee; because Featured App status boosts the rewards an application earns, the pause materially changes the app's economics while the review runs (Global Synchronizer Foundation)
- **Nine in ten investment banks expect onchain repo and collateral mobility to reshape liquidity management within five years** — A Canton Network post citing SODA's tokenization survey reports that 90% of investment banks expect onchain repo and collateral mobility to significantly reshape liquidity management within five years, the institutional use case Canton is positioning its settlement network around (Canton Network)

Network: CC $0.0821 | Market cap $3.29B (rank 25) | 24h volume $12.71M | Supply 40,073,243,780 CC, up 2.46% in 24 hours and down 12.03% over seven days as of the 19:07 UTC November 18 read; milestone: Featured App Guidance v2.0b remains in force, holding the per-transaction featured-app reward cap at $0.79 with activity markers required to match burned fees one-for-one (Kriptometre for market data; Canton Network Forum for the milestone)

item.title: Bayzen is approved for Featured App status on Canton MainNet, with the decision now pending an on-chain Super Validator vote
item.description:
Canton Signal Feed (Nov 18, 2026 · 1:12 PM ET)

- **Bayzen is approved for Featured App status on Canton MainNet, with the decision now pending an on-chain Super Validator vote** — The Tokenomics Committee approved Bayzen for Featured App status, which lets an application earn boosted Canton Coin rewards for the activity it drives on the network; committee approval alone does not grant the status until Super Validators confirm it on-chain, and approval is not an endorsement by the Canton Foundation (CC Space)
- **Kaiko deploys the first institutional-grade price oracle on Zenith, Canton's EVM execution layer** — The market-data provider's oracle is live on Zenith testnet now and is due in production at Zenith mainnet launch, giving EVM developers on Canton regulated multi-asset pricing data; trusted pricing is the piece market infrastructures need before accepting tokenized assets as collateral and margin (Canton Network Forum)
- **Canton Coin spot prices sit 4.83% apart across exchanges, with no route rated worth taking outright** — A live scan at 16:56 UTC on November 18 puts Canton Coin cheapest on WEEX at $0.07844 and dearest on Bitrue at $0.082225 across 13 exchanges with a liquid spot market, narrowed from 5.18% recorded at 12:12 PM; the widest route, buying on WEEX and selling on LBank at 4.10% after fees, is flagged as a suspect pair, and the best futures route is long MEXC perpetuals and short Lighter perpetuals at 0.01% after fees (ArbitrageGap)
- **Canton Coin perpetual open interest eases to 315 million coins as funding stays near neutral** — Open interest sits at 315 million CC, about $25.96 million, down from 323 million CC and $27.22 million recorded this morning, with average funding across eight exchanges at 0.0012%, suggesting balanced positioning between longs and shorts, and 24-hour turnover at $19.97 million (JustScreener)

item.title: Palladium Labs open-sources its Chainlink oracle kit for Canton developers, packaging the price path Alpend already uses on MainNet
item.description:
Canton Signal Feed (Nov 18, 2026 · 12:42 PM ET)

- **Palladium Labs open-sources its Chainlink oracle kit for Canton developers, packaging the price path Alpend already uses on MainNet** — Version 1.0.0 of canton-oracle-kit, released on November 18 under the Apache 2.0 licence, brings together a report-verification contract, a price store and an example updater for Chainlink Data Streams reports; a pusher fetches a signed report, a Daml feeder contract calls Chainlink's verifier and checks the validity window, and the store rejects non-positive or stale prices and holds any move above a configured threshold in a pending state until a corroborating submission arrives, with the kit currently supporting V3 crypto reports on Daml SDK 3.4.11 and Canton 3.4.x and the application operator retaining authority over the verifier configuration, feed mappings and direct price writes (CantonNews)
- **Wells Fargo is among the organisations awarded new MainNet validator allocations, receiving three alongside five other operators** — The Canton Foundation Tokenomics Working Group awarded the additional allocations to Wells Fargo alongside Visoty, Cartumi, Winsnip, Winnode and Otoclick, issued in line with current network capacity and health assessments, in a further sign of institutional uptake of running Canton infrastructure (CC Space)
- **Three Canton applications lose Featured App status over free-traffic abuse, with the revocations now going to Super Validators** — The Tokenomics Committee, acting on the Featured App Accountability Committee's recommendation, is revoking Featured App status from Grofty Wallet, Yapper Agent and Ibex for abusing free traffic; the revocations still need on-chain approval by Super Validators, and Featured App status materially increases the Canton Coin rewards an application earns (CC Space)
- **Broadridge and Tradeweb each booked $1.4 million in the September quarter for their Canton services, paid in newly minted Canton Coin** — The figures, drawn from the two firms' SEC filings and reviewed in a Community Research Grants analysis using November 14 to 15 data, were earned for performing services as Super Validators and Validators rather than as fees from clients, making protocol issuance the visible form of Canton revenue for both reporting firms in that quarter (Medium)

item.title: Kaiko extends its Series B to $110 million, led by S&P Global with Canton also participating
item.description:
Canton Signal Feed (Nov 18, 2026 · 12:12 PM ET)
- **Kaiko extends its Series B to $110 million, led by S&P Global with Canton also participating** — The market-data provider, which is a Canton Super Validator, announced the extension on September 14 with S&P Global leading and Canton joining among other strategic investors; the company describes the round as a significant investment in data and data infrastructure from institutions that lead capital markets and digital assets, and no valuation or use-of-proceeds breakdown beyond that description was disclosed in the announcement (Canton Network Forum)
- **CC Space launches its AI network explorer on Canton TestNet, with browsing open and 500 free credits on signup** — The AI-powered explorer lets users ask questions about the network based on indexed data, explore consensus, on-chain activity, governance and detailed analytics, and track validators or parties or start building with the API before MainNet; no account is needed to browse, and signing up gives 500 free credits to try the AI assistant, alerts and API (CC Space)
- **CC Space cuts alert delivery cost tenfold to 5 credits and expands triggers across more channels** — Alert deliveries fall from 50 credits to 5, about 1.5 cents per notification, with expanded triggers covering validator and Super Validator health, traffic runway, Featured App compliance, party balances and governance proposals, delivered across web, email, Telegram, Slack, PagerDuty and webhook (CC Space)
- **Canton Coin spot prices sit 5.18% apart across exchanges, with no route rated worth taking outright** — A live scan at 17:13 UTC on November 18 puts Canton Coin cheapest on WEEX at $0.078395 and dearest on Bitrue at $0.082455 across 13 exchanges with a liquid spot market, widened from 5.02% recorded at 10:12 AM; the widest route, buying on MEXC and selling on LBank at 4.54% after fees, is flagged as a suspect pair, the best futures route is long WhiteBIT and short Hyperliquid at 0.24% after fees, and no route is rated take (ArbitrageGap)

item.title: CapConnect+ enters a Canton Super Validator vote with a plan to settle commercial paper and its cash payment together on the network
item.description:
Canton Signal Feed (Nov 18, 2026 · 11:42 AM ET)
- **CapConnect+ enters a Canton Super Validator vote with a plan to settle commercial paper and its cash payment together on the network** — CIP-0131, with voting open since November 10, proposes a Super Validator role for CapConnect+ with a maximum of five weight units tied to delivery and adoption, sponsored by Tradeweb and endorsed by MPCH; the first production target is at least $100 million in aggregate commercial-paper issuance with both the asset and the cash settling on Canton through delivery-versus-payment, and further weight is tied to $1 billion, $5 billion and $10 billion in cumulative Canton-settled issuance, while the platform's $46.11 billion in issuance facilitated since early 2025 used existing settlement infrastructure and is not Canton volume, and no vote outcome has been established (CantonNews)
- **Tokenomics Committee approves Stable Coin (SBC) as a Featured App, with the decision now going to Super Validators for on-chain approval** — The Global Synchronizer Foundation's Tokenomics Committee approved Stable Coin Inc.'s SBC application for Featured App status, which boosts the rewards an application earns for the activity it drives; the same notice confirms an additional Super Validator weight release for Canton Strategic Holdings under the Digital Asset Treasury programme, and committee approval alone does not grant the status until the on-chain vote passes (CC Space)
- **Bitget paused Canton Coin deposits and withdrawals for wallet maintenance, with no security incident or network outage reported** — A report dated November 17 says Bitget paused CC deposits and withdrawals for wallet maintenance and had not given a reopening time; the notices did not report a security incident or a Canton Network outage, so the pause limits exchange transfers without indicating a protocol problem, and users are advised to verify service status before moving tokens (CoinMarketCap)
- **Canton DeFi locked value eases to $11.33 million as 24-hour DEX volume holds at $17.37 million** — DefiLlama's November 18 snapshot puts total value locked at $11.33 million, down 1.47% in 24 hours from $11.55 million recorded earlier today, with DEX volume at $17.37 million in 24 hours and $130.84 million over seven days, perps volume at $236,218, and Temple still largest at $5.99 million ahead of Alpend at $2 million and Cantex at $1.74 million across eight tracked protocols (DefiLlama)

Network: CC $0.0829 | Market cap $3.3B (rank 26) | 24h volume $13.0M | Supply about 40,062,882,265 CC, up 2.41% in 24 hours and down 10.35% over seven days as of the 15:29 UTC November 18 read; milestone: live MainNet rewards over the past 24 hours rise to 10.3M CC, up from 9.3M CC at 9:42 AM, with current activity at 3.00 TPS, about 1.6K validators, 13 Super Validators and 4 active proposals (Altcoin Buzz for market data, reporting CoinGecko figures; CantonNews for the milestone)

item.title: Canton MainNet total transactions pass 606.2 million as validators rise to 1,572 and parties reach 951,980
item.description:
Canton Signal Feed (Nov 18, 2026 · 11:12 AM ET)
- **Canton MainNet total transactions pass 606.2 million as validators rise to 1,572 and parties reach 951,980** — CCTools' live read at 16:10 UTC on November 18 puts all-time on-chain transactions at 606.20 million, up from 605.7 million recorded earlier today, with 1,572 validators alongside 13 Super Validators, 951,980 total parties and 146 Featured Apps built on Canton; the figures describe cumulative network activity and infrastructure, not trading volume (CCTools)
- **SEC staff no-action letter views Canton Coin as a digital commodity and will not recommend enforcement over its programmatic issuance under specified conditions** — The Division of Corporation Finance letter dated November 3, covered today, says staff will not recommend enforcement action over Canton Coin's programmatic issuance without securities registration under the specified conditions; the letter reflects only the staff's position on enforcement, not a legal conclusion, and rests on the facts Canton presented, and Canton's own description of the coin as "not a security" is a clause the staff reply leaves out (BSC News)
- **Morgan Stanley is reported among the first banks to use DTCC's tokenization service on Canton** — Coverage today, citing Decrypt, says Morgan Stanley says it is among the first banks to use the service DTCC launched on Canton on October 28; the service tokenizes assets custodied at DTCC, and the report gives no transaction volume or asset amount attributable to Morgan Stanley's use (BSC News)
- **Canton Coin burned over the last seven days equals 58.6% of issuance, with 109.3 million coins burned against 186.5 million issued** — CCTools' burn-and-issuance record for November 11 to 17, drawing on Loop Data, puts the burn share at 58.6% over seven days and 55.9% over 30 days, with the latest daily burn at 15.6 million CC on November 17 and app rewards at 14.7 million CC that day; issuance is what the rounds schedule, not minted supply, because unclaimed rewards are not minted (CCTools)

Network: CC $0.0822 | Market cap $3.29B | 24h volume $12.81M | Supply 40.07B CC, up 2.91% in 24 hours as of the 16:17 UTC November 18 read; milestone: the latest issuance round is #122,273, with the next halving, Epoch 3, at round 262,800 and about 140,527 rounds remaining, when nominal daily issuance halves from 27.4M CC to 13.7M CC (CCTools for market data and the milestone)

item.title: OpenAssets brings its markets-in-a-box tokenization platform to Canton as a DA Registry implementation partner
item.description:
Canton Signal Feed (Nov 18, 2026 · 10:12 AM ET)
- **OpenAssets brings its markets-in-a-box tokenization platform to Canton as a DA Registry implementation partner** — In the November 5 collaboration with Digital Asset, OpenAssets will make its platform, which combines tokenized asset issuance, settlement, compliance, asset management and distribution in one stack, available to institutions on Canton, serving as an implementation partner for DA Registry, Digital Asset's tokenization engine; DA Registry adds allowlist, blocklist and transfer-approval controls connected to external KYC and AML providers, only the parties to a transaction can see it on Canton, and assets can take part in atomic settlement, collateral management and cross-application lending, with DA Registry already enabling more than 30 issuers and tokenization platforms on the network and no launch date or first customer disclosed (PR Newswire)
- **Canton accounts for $320.7 billion of the $366 billion in represented tokenized assets tracked on RWA.xyz** — The November 7 snapshot puts Canton far ahead of other networks on that measure, with the total almost entirely driven by Broadridge's Distributed Ledger Repo platform, which uses Canton technology to manage short-term repo loans backed by U.S. government bonds and reported $7.5 trillion in transaction volume for September 2026; represented assets are positions recorded on the ledger rather than freely traded onchain assets, and Finadium analysts describe Canton at this stage as a specialised record-keeping layer rather than a decentralised distribution network (RWA Signal)
- **About 79% of Canton transactions were executed privately in a 24-hour November window** — The November 14 review, drawing on CantonScan data, puts roughly 79% of transactions over the window as fully private under Daml-based smart contracts, with Digital Asset's institutional expansion supported by its $355 million June 2026 funding round and the October 2026 DTCC tokenization rollout; the figure describes the share of private execution, not total network volume (Basis Desk)
- **Canton Coin spot prices sit 5.02% apart across exchanges, with no route rated worth taking outright** — A live scan at 15:31 UTC on November 18 puts Canton Coin cheapest on MEXC at $0.079036 and dearest on Bitrue at $0.083005 across 13 exchanges with a liquid spot market, narrowed from 6.96% recorded this morning; the widest route, buying on MEXC and selling on LBank at 4.45% after fees, is flagged as a suspect pair, the best futures route is long WhiteBIT and short Lighter at 0.20% after fees, and all 9 routes in profit are rated risky with none rated take (ArbitrageGap)

Network: CC $0.0829 | Market cap $3.30B (rank 26) | 24h volume $13.46M | Supply 40,070,342,939 CC, up 1.31% in 24 hours with a 24-hour range of $0.0787 to $0.0857 as of the 14:22 UTC November 18 read; milestone: the network's infrastructure is supported by 827 validators, including 63 invitation-only Super Validators managed by the Canton Foundation (COINOTAG for market data; RWA Signal for the milestone)

item.title: Canton Foundation opens Community Research Grants with up to 50,000 Canton Coin a month for independent research and education
item.description:
Canton Signal Feed (Nov 18, 2026 · 9:42 AM ET)
- **Canton Foundation opens Community Research Grants with up to 50,000 Canton Coin a month for independent research and education** — The discretionary programme, published November 4, considers original research and educational content publicly published between November 1 and November 30, 2026 for its first round, with work shared by December 4 to be reviewed in connection with November; the Foundation may award less than the full monthly amount or nothing at all, full terms including eligibility, identity verification and sanctions screening were expected on or before November 15, and no grant will be made before those terms are published or without a signed grant agreement (Canton Foundation)
- **FTP Tech links ChatGPT and Claude to a Canton agent wallet through a hosted MCP server, with user-set spending caps** — The validator operator's Model Context Protocol server lets a user ask a chatbot to research a tokenized asset and then buy it with Canton Coin in the same conversation; in the published demo an agent swaps 100 CC into tokenized silver and ETH for a 0.01 CC fee per trade, daily and per-payment caps are set on the wallet by the user and can be changed at any time, and availability and supported assets beyond the demo have not been independently confirmed (FTP Tech)
- **Upflam payments and wallet platform opens to everyone on Canton, dropping its invite-only access** — Anyone can now sign up, create a Canton wallet and take payments through payment links, invoices, donation pages, embeddable buttons, recurring AutoPay and a WooCommerce plugin, with a 0.1% fee on incoming payments; fiat access and Shopify support remain planned rather than live (Canton Network Forum)
- **Canton Dev Fund analysis finds failed funding votes expire from absent voters, not rejections** — A community analysis of the Dev Fund repository finds seven funding votes failed with almost no votes against: they simply expired after 21 days because the 51%-of-eligible-voters threshold was never met, and four were reopened within days; it also warns that repository labels undercount failures because reopening a vote resets them (CC Space)

Network: CC $0.0829 | Market cap $3.32B (rank 26) | 24h volume $13.18M | Supply 40,072,723,113 CC, up 1.69% in 24 hours and down 9.80% over seven days as of the 15:00 UTC November 18 read; milestone: live MainNet rewards over the past 24 hours stand at 9.3M CC (Criptano for market data; CantonNews for the milestone)

item.title: MEXC's Featured App status is recommended for a pause over Canton Coin locking requirements
item.description:
Canton Signal Feed (Nov 18, 2026 · 8:42 AM ET)
- **MEXC's Featured App status is recommended for a pause over Canton Coin locking requirements** — The Tokenomics Committee has recommended pausing MEXC's Featured Application status because it does not meet the Canton Coin locking requirements introduced by CIP-0116, meaning the exchange's party stops earning featured-app rewards until it complies; the recommendation is an enforcement step under the locking rules, not a delisting of Canton Coin from the exchange (Global Synchronizer Foundation)
- **OpenZeppelin's Canton Daml library and four reference designs clear the Dev Fund vote** — OpenZeppelin, the smart-contract security firm recently acquired by S&P Global, has had its open-source Daml contracts library and four reference application designs for Canton — a privacy-preserving DEX, a lending protocol, cross-chain stablecoin payments and one further design — approved by Digital Asset and passed by the Dev Fund committee, giving teams building financial apps on Canton vetted, reusable building blocks instead of starting from scratch (Canton Network Forum)
- **Rome Protocol launches Ostia, a zero-knowledge EVM chain settling on Canton** — Rome Protocol has put Ostia live on Canton DevNet as an Ethereum-compatible chain whose blocks are proved with zero-knowledge proofs and settled in a single Canton transaction, with a bridge that moves Canton Coin and ERC-20 tokens between the two sides; the code is open source, so Solidity developers can now deploy to a chain that settles on Canton, and the launch is on DevNet, not MainNet (Canton Network Forum)
- **DTCC plans to connect its tokenization service to Solana in the second half of 2027, with a Stellar connection planned for the first half** — The service launched on Canton and DTCC's private Besu network on October 28 and runs under agreements with 20 participants, and the November 15 expansion plan was characterised as a multichain strategy rather than a move away from Canton, so Canton remains the first live venue while the other connections are future work (CoinStats)

Network: CC $0.082087 | Market cap $3.3B (rank 25) | 24h volume $11.7M | Supply 40,069,805,635 CC, down 0.1% in 24 hours and down 7.5% over seven days as of the November 18 read; milestone: more than 650 firms have connected to Canton in two years, per Digital Asset's Canton Summit 2026 recap (Crypheat for market data; Canton Network for the milestone)

item.title: Further Asset Management is approved as a Canton Super Validator, the first at that tier with a dedicated Middle East presence
item.description:
Canton Signal Feed (Nov 18, 2026 · 8:12 AM ET)
- **Further Asset Management is approved as a Canton Super Validator, the first at that tier with a dedicated Middle East presence** — Further announced today that existing Super Validator operators approved it under CIP-0113, giving it a formal governance role in the Global Synchronizer and a Super Validator node linking the UAE ecosystem; the firm says the move takes it from capital provider to active network operator, one of a small number of non-bank institutional validators on Canton, and Digital Asset chief executive Yuval Rooz said Further brings a live portfolio of companies that will generate real transaction volume on the network (Further Asset Management)
- **Canton's governance locks move from votes to code as CIP-0127 sets out on-chain enforcement of validator and app lock-ups** — The Canton Network Docs describe a governance lock as a Canton Coin holding locked to meet the requirements set by CIP-0105 for Super Validators and CIP-0116 for Featured Apps, with CIP-0127 as the functional specification defining the lock lifecycle and wallet workflows; governance locks are available from Splice 0.10.0 onwards, its first two increments are included in that release, every lock must hold at least 10,000 CC, and until custom controllers arrive all Super Validator rights owners and Featured App providers must use the compatibility mode the proposal defines (Canton Network Docs)
- **Canton's on-chain governance record stands at 573 executed proposals against 45 rejected, a 93% approval rate** — CCTools' governance data as of 12:10 UTC on November 18 puts the network's cumulative record at 573 executed and 45 rejected proposals, with total Canton Coin supply at 40.07 billion CC derived from the protocol itself; the figures are a cumulative governance snapshot, not a count of votes held today (CCTools)
- **Canton Coin spot prices sit 6.96% apart across exchanges, with no route rated worth taking outright** — A live scan at 06:25 UTC on November 18 puts Canton Coin cheapest on MEXC at $0.078731 and dearest on XT at $0.08421 across 12 exchanges with a liquid spot market, widened from the 5.57% spread recorded earlier today; the widest route, buying on MEXC and selling on Bitget at 6.75% after fees, is flagged as a suspect pair, and the best futures route is long MEXC perpetuals and short Lighter perpetuals at 0.08% after fees (ArbitrageGap)

item.title: Canton Index milestone votes seek acceptance for tools that turn ledger records into data applications can query
item.description:
Canton Signal Feed (Nov 18, 2026 · 7:12 AM ET)
- **Canton Index milestone votes seek acceptance for tools that turn ledger records into data applications can query** — Canton Index, a project from The Graph Foundation and InfraDAO, has votes open on two parts of its work: milestone 1, covering tools for defining and testing filters that select the records an application needs, and milestone 2, covering a pipeline that processes new ledger records and keeps an application's stored data up to date; each milestone carries 444,000 CC, for a combined 888,000 CC, the first milestone is returning to review after an earlier vote did not pass, with revised documentation and responses to design feedback in its resubmission, its source code remains private with publication planned by milestone 4, and neither vote had established acceptance or payment at the reporting cutoff, so these are votes on acceptance of submitted work rather than a new award for the whole project (CantonNews)
- **Canton Coin rises nearly 5% in 24 hours to about $0.084 in the latest market coverage** — Coverage published on November 18 puts Canton Coin at about $0.084, up nearly 5% over 24 hours on CoinGecko data, with the move attributed in that coverage to regulatory relief and tokenization momentum; the token remains well below its all-time high of $0.1942, and the gain is a price move reported today rather than a new network announcement (BSC News)
- **Canton Coin sits below all eight tracked moving averages with daily momentum in weak territory** — Technical reads dated November 16 to 17 put the daily relative strength index at 34.5, with the 4-hour reading at 38.7 and the weekly at 36.1, all below the neutral 50 line, and price below every tracked average, including the 20-day simple moving average at $0.0914 and the 50-day at $0.1047; support clusters between $0.0750 and $0.0799, with $0.0950 cited as the reclaim level for a recovery, and the daily structure remains a sequence of lower highs that has not resolved, so the readings describe a weak trend rather than a confirmed turn (CoinStats)
- **Canton exchange-traded product demand stays weak, with the 21Shares fund down about 25% over 30 days** — The 21Shares Canton Network ETF (TCAN) fell about 25% over 30 days as of November 13, while the Bitwise Canton ETP (BWCC) reported total assets under management of $0.24 million and a year-to-date net asset value change of -51.48%; the figures describe product flows and fund demand, not network usage, and sit against a broader market backdrop in extreme fear (CoinStats)
Network: CC $0.08441 | Market cap $3.38B | 24h volume $15.29M | CC up 4.62% in 24 hours and down 5.32% over seven days as of the November 18 read; milestone: DTCC's tokenization service has been live on Canton since October 28 under agreements with 20 participants, and Société Générale accepted $10 million in U.S. Treasuries tokenized through the service as collateral on Canton on November 2 (CoinStats for market data and the milestone, reporting Tiger Research for the service details)

item.title: Progmat partners with Digital Asset to tokenize Japanese government bonds on Canton for round-the-clock settlement
item.description:
Canton Signal Feed (Nov 18, 2026 · 6:12 AM ET)
- **Progmat partners with Digital Asset to tokenize Japanese government bonds on Canton for round-the-clock settlement** — The collaboration aims to settle the bonds in programmable token form on a 24/7 basis while preserving their legal rights; Progmat leads Japan's security token issuance market by value handled, and the initiative runs through a working group with 367 members that began live testing in November to build a sandbox for issuing tokenized government bonds and stablecoins, so the work is at the testing stage rather than a live government-bond issuance (Coin Newsify)
- **TSV completes its first transaction under the SEC innovation exemption, settling tokenized Canton Strategic Holdings shares on Canton** — The November 4 transaction moved issuer-sponsored tokenized shares of Canton Strategic Holdings through a permissioned pool on Tradecraft and settled them on Canton, with Fairmint, an SEC-registered transfer agent, handling the shares and maintaining on-chain ownership records; TSV describes itself as the first United States tokenized stock trading platform operating under the exemption, and the structure removed the 30-day notice period usually required for third-party tokenization (Coin Newsify)
- **Canton Development Fund approves RedStone's CAPS proposal to set a privacy standard for shared pricing data** — The Canton Access and Privacy Standard, approved on September 16, carries a 12-month development plan budgeted at 15.775 million Canton Coin, about $1.83 million, to let institutions use the same reference prices while keeping their own transaction terms confidential; the first implementations involve design partners Zenith and Memora, with Memora focusing on proof of reserves, so the standard is funded and in development rather than deployed network-wide (Cointelegraph)
- **Cancore raises $7.2 million to scale its Liquidity OS for tokenized finance after settling $86 million on Canton MainNet** — The seed round values the Canton-based trading platform at a $60 million token valuation and drew Paper Ventures, dao5, ArkStream Capital, X Ventures, MH Ventures and Proof of Talk, with no formal lead investor and Paper Ventures and dao5 as the largest contributors; the $86 million settled figure is the platform's own reported MainNet total (The Block)

Network: CC $0.0836 | Market cap $3.35B (rank 25) | 24h volume $15.39M | CC up 4.0% in 24 hours as of the 10:51 UTC November 18 read; milestone: Temple processed $698 million in 30 days, about 85% of Canton DEX volume, while Rocky Exchange leads all-time spot volume at $2.09 billion (CoinBird for market data, reporting CoinGecko figures; Coin Newsify for the milestone)

item.title: DamlFuzz funding vote seeks a free, open-source tool to test Daml contracts for authorisation and privacy failures before users find them
item.description:
Canton Signal Feed (Nov 18, 2026 · 5:42 AM ET)
- **DamlFuzz funding vote seeks a free, open-source tool to test Daml contracts for authorisation and privacy failures before users find them** — The vote, opened on November 14, would fund a fuzzer that tries many inputs and sequences of actions against contracts written in Daml, Canton's smart-contract language, checking rules about who can authorise an action and which parties can see the data; the proposed tool would run locally and fit into developers' regular testing, and the vote opening is a proposal stage, not an approved grant or a live tool (CantonNews)
- **Party-Aware Daml Upgrade and Vetting Planner vote opens to check an application update before it changes a running system** — The separate November 14 vote would combine checks on software packages, dependencies and permissions into a reviewable plan, with vetting meaning declaring which application packages a participant supports; the proposed first version would inspect one participant and produce a plan without making changes itself, flagging gaps where information is missing rather than treating the whole network as ready (CantonNews)
- **Supanova launchpad liquidity roughly doubles in its first week even as trading volume cools sharply from launch day** — AlphaMemeRadar's review of Supanova, which opened Canton's first memecoin launchpad on November 3, puts its liquidity page on November 11 at 5 pools loaded and $496.9K in total value locked, up from about $247,600 on November 4, while 24-hour volume fell about 95% to 451K CC from 9.73 million CC the day after launch; every trade on the launchpad runs against Canton Coin, tokens trade on a bonding curve with no gas fees and graduate into a liquidity pool, and the review notes a listing or graduation is not an endorsement or a safety check (AlphaMemeRadar)
- **Canton Coin rebounds from its November 17 low in the latest daily history, rising to $0.08346 from $0.07937** — TrackLivePrice's November 18 daily history, based on CoinGecko data, puts Canton Coin at $0.08346, up from $0.07937 recorded for November 17 and below $0.08260 for November 16, with the move described in the latest snapshot as up 3.82% in 24 hours and down 5.97% over seven days; the daily rows are snapshots, not a forecast (TrackLivePrice)

item.title: Kann Audits proposes two Canton security projects, covering independent audits of core components and AI-assisted scanning of Daml code
item.description:
Canton Signal Feed (Nov 18, 2026 · 5:12 AM ET)
- **Kann Audits proposes two Canton security projects, covering independent audits of core components and AI-assisted scanning of Daml code** — The two applications, submitted on November 14, seek assignments within the existing audit programme for independent audits of core components, with no new allocation requested and any work drawing on that programme's approved budget subject to selection, and the Canton Coin equivalent of $45,000 over nine months for an AI-assisted Daml security scanner that would include a catalogue of security weaknesses, developer-tool integration and three months of free access for each Canton team with a researcher reviewing its first scan; both applications still list a need for a champion to support them through the process, so they are proposals, not approved grants or audit appointments (CantonNews)
- **National Bank of Cambodia is testing tokenized government bonds on Canton in an SBI Holdings proof of concept** — The test, reported on November 18 with interim results due at the Black Swan Summit on November 15 to 16, is separate from a yen stablecoin remittance trial, and service details and timing remain under discussion, so the work is a proof of concept rather than a live government-bond issuance on the network (CoinStats)
- **Canborsa adds Anthropic-linked markets to its perpetuals venue, listing leverage of up to 10 times for both new tickers** — The ANT and ANTH markets announced on November 13 let traders take a position on price movements without owning Anthropic shares, with leverage amplifying losses as well as gains, and add another category of exposure to a venue that already supports Canton Coin as collateral (CantonNews)
- **Canton Coin spot prices sit 5.57% apart across exchanges, with no spot route rated worth taking outright** — A live scan at 10:14 UTC on November 18 puts Canton Coin cheapest on MEXC at $0.07952 and dearest on Bitstamp at $0.083952 across 13 exchanges with a liquid spot market, changed from 4.23% recorded on November 15, with the widest spot route, buying on MEXC and selling on LBank at 4.82% after fees, flagged as a suspect pair, and the best futures route long Toobit and short Hyperliquid at 0.09% after fees (ArbitrageGap)

Network: CC $0.0847 | Market cap $3.39B (rank 25) | 24h volume $15.37M | Supply 40,071,474,310 CC, up 5.22% in 24 hours and down 5.32% over seven days as of the 10:00 UTC November 18 read; milestone: live MainNet rewards over 24 hours stand at 6.4M CC, up from 6.1M CC in the 4:42 AM read, with current activity at 1.00 TPS, total transactions at 605.7M, total parties at 951.1K, about 1.6K validators, 13 Super Validators and 4 active proposals (Criptano for market data; CantonNews for the milestone)

item.title: Canton Dev Korea brings builders together in Seoul today for sessions on identities, participant nodes and application development
item.description:
Canton Signal Feed (Nov 18, 2026 · 4:42 AM ET)
- **Canton Dev Korea brings builders together in Seoul today for sessions on identities, participant nodes and application development** — DSRV is hosting Canton Dev Korea: Building on Canton in Seoul on November 18 from 09:00 to 12:00 UTC, with planned sessions covering operating Canton identities and participant nodes, application development and integration with existing systems, followed by questions and networking; registration requires host approval, so the session is a developer-ecosystem event for approved attendees rather than a product launch or a network announcement (CantonNews)
- **DPM Trace reaches its adoption-review vote after four independent organisations tested the transaction-debugging tool on Canton** — Walnut submitted its fourth milestone report after four independent organisations tested DPM Trace, which helps developers follow a transaction's actions and investigate failures, on Canton versions 3.4.11 through 3.7.1, bringing together their feedback and the team's own findings in 17 tracked issues; a 21-day acceptance vote opened on November 16 requiring support from at least 51% of eligible binding voters, and the vote opening does not establish acceptance or payment (CantonNews)
- **Canton Coin perpetuals show short-leaning positioning as open interest sits at $27.22 million across eight exchanges** — JustScreener's November 18 read puts perpetual futures open interest at 323 million CC, or $27.22 million, with average funding at -0.0064% across eight exchanges, meaning shorts are paying longs, 24-hour turnover at $20.45 million and the price up 4.04% over 24 hours; the figures come from a different provider than the derivatives read in the previous edition and describe positioning, not new spot buying (JustScreener)
- **Canton chain fees ease to $7,247 a day in the latest daily snapshot** — Crypheat's November 18 snapshot puts chain fees at $7,247 per day, down from $8,215 recorded on November 15, with the site describing fees as a proxy for real usage of the chain; the same snapshot gives a heat score of 2, rated COLD, unchanged from yesterday (Crypheat)

Network: CC $0.0843 | Market cap $3.38B (rank 25) | 24h volume $15.10M | Supply about 40.07B CC, up 4.57% in 24 hours and down 5.32% over seven days as of the 09:30 UTC November 18 read; milestone: live MainNet rewards over 24 hours stand at 6.1M CC, up from 5.7M CC in the 4:12 AM read, with current activity at 1.00 TPS, about 1.6K validators, 13 Super Validators and 4 active proposals (BlocFolio for market data; CantonNews for the milestone)

item.title: Stratalink Labs launches its Proof of Liquidity oracle on Canton MainNet, recording signed assessments of market depth on the ledger
item.description:
Canton Signal Feed (Nov 18, 2026 · 4:12 AM ET)
- **Stratalink Labs launches its Proof of Liquidity oracle on Canton MainNet, recording signed assessments of market depth on the ledger** — The PoLi Oracle, published November 17, scores secondary-market order-book depth observed directly from trading venues, with each score cryptographically signed and recorded on Canton as a point-in-time attestation that authorised parties can verify; the initial deployment covers Bitcoin, Ether, Solana and Canton Coin across two venues, IntellectEU built the Daml smart contract layer and the deployment runs on a validator provisioned through CatalyX Blockchain Manager with an on-ledger compliance check; PoLi measures market depth, not reserve backing or redemption access, so a fully backed asset can still score poorly if its markets are thin, and founder Robert McDermott confirmed institutional pilot discussions are at an early stage with no institutions yet using the system, making the launch a technical milestone rather than a commercial one (Unlock Blockchain)
- **Canton DeFi locked value holds at $11.55 million as 24-hour DEX volume rises to $17.6 million** — DefiLlama's November 18 snapshot puts total value locked at $11.55 million, with DEX volume at $17.6 million in 24 hours, up from $16.66 million recorded on November 15, $130.84 million over seven days and perps volume at $238,049 (DefiLlama)
- **Canton Foundation publishes CIP-0103, the dApp Standard defining a common interface between applications and wallets** — The standard, published on November 17 and listed as Approved on the Standards Track, introduces a vendor-neutral dApp API that decouples network connectivity and key management from decentralised applications, so users can access any application with a validator and signing provider of their choice while wallets enforce authorisation against malicious requests from untrusted applications (Canton Network Docs)
- **Canton Coin derivatives show no new buying behind the latest price gain, with open interest down and funding neutral** — CoinStats' November 18 read puts futures open interest at $36.04 million, down 1.24% over two days and 19.78% over 30 days and below the $40.35 million period average, with funding neutral at 0.0008%, 24-hour liquidations of only $3.11K almost entirely on long positions, and 24-hour volume of $12.68 million described as thin against the market cap, with no dated price-specific announcement found in the past 24 hours (CoinStats)

item.title: ChainSafe now runs the Canton DevNet endpoints OpenZeppelin uses to build and test its Daml contract libraries
item.description:
Canton Signal Feed (Nov 18, 2026 · 3:42 AM ET)
- **ChainSafe now runs the Canton DevNet endpoints OpenZeppelin uses to build and test its Daml contract libraries** — ChainSafe announced on November 16 that it will deploy, operate and maintain the DevNet API endpoints for OpenZeppelin, covering smart-contract package upload endpoints and Ledger API read and write access, so OpenZeppelin can deploy its Daml libraries and tooling and test them against a live network as it expands its Contracts library and reference implementations to Canton; ChainSafe is itself a Canton Super Validator, and the arrangement is DevNet testing infrastructure, not a MainNet application launch or a completed security audit (ChainSafe)
- **CIP-0132, the first technical paymaster model for Universal Burn, moves from discussion draft to a formal vote** — The proposal opened for voting on November 16, with Digital Asset as Super Validator sponsor and Five North as endorser, and sets out three steps for dedicated synchronizers: measure the synchronizer's traffic, have a designated paymaster burn Canton Coin after that traffic is consumed, and record activity that can qualify for rewards; this first phase still relies on the operator and paymaster to report usage accurately and does not yet enforce traffic limits, and the vote opening is not approval or deployment of the model, which builds on the already-approved Universal Burn framework in CIP-0129 (CantonNews)
- **Alpend gives ONE its own protocol identity as Adula, separating issuance from its private lending platform** — Palladium Labs introduced Adula on November 16 as the home for ONE, its privacy-native collateralized debt position protocol issuing ONE against collateral on Canton, while Alpend continues to focus on private lending and borrowing; the underlying mechanics are unchanged and each protocol now has its own identity and governance path, public minting of ONE against Canton Coin remains listed as coming soon, and swaps between USDCx and ONE remain available only in its open private beta (CantonNews)
- **Canton maintainers are testing a recovery runbook for validators that fell out of consensus after the MainNet Logical Synchronizer Upgrade** — A November 16 maintainer update says a small percentage of active MainNet validator nodes were unprepared for the most recent Logical Synchronizer Upgrade, having missed the minimum Splice version, and fell out of consensus; maintainers are sharing a finalized recovery procedure with a small number of validator operators to validate it and correct any unclear documentation, and planned to revisit progress the next morning US Eastern, after which a validated runbook would be posted publicly and added to the official Disaster Recovery documentation; the update does not say all affected validators have recovered (Canton Network Forum)

item.title: Canton Strategic Holdings doubles third-quarter revenue to $3.05 million and turns adjusted EBITDA positive for the first time
item.description:
Canton Signal Feed (Nov 18, 2026 · 3:12 AM ET)
- **Canton Strategic Holdings doubles third-quarter revenue to $3.05 million and turns adjusted EBITDA positive for the first time** — The Nasdaq-listed company (CNTN) reported on November 16 total revenue of $3,051,232 for the quarter ended September 30, up 104% from $1,495,859 in the second quarter, in its first full quarter of Super Validator and locking-as-a-service operations; network validation revenue rose to $1,503,238 as active Super Validator weight climbed from 0.5 to 6.5 of 15 approved, other revenue was $1,547,994, mostly locking-as-a-service, and adjusted EBITDA was $610,414 against a loss of $820,449 in the second quarter, while a $54.65 million unrealized loss on its digital-asset holdings drove a net loss of $35,078,297 (PR Newswire)
- **Nomura, NRI and BOOSTRY set out a joint plan to connect financial firms to onchain markets on Canton** — In their November 16 announcement, NRI is developing a service that captures blockchain transactions and balances in real time into its I-STAR securities back-office systems, BOOSTRY says its Canton-first institutional wallet entered production in September and that it has completed a protocol connecting Canton to its ibet for Fin digital-securities platform, and the three intend to examine government and corporate bonds, shares and funds from issuance through settlement and collateral use; the collaboration is still under consideration and builds on the single shared Super Validator arrangement approved under CIP-0130, with up to 10 reward weight in total (CantonNews)
- **Total Canton Coin burned passes 6.13 billion as fee burns run at about four coins for every five minted** — CantonScan data put the cumulative burn at 6.13 billion CC as of November 16, up from 6.05 billion recorded on November 15, with about $1.15 million worth burned in the 24 hours to November 16; because new CC is minted as rewards, burns at roughly 80% of minting mean supply still grows modestly rather than contracting, against about 40 billion CC in circulation (BSC News)
- **Splice release notes reach version 0.10.2, upgrading Canton to 3.7.3 and removing the last CometBFT support** — The 0.10.2 notes add CIP-104 v1.1 featured-asset activity fields to Scan event responses, add governance support for the amended traffic-based reward calculation, and remove the remaining CometBFT endpoints, metrics and charts from the Super Validator app; the release train follows the MainNet upgrade to Splice 0.10.0 that was listed for November 16 (Canton Network Docs)

item.description:

- **Canton Coin climbs 10.16% in 24 hours to $0.0852 as its market cap reaches $3.41 billion** — The November 16 read at 00:15 UTC puts Canton Coin at rank 25 with 24-hour volume of $18.00 million, still down 5.13% over seven days and 59% below its all-time high of $0.1942; the read notes no specific recent catalyst and attributes the move to a broader crypto market advance despite extreme fear conditions (Criptano)

- **Console Wallet reports full service restoration after a precautionary suspension following suspicious activity** — In its November 12 update, Console said it was fully operational after suspending services the previous week as a precaution; the restoration is the project's reported status and the short notice does not provide a full incident analysis (CantonNews)
